import json
if "_onebook_mdd_cache" not in globals():
    _onebook_mdd_cache = {}
from mdict_utils.base.readmdict import MDD
def _onebook_mdd_keys_diag(path):
    try:
        if path not in _onebook_mdd_cache:
            _onebook_mdd_cache[path] = MDD(path)
        mdd = _onebook_mdd_cache[path]
        total = 0
        sample = []
        css_keys = []
        lla_keys = []
        sample_cap = 80
        css_cap = 150
        lla_cap = 150
        for mk, mv in mdd.items():
            total += 1
            kt = mk.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore") if isinstance(mk, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(mk)
            if len(sample) < sample_cap:
                sample.append(kt)
            low = kt.lower()
            if (".css" in low) or low.endswith("css") or ("/css" in low):
                if len(css_keys) < css_cap:
                    css_keys.append(kt)
            if "lla" in low:
                if len(lla_keys) < lla_cap:
                    lla_keys.append(kt)
        return {"error": None, "total": total, "sample": sample, "css_keys": css_keys, "lla_keys": lla_keys}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"error": str(e), "total": 0, "sample": [], "css_keys": [], "lla_keys": []}

import json
import re
if "_onebook_mdx_cache" not in globals():
    _onebook_mdx_cache = {}
if "_onebook_mdx_lookup_v3" not in globals():
    from mdict_utils.base.readmdict import MDX
    _link_pat = re.compile(r"@@@LINK=([^\s<\n\r]+)", re.IGNORECASE)
    def _norm_key(k):
        key = k.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore") if isinstance(k, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(k)
        return key.strip().lower()
    def _decode_val(v):
        return v.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore") if isinstance(v, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(v)
    def _get_html_for_norm(mdx, tnorm):
        if not tnorm:
            return None
        stem = tnorm[:-4] if tnorm.endswith(".mdx") else tnorm
        for k, v in mdx.items():
            kn = _norm_key(k)
            if kn == tnorm or kn == stem:
                return _decode_val(v)
        return None
    def _link_redirect_lookup_keys(linked_raw):
        s = (linked_raw or "").strip().replace("\\", "/")
        low = s.lower()
        if low.startswith("entry://"):
            s = s[9:]
            low = s.lower()
        if low.endswith(".html"):
            s = s[:-5]
            low = s.lower()
        out = []
        if low:
            out.append(low)
        if "/" in low:
            parts = low.split("/")
            last = parts[-1]
            first = parts[0]
            if last and last not in out:
                out.append(last)
            if first and first != last and first not in out:
                out.append(first)
        bs = low.replace("/", "\\")
        if bs and bs not in out:
            out.append(bs)
        return out
    def _get_html_for_link_target(mdx, linked_raw):
        for t in _link_redirect_lookup_keys(linked_raw):
            h = _get_html_for_norm(mdx, t)
            if h is not None:
                return h
        return None
    def _resolve_mdx_link_redirects(html, mdx, depth=0):
        if depth > 8 or not html:
            return html
        s = html.strip()
        head = s[:500]
        idx = head.upper().find("@@@LINK=")
        if idx < 0:
            return html
        m = _link_pat.search(s[idx:idx + 200])
        if not m:
            return html
        linked = m.group(1).strip()
        inner = _get_html_for_link_target(mdx, linked)
        if inner is None:
            return html
        return _resolve_mdx_link_redirects(inner, mdx, depth + 1)
    def _onebook_mdx_lookup_v3(path, term):
        try:
            if path not in _onebook_mdx_cache:
                _onebook_mdx_cache[path] = MDX(path)
            mdx = _onebook_mdx_cache[path]
            norm = (term or "").strip().lower()
            if not norm:
                return {"html": None, "error": "empty term"}
            html = _get_html_for_norm(mdx, norm)
            if html is None:
                return {"html": None, "error": None}
            html = _resolve_mdx_link_redirects(html, mdx, 0)
            return {"html": html, "error": None}
        except Exception as e:
            return {"html": None, "error": str(e)}
result_json_out = json.dumps(_onebook_mdx_lookup_v3(mdx_path_arg, mdx_term_arg))

import json
import base64
if "_onebook_mdd_cache" not in globals():
    _onebook_mdd_cache = {}
if "_onebook_mdd_lookup" not in globals():
    from mdict_utils.base.readmdict import MDD
    def _onebook_mdd_lookup(path, key):
        try:
            if path not in _onebook_mdd_cache:
                _onebook_mdd_cache[path] = MDD(path)
            mdd = _onebook_mdd_cache[path]
            raw = (key or "").strip()
            if not raw:
                return {"data": None, "error": "empty key"}
            candidates = []
            k = raw.replace("\\", "/")
            if k.startswith("/"):
                candidates.append(k)
                candidates.append(k[1:])
            else:
                candidates.append(k)
                candidates.append("/" + k)
            # Common MDD key variants
            if k.startswith("./"):
                candidates.append(k[2:])
            candidates.append("data/" + k.lstrip("/"))
            candidates.append("/data/" + k.lstrip("/"))
            candidates.append(k.replace("/", "\\"))
            lowered = []
            for c in candidates:
                c2 = c.lower()
                if c2 not in lowered:
                    lowered.append(c2)
            def _normalize(k):
                return (k or "").strip().replace("\\", "/").lower()
            def _find_value(target_norm):
                for mk, mv in mdd.items():
                    key_text = mk.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore") if isinstance(mk, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(mk)
                    if _normalize(key_text) == target_norm:
                        return mv
                return None
            def _resolve_value(target_norm, depth=0):
                if depth > 4:
                    return None
                mv = _find_value(target_norm)
                if mv is None:
                    return None
                data = mv if isinstance(mv, (bytes, bytearray)) else bytes(str(mv), "utf-8")
                # Some dictionaries store MDD resources as aliases:
                # @@@LINK=other/path.ext
                try:
                    txt = data.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
                except Exception:
                    txt = ""
                if txt.startswith("@@@LINK="):
                    linked = txt[len("@@@LINK="):].strip()
                    linked_norm = _normalize(linked)
                    if linked_norm and linked_norm != target_norm:
                        return _resolve_value(linked_norm, depth + 1)
                return data
            for target_norm in lowered:
                data = _resolve_value(target_norm, 0)
                if data is not None:
                    b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
                    return {"data": b64, "error": None}
            return {"data": None, "error": None}
        except Exception as e:
            return {"data": None, "error": str(e)}
result_json_out = json.dumps(_onebook_mdd_lookup(mdd_path_arg, mdd_key_arg))

        function handleFiles(fileList) {
            if (!fileList || fileList.length === 0) return;
            const files = Array.from(fileList);
            const confirmMessage = files.length === 1
                ? ('
\nUpload 1 file?')
                : ('
 ' + files.length + ' 
\nUpload ' + files.length + ' files?');
            if (!window.confirm(confirmMessage)) {
                document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';
                return;
            }
            uploadFilesSequentially(files, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        function uploadFilesSequentially(files, index, successCount, failureCount) {
            if (index >= files.length) {
                const status = document.getElementById('status');
                const progressContainer = document.getElementById('progressContainer');
                const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                status.className = failureCount === 0 ? 'success' : 'error';
                status.innerText = '
 ' + successCount + ' / ' + files.length
                    + (failureCount > 0 ? ('
 ' + failureCount) : '');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    progressBar.style.width = '0%';
                    progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
                }, 2000);
                document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';
                return;
            }
            uploadFile(files[index], index + 1, files.length, function(ok) {
                uploadFilesSequentially(
                    files,
                    index + 1,
                    successCount + (ok ? 1 : 0),
                    failureCount + (ok ? 0 : 1)
                );
            });
        }
        function uploadFile(file, current, total, done) {
            const status = document.getElementById('status');
            const progressContainer = document.getElementById('progressContainer');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            
            status.className = '';
            status.innerText = '
 (' + current + '/' + total + '): ' + file.name;
            progressContainer.style.display = 'block';
            progressBar.style.width = '0%';
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('files[]', file);
            const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('POST', '/upload', true);
            xhr.upload.onprogress = function(e) {
                if (e.lengthComputable) {
                    const percent = (e.loaded / e.total) * 100;
                    progressBar.style.width = percent + '%';
                }
            };
            xhr.onload = function() {
                done(xhr.status === 200);
            };
            xhr.onerror = function() {
                done(false);
            };
            xhr.send(formData);
        }
    </script>

(function() {
    function removeTags(tagName) {
        const elements = document.getElementsByTagName(tagName);
        while (elements.length > 0) {
            elements[0].parentNode.removeChild(elements[0]);
        }
    }
    function removeBySelector(selector) {
        document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => el.remove());
    }
    removeTags('script');
    removeTags('style');
    removeTags('noscript');
    removeTags('iframe');
    removeTags('header');
    removeTags('footer');
    removeTags('nav');
    removeTags('form');
    removeTags('img');
    removeBySelector('.header');
    removeBySelector('.footer');
    removeBySelector('.nav');
    removeBySelector('.ad');
    removeBySelector('.banner');
    removeBySelector('.promotion');
    removeBySelector('[id*="banner"]');
    removeBySelector('[class*="banner"]');
    let title = document.title || "Untitled";
    const h1 = document.querySelector('h1');
    if (h1 && h1.innerText && h1.innerText.trim().length > 0) {
        title = h1.innerText.trim();
    }
    let contentNode = document.querySelector('article');
    if (!contentNode) {
        const selectors = [
            '.article-content', '.post-content', '.entry-content',
            '#article-content', '#content', '.main-content',
            '[itemprop="articleBody"]', '.art_content', '.news_content',
            '[data-testid="post-content"]', 'shreddit-post',
            '.container'
        ];
        for (let selector of selectors) {
            const node = document.querySelector(selector);
            if (node) { contentNode = node; break; }
        }
    }
    if (!contentNode) {
        contentNode = document.body;
    }
    let content = "";
    if (contentNode) {
        let clone = contentNode.cloneNode(true);
        const unwantedTags = ['script', 'style', 'noscript', 'iframe', 'frame', 'video', 'audio', 'object', 'embed', 'form', 'nav', 'header', 'footer', 'link', 'meta', 'button', 'input', 'textarea', 'select'];
        unwantedTags.forEach(tag => {
            clone.querySelectorAll(tag).forEach(el => el.remove());
        });
        const allElements = clone.getElementsByTagName('*');
        for (let el of allElements) {
            el.removeAttribute('style');
            el.removeAttribute('class');
            el.removeAttribute('width');
            el.removeAttribute('height');
            el.removeAttribute('onclick');
            el.removeAttribute('onmouseover');
            if (el.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'img' && !el.hasAttribute('alt')) {
                el.setAttribute('alt', 'image');
            }
        }
        content = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clone);
    }
    return { title: title, content: content };
})()

    window.applyFontSize = function(percent) {

    // Helper to find the main scroll container
    window.findMainScrollContainer = function() {
        // 1. Check if body/html is scrolling
        var docScroll = document.documentElement.scrollHeight > window.innerHeight;
        if (docScroll && document.documentElement.scrollTop > 0) return document.documentElement;
        if (document.body.scrollHeight > window.innerHeight && document.body.scrollTop > 0) return document.body;
        
        // 2. Find the largest scrollable element
        var all = document.getElementsByTagName('*');
        var maxScrollHeight = 0;
        var bestCandidate = null;
        
        for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
            var el = all[i];
            // Must be scrollable
            if (el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight && el.clientHeight > 0) {
                 // Heuristic: Must be reasonably tall (e.g., > 50% of screen) or have significant content
                 if (el.clientHeight > window.innerHeight * 0.3) {
                     if (el.scrollHeight > maxScrollHeight) {
                         maxScrollHeight = el.scrollHeight;
                         bestCandidate = el;
                     }
                 }
            }
        }
        
        // Default to body if nothing better found, or if body is indeed the scroll container (even if scrollTop is 0 currently)
        if (!bestCandidate) {
            if (document.body.scrollHeight > window.innerHeight) return document.body;
            return document.documentElement;
        }
        
        return bestCandidate;
    };
    // Scroll Handling with Polling Fallback
    var lastReportedPercent = -1;
    
    var reportScroll = function() {
        // Paged Mode Handling
        if (window.isPaged) {
             var totalWidth = document.documentElement.scrollWidth;
             var pageWidth = (typeof window.__obPagedPageWidthPx === 'number' && window.__obPagedPageWidthPx > 0)
                ? window.__obPagedPageWidthPx : window.innerWidth;
             var currentX = window.scrollX || document.documentElement.scrollLeft || document.body.scrollLeft;
             
             var percent = 0;
             if (totalWidth > pageWidth) {
                 percent = currentX / (totalWidth - pageWidth);
             }
             
             if (Math.abs(percent - lastReportedPercent) > 0.001) {
                 lastReportedPercent = percent;
                 if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollHandler) {
                      window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollHandler.postMessage(percent);
                 }
             }
             return;
        }
        
        // Default Vertical Mode
        var container = window.findMainScrollContainer();
        if (!container) return;
        
        var scrollTop = container.scrollTop || window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        var scrollHeight = container.scrollHeight || document.body.scrollHeight;
        var clientHeight = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        
        var percent = 0;
        if (scrollHeight > clientHeight) {
            percent = scrollTop / (scrollHeight - clientHeight);
        }
        
        // Deduplicate
        if (Math.abs(percent - lastReportedPercent) > 0.001) {
            lastReportedPercent = percent;
            if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollHandler) {
                 window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollHandler.postMessage(percent);
            }
        }
    };
    // 1. Event Listener (Capture)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function(e) {
        // Throttle
        if (!window.scrollTimeout) {
            window.scrollTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                 reportScroll();
                 window.scrollTimeout = null;
            }, 200);
        }
    }, true);
    
    // 2. Polling Fallback (every 1s) - catches cases where events don't bubble or fire
    setInterval(function() {
        reportScroll();
    }, 1000);
    
    // Initial Scroll Function
    window.restoreScroll = function(progress) {
         // Force Layout Calculation to ensure dimensions are correct immediately
         var forceLayout = document.body.offsetHeight;
         
         // Paged Mode Handling
         if (window.isPaged) {
             var checkAndScroll = function() {
                 var totalWidth = document.documentElement.scrollWidth;
                 var pageWidth = (typeof window.__obPagedPageWidthPx === 'number' && window.__obPagedPageWidthPx > 0)
                    ? window.__obPagedPageWidthPx : window.innerWidth;
                 
                 // If content fits (maybe layout not ready?), retry a few times
                 if (totalWidth <= pageWidth && document.body.innerText.length > 100) {
                     // Content exists but width is small -> Layout pending?
                     setTimeout(checkAndScroll, 50); // Faster retry
                     return;
                 }
                 
                 if (totalWidth > pageWidth) {
                     // Calculate target page based on progress
                     // Progress 0.0 -> Start
                     // Progress 1.0 -> End (totalWidth - pageWidth)
                     var maxScroll = totalWidth - pageWidth;
                     var targetX = progress * maxScroll;
                     
                     // Snap to nearest page
                     var pageIndex = Math.round(targetX / pageWidth);
                     window.scrollTo(pageIndex * pageWidth, 0);
                 }
             };
             
             // Try immediately and with delays
             checkAndScroll();
             setTimeout(checkAndScroll, 100);
             setTimeout(checkAndScroll, 300);
             
             return;
         }
         
         // Default Vertical Mode
         var attempt = 0;
         var maxAttempts = 10;
         
         var tryScroll = function() {
             var container = window.findMainScrollContainer();
             var scrollHeight = container.scrollHeight || document.body.scrollHeight;
             var clientHeight = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
             
             if (scrollHeight > clientHeight) {
                 var scrollTop = progress * (scrollHeight - clientHeight);
                 
                 // Try scrolling window first if container is body/html
                 if (container === document.body || container === document.documentElement) {
                     window.scrollTo(0, scrollTop);
                 } else {
                     container.scrollTop = scrollTop;
                 }
             } else {
                 if (attempt < maxAttempts && progress > 0) {
                     attempt++;
                     setTimeout(tryScroll, 200);
                 }
             }
         };
         
         tryScroll();
    }
    // --- Selection Info for Mark (Adapts to getXPath if available) ---
    window.getSelectionAnnotationInfo = function() {
        var selection = window.getSelection();
        if (selection.rangeCount === 0) return null;
        var range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
        var container = document.createElement("div");
        container.appendChild(range.cloneContents());
        var decorations = container.querySelectorAll(".ob-ruby-text, .vocab-badge");
        decorations.forEach(function(el) { el.remove(); });
        var text = (container.innerText || "").trim();
        
        if (text.length === 0) return null;
        
        // getXPath is defined in coreScript
        var startPath = getXPath(range.startContainer);
        var endPath = getXPath(range.endContainer);
        var rect = range.getBoundingClientRect();
        
        return JSON.stringify({
            text: text,
            startPath: startPath,
            startOffset: range.startOffset,
            endPath: endPath,
            endOffset: range.endOffset,
            rect: { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height }
        });
    }
    // Keep text selection on the current paged spread 
 do not auto-scroll to adjacent columns/pages.
    (function() {
        function currentPagedScrollX() {
            return window.scrollX || document.documentElement.scrollLeft || document.body.scrollLeft || 0;
        }
        function pageWidthPx() {
            if (typeof window.__obPagedPageWidthPx === 'number' && window.__obPagedPageWidthPx > 0) {
                return window.__obPagedPageWidthPx;
            }
            return window.innerWidth || 1;
        }
        function syncPinnedPageFromScroll() {
            var pw = pageWidthPx();
            window.__obSelectionPinnedPageX = Math.round(currentPagedScrollX() / pw) * pw;
        }
        function hasActivePhraseSelection() {
            var sel = window.getSelection();
            if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0 || sel.isCollapsed) return false;
            return (sel.toString() || '').trim().length > 0;
        }
        function pinSelectionToCurrentPage() {
            if (!window.isPaged) return;
            if (!hasActivePhraseSelection()) {
                window.__obSelectionPinnedPageX = null;
                return;
            }
            if (window.__obSelectionPinnedPageX == null) {
                syncPinnedPageFromScroll();
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener('selectionchange', function() {
            if (!window.isPaged) return;
            pinSelectionToCurrentPage();
        });
        window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
            if (!window.isPaged || window.__obSelectionPinnedPageX == null) return;
            if (!hasActivePhraseSelection()) {
                window.__obSelectionPinnedPageX = null;
                return;
            }
            var pinned = window.__obSelectionPinnedPageX;
            var current = currentPagedScrollX();
            if (Math.abs(current - pinned) > 1) {
                window.scrollTo(pinned, 0);
            }
        }, { passive: true });
    })();
    
    // Highlight Function (Robust with Offset)
    window.setHighlight = function(id) {
        // Remove old
        document.querySelectorAll('.epub-highlight').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('epub-highlight'));
        
        if (id) {
            var el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) {
                el.classList.add('epub-highlight');
                
                if (window.__obTtsAutoScroll !== true) {
                    return;
                }
                var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                // 0. Handle Paged Mode (Added for Native Audio support)
                if (typeof window.isPaged !== 'undefined' && window.isPaged) {
                    var pageWidth = window.innerWidth;
                    
                    // Check if element is outside the current viewport horizontally
                    if (rect.left >= pageWidth - 10) { // Next Page
                        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
                            window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge.postMessage({ type: 'page-next' });
                        }
                    } else if (rect.right <= 10) { // Prev Page
                        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
                            window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge.postMessage({ type: 'page-prev' });
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                }
                
                // Use simple window scrolling (matching TTS logic) which is more reliable in this WebView context
                var viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
                var topThreshold = viewportHeight * 0.15;
                var bottomThreshold = viewportHeight * 0.60;
                
                var isInComfortZone = (rect.top >= topThreshold && rect.bottom <= bottomThreshold);
                
                // Handle large elements that don't fit entirely
                if (rect.height > (bottomThreshold - topThreshold)) {
                    isInComfortZone = (rect.top >= topThreshold && rect.top <= bottomThreshold);
                }
                
                if (!isInComfortZone) {
                    var targetTop = viewportHeight * 0.3;
                    var scrollAmount = rect.top - targetTop;
                    window.scrollBy({top: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth'});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Hide Page Numbers Function
    window.hidePageNumbers = function() {
        try {
            // Standard EPUB page breaks and common class names
            var selectors = [
                '[epub\\:type="pagebreak"]', 
                '[role="doc-pagebreak"]', 
                '.page-number', 
                '.pagenum',
                '[class*="page-number"]',
                '[class*="pagenum"]',
                '[id*="page-number"]',
                '[id*="pagenum"]',
                '[aria-label*="Page"]',
                '[title*="Page"]'
            ];
            
            var pageBreaks = document.querySelectorAll(selectors.join(', '));
            pageBreaks.forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("hidePageNumbers error:", e);
        }
    }
    // Run safely
    try { window.hidePageNumbers(); } catch(e) {}
    
    // Cleanup Legacy Navigation Function
    window.cleanupLegacyNavigation = function() {
         var elements = document.querySelectorAll('p, div, span, nav');
         elements.forEach(el => {
             var text = el.innerText.trim();
             // Check for pattern like "[Previous] [Contents] [Next]"
             if (text.length < 200 && (
                 (text.includes('[Previous]') && text.includes('[Next]')) ||
                 (text.includes('[Contents]') && text.includes('[Next]')) ||
                 (text.includes('[Previous]') && text.includes('[Contents]')) ||
                 text === '[Contents]' || text === '[Next]' || text === '[Previous]'
             )) {
                  el.style.display = 'none';
             }
         });
    }
    // Call cleanup immediately
    window.cleanupLegacyNavigation();

// --- XPath Helpers ---
function getXPath(node) {
    if (node.id) return '//*[@id="' + node.id + '"]';
    if (node === document.body) return '/html/body';
    if (node.nodeType === Node.DOCUMENT_NODE) return '';
    
    var parent = node.parentNode;
    if (!parent) return '';
    
    var index = 1;
    var siblings = parent.childNodes;
    for (var i = 0; i < siblings.length; i++) {
        var sibling = siblings[i];
        if (sibling === node) {
            var path = getXPath(parent) + '/' + (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE ? 'text()' : '*[local-name()="' + node.nodeName.toLowerCase() + '"]');
            path += '[' + index + ']';
            return path;
        }
        if (sibling.nodeType === node.nodeType && sibling.nodeName === node.nodeName) {
            index++;
        }
    }
function getNodeByXPath(path) {
    // Handle standard HTML and XHTML namespace issues
    try {
        // 1. Try raw path first
        var result = document.evaluate(path, document, null, XPathResult.FIRST_ORDERED_NODE_TYPE, null).singleNodeValue;
        if (result) return result;
        
        // 2. If raw path failed, try to convert simple paths like /html/body/p[1] to namespace-agnostic version
        // Regex to find segments like /tag[index] or /tag
        // We replace /tag with /*[local-name()='tag']
        
        if (path.indexOf('local-name') === -1) {
             var newPath = path.replace(/\/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)/g, "/*[local-name()='$1']");
             // console.log("JS: Converting path " + path + " to " + newPath); // Debug
             result = document.evaluate(newPath, document, null, XPathResult.FIRST_ORDERED_NODE_TYPE, null).singleNodeValue;
             if (result) return result;
        }
        
        return null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log("Standard XPath failed: " + e);
        return null;
    }
// --- Block Offset Helper ---
function isBlock(node) {
    if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return false;
    // Common block tags
    var tags = ['P','DIV','H1','H2','H3','H4','H5','H6','LI','UL','OL','SECTION','ARTICLE','BLOCKQUOTE','PRE'];
    if (tags.includes(node.nodeName)) return true;
    
    // Check computed style
    var style = window.getComputedStyle(node);
    return ['block', 'flex', 'grid', 'table'].includes(style.display);
function restoreRangeFromBlockOffset(block, start, end) {
    var charCount = 0;
    var range = document.createRange();
    var startFound = false;
    var endFound = false;
    
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(block, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
    var node;
    
    while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
        var nextCharCount = charCount + node.length;
        
        if (!startFound && start >= charCount && start < nextCharCount) {
            range.setStart(node, start - charCount);
            startFound = true;
        }
        
        // Use <= because end offset can be exactly at the end of a node
        if (!endFound && end >= charCount && end <= nextCharCount) {
            range.setEnd(node, end - charCount);
            endFound = true;
            // If we found end, we are done unless start hasn't been found (which shouldn't happen if start < end)
            if (startFound) break; 
        }
        
        charCount = nextCharCount;
    }
    
    return (startFound && endFound) ? range : null;
/** Prefer paragraph-like hosts over a large wrapping DIV (avoids concatenating half the chapter). */
window.onebookFindSentenceBlock = function(node) {
    var el = node && node.nodeType === 3 ? node.parentElement : node;
    if (!el) return null;
    var semantic = el.closest && el.closest('p, li, blockquote, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6');
    if (semantic) return semantic;
    var fallback = null;
    while (el && el !== document.body) {
        var tag = el.tagName;
        if (tag === 'P' || tag === 'LI' || tag === 'BLOCKQUOTE' || /^H[1-6]$/.test(tag)) return el;
        var display = window.getComputedStyle(el).display;
        if (!fallback && (display === 'block' || display === 'list-item' || display === 'flex' || display === 'grid' || tag === 'DIV')) {
            fallback = el;
        }
        el = el.parentElement;
    }
    return fallback || el;
/** Collapse "...kitchen But all...kitchen doors." style duplicated runs from column/DOM quirks. */
window.onebookCollapseDuplicatedSentenceRun = function(text) {
    var t = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (t.length < 40) return t;
    var probeLen = Math.min(72, Math.floor(t.length / 2));
    while (probeLen >= 40) {
        var probe = t.substring(0, probeLen);
        var idx = t.indexOf(probe, 12);
        if (idx > 0) {
            var second = t.substring(idx).trim();
            if (second.length >= probeLen) return second;
            return t.substring(0, idx).trim();
        }
        probeLen -= 8;
    }
    return t;
window.onebookIsSentenceAnnotationNode = function(node, block) {
    var curr = node && node.parentNode;
    while (curr && curr !== block) {
        if (curr.tagName === 'RT' || curr.tagName === 'RP' ||
            (curr.classList && (
                curr.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text') ||
                curr.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text-isolator') ||
                curr.classList.contains('vocab-badge')
            ))) {
            return true;
        }
        curr = curr.parentNode;
    }
    return false;
window.getSentenceFromBlock = function(block, targetNode, targetOffset) {
     if (!block) return "";
     
     console.log("JS: getSentenceFromBlock called on", block);
     var rawContext = "";
     var hitIndex = -1;
     
     var walker = document.createTreeWalker(block, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
     var node;
     while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
         var isAnnotation = window.onebookIsSentenceAnnotationNode(node, block);
         
         if (!isAnnotation) {
             // When target is a ruby/wrapper element, only anchor on its primary word text
             // (first non-annotation text), not every descendant text node.
             if (targetNode && node === targetNode) {
                 hitIndex = rawContext.length + (targetOffset || 0);
             } else if (targetNode && targetNode.nodeType === 1 && targetNode.contains(node)
                        && !window.onebookIsSentenceAnnotationNode(node, targetNode)
                        && hitIndex === -1) {
                 hitIndex = rawContext.length + (targetOffset || 0);
             }
             rawContext += node.textContent;
         }
     }
     
     // Fallback if targetNode not found
     if (hitIndex === -1 && targetNode) {
         var word = (targetNode.nodeType === 3 ? targetNode.textContent : (targetNode.textContent || ""));
         // Strip annotation chrome if element.innerText pulled ruby glosses.
         if (targetNode.nodeType === 1 && targetNode.childNodes && targetNode.childNodes.length) {
             var primary = '';
             for (var ci = 0; ci < targetNode.childNodes.length; ci++) {
                 var ch = targetNode.childNodes[ci];
                 if (ch.nodeType === 3) { primary += ch.textContent; }
                 else if (ch.nodeType === 1 && ch.classList
                          && !ch.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text')
                          && !ch.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text-isolator')
                          && !ch.classList.contains('vocab-badge')
                          && ch.tagName !== 'RT' && ch.tagName !== 'RP') {
                     primary += ch.textContent || '';
                 }
             }
             if (primary) word = primary;
         }
         word = String(word || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
         if (word) hitIndex = rawContext.indexOf(word);
     }
     if (hitIndex === -1) hitIndex = 0;
     
     // Sentence Boundary Detection
     var sentStart = 0;
     var sentEnd = rawContext.length;
     var puncs = ['.', '!', '?', '
', '
', '
     function isAbbrevDot(raw, i) {
         if (raw[i] !== '.') return false;
         var sub = raw.substring(Math.max(0, i - 3), i);
         return sub.endsWith('Mr') || sub.endsWith('Dr') || sub.endsWith('Ms') || sub.endsWith('Mrs') || sub.endsWith('St');
     }
     
     // Backward
     for (var i = hitIndex - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
         var char = rawContext[i];
         if (puncs.includes(char)) {
             if (isAbbrevDot(rawContext, i)) continue;
             sentStart = i + 1;
             break;
         }
     }
     
     // Forward
     for (var i = hitIndex; i < rawContext.length; i++) {
         var char = rawContext[i];
         if (puncs.includes(char)) {
             if (isAbbrevDot(rawContext, i)) continue;
             sentEnd = i + 1;
             var nextChar = rawContext[i+1];
             if (nextChar && (nextChar === '"' || nextChar === '
' || nextChar === "'" || nextChar === '
')) {
                 sentEnd++;
             }
             break;
         }
     }
     
     var sentence = rawContext.substring(sentStart, sentEnd).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
     return window.onebookCollapseDuplicatedSentenceRun(sentence);

    window.log("Content cleaning skipped to preserve Chinese text.");

    setTimeout(handleSelection, 100);
// --- Tap Handling (Single & Double) ---
var lastTapTime = 0;
var tapTimeout = null;
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    // Check if we should disable core click handling (e.g. EPUB3 scripts are active)
    if (window.disableCoreClickHandling) {
        return;
    }
    try {
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.logHandler) {
            window.webkit.messageHandlers.logHandler.postMessage(
                '[HTMLBlankTap] CORE click path active (disableCoreClickHandling=false) xy=' +
                Math.round(e.clientX) + ',' + Math.round(e.clientY)
            );
        }
    } catch (err) {}
    if (window.clickAction === 'none') {
        return;
    }
    // Ignore interactive elements
    if (e.target.closest('a') || 
        e.target.classList.contains('onebook-highlight') ||
        e.target.classList.contains('vocab-badge')) {
        return;
    }
    
    var s = window.getSelection();
    // If user already selected text (drag - multiple words), ignore.
    // We allow single word selection to proceed to Single Tap logic.
    if (s.toString().trim().indexOf(' ') > -1) return;
    
    var currentTime = new Date().getTime();
    var tapLength = currentTime - lastTapTime;
    
    if (tapLength < 300 && tapLength > 0) {
        // Double Tap Detected
        clearTimeout(tapTimeout);
        if (window.doubleClickAction === 'off') {
            lastTapTime = 0;
            return;
        }
        
        // Select word at point for double tap
        if (document.caretRangeFromPoint) {
            var range = document.caretRangeFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            if (range && range.startContainer.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                s.removeAllRanges();
                s.addRange(range);
                
                // Expand to word
                s.modify('move', 'backward', 'word');
                s.modify('extend', 'forward', 'word');
                
                // Trim whitespace
                var text = s.toString();
                if (text.length > 0 && text.match(/\s$/)) {
                    s.modify('extend', 'backward', 'character');
                }
                
                var selectedText = s.toString().trim();
                if (selectedText.length > 0) {
                     if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.doubleTapHandler) {
                         window.webkit.messageHandlers.doubleTapHandler.postMessage(selectedText);
                     }
                }
                s.removeAllRanges(); // Clear selection after handling
            }
        }
        lastTapTime = 0;
    } else {
        // Single Tap - Wait to see if it's a double tap
        lastTapTime = currentTime;
        tapTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
            // Re-read in case settings changed during the debounce window.
            if (window.clickAction === 'none') {
                lastTapTime = 0;
                return;
            }
            // Check if selection exists (drag/phrase). If phrase, return.
            // If single word or empty, we proceed.
            var currentSel = window.getSelection();
            var currentText = currentSel.toString();
            if (currentText.length > 0 && currentText.trim().indexOf(' ') > -1) return;
            // Actual Single Tap Logic
            var word = "";
            var context = "";
            var range = null;
            // 1. Try to use existing single-word selection
            if (currentText.length > 0) {
                word = currentText.trim();
                if (currentSel.rangeCount > 0) {
                    range = currentSel.getRangeAt(0);
                }
            }
            
            // 2. If no word found, try caretRangeFromPoint
            if (word.length === 0 && document.caretRangeFromPoint) {
                range = document.caretRangeFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
                if (range && range.startContainer.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                    currentSel.removeAllRanges();
                    currentSel.addRange(range);
                    
                    // Expand to word
                    currentSel.modify('move', 'backward', 'word');
                    currentSel.modify('extend', 'forward', 'word');
                    
                    // Trim whitespace
                    var text = currentSel.toString();
                    if (text.length > 0 && text.match(/\s$/)) {
                        currentSel.modify('extend', 'backward', 'character');
                    }
                    
                    word = currentSel.toString().trim();
                }
            }
                    
            if (word.length > 0 && range) {
                // Get Context
 p/li 
 DIV 
                var block = (window.onebookFindSentenceBlock
                    ? window.onebookFindSentenceBlock(range.startContainer)
                    : range.startContainer.parentElement.closest('p, li, blockquote, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, div'));
                
                var context = "";
                if (block) {
                    context = window.getSentenceFromBlock(block, range.startContainer, range.startOffset);
                } else {
                    // Fallback if no block found
                    context = range.startContainer.textContent;
                }
                if (window.onebookCollapseDuplicatedSentenceRun) {
                    context = window.onebookCollapseDuplicatedSentenceRun(context);
                }
                
                var sc = range.startContainer;
                var startEl = (sc.nodeType === 1) ? sc : sc.parentElement;
                var rubyHost = startEl && startEl.closest && startEl.closest('.ob-ruby-container');
                var collectedWrap = rubyHost && window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer && window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer(rubyHost);
                var tapIsCollected = !!collectedWrap;
                
                // Show Temporary "Analyzing..." State (saved vocab included 
 may wait on contextual AI)
                try {
                    if (collectedWrap) {
                        if (window.clearActiveWords) {
                            window.clearActiveWords();
                        }
                        collectedWrap.classList.add('onebook-analyzing');
                        var savedRt = collectedWrap.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text');
                        if (savedRt) {
                            savedRt.dataset.originalText = savedRt.innerText;
                            savedRt.innerText = 'Analyzing...';
                        }
                        currentSel.removeAllRanges();
                    } else {
                        // Direct .ob-ruby-text child (not isolator): CSS positions it absolute
                        // via .onebook-analyzing 
 isolator stays display:none when ruby is off.
                        var wrapper = document.createElement('span');
                        wrapper.className = 'ob-ruby-container onebook-analyzing';
                        
                        var rt = document.createElement('span');
                        rt.className = 'ob-ruby-text';
                        rt.textContent = 'Analyzing...';
                        
                        var content = range.extractContents();
                        wrapper.appendChild(content);
                        wrapper.appendChild(rt);
                        range.insertNode(wrapper);
                        
                        currentSel.removeAllRanges();
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log("Analyzing state failed: " + e);
                }
                
                // Send Messages
                if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers) {
                    // Speech
                    if (window.clickAction !== 'favoriteOnly' && window.clickAction !== 'none' && window.webkit.messageHandlers.speechHandler) {
                        window.webkit.messageHandlers.speechHandler.postMessage(word);
                    }
                    // AI Analysis
                    if (window.clickAction !== 'none' && window.webkit.messageHandlers.aiAnalysisHandler) {
                        window.webkit.messageHandlers.aiAnalysisHandler.postMessage({
                            word: word,
                            context: context,
                            isCollected: tapIsCollected
                        });
                    }
                }
                currentSel.removeAllRanges(); // Clear selection
            }
            lastTapTime = 0;
        }, 300);
    }
function handleSelection() {
    if (window.__obSuppressSelectionAnnotationUntil && Date.now() < window.__obSuppressSelectionAnnotationUntil) {
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler) {
            window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler.postMessage("");
        }
        return;
    }
    var selection = window.getSelection();
    if (selection.rangeCount === 0) {
         window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler.postMessage(""); // Clear selection
         return;
    }
    var range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
    var text = window.__obExtractCleanTextFromRange(range).trim();
    
    if (text.length === 0) {
         window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler.postMessage(""); // Clear selection
         return;
    }
    // Favorited phrase: native opens 
 via phraseClickHandler 
 do not trigger selection translation.
    var anc = range.commonAncestorContainer;
    var el = (anc.nodeType === 1) ? anc : anc.parentElement;
    if (el && el.closest && el.closest('.favorite-phrase-underline, .favorite-phrase-highlight, .favorite-phrase-highlight-only, .favorite-phrase')) {
        window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler.postMessage("");
        return;
    }
    
    // 2. Prepare Annotation Data
    var startPath = getXPath(range.startContainer);
    var endPath = getXPath(range.endContainer);
    
    var highlightInfo = {
        text: text,
        startPath: startPath,
        startOffset: range.startOffset,
        endPath: endPath,
        endOffset: range.endOffset
    };
    
    window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler.postMessage(JSON.stringify(highlightInfo));
// --- Selection Helpers ---
window.__obPruneSelectionDecorations = function(root) {
    if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
    // Keep only real article text in selection payload:
    // - .ob-ruby-text / .ob-ruby-text-isolator: inline definition/annotation text
    // - rt / rp: native ruby markup
    // - .vocab-badge: reading-trajectory tap count badge
    var decorations = root.querySelectorAll(".ob-ruby-text, .ob-ruby-text-isolator, rt, rp, .vocab-badge");
    decorations.forEach(function(el) { el.remove(); });
window.__obExtractCleanTextFromRange = function(range) {
    if (!range) return "";
    var container = document.createElement("div");
    container.appendChild(range.cloneContents());
    window.__obPruneSelectionDecorations(container);
    return container.innerText || "";
window.getFilteredSelectionText = function() {
    var selection = window.getSelection();
    if (selection.rangeCount === 0) return "";
    
    var container = document.createElement("div");
    for (var i = 0; i < selection.rangeCount; i++) {
        container.appendChild(selection.getRangeAt(i).cloneContents());
    }
    
    window.__obPruneSelectionDecorations(container);
    
    return container.innerText; 
window.getSelectionWithContext = function() {
    var selection = window.getSelection();
    if (selection.rangeCount === 0) return JSON.stringify({ text: "", context: "" });
    
    // Get selected text
    var container = document.createElement("div");
    for (var i = 0; i < selection.rangeCount; i++) {
        container.appendChild(selection.getRangeAt(i).cloneContents());
    }
    window.__obPruneSelectionDecorations(container);
    var text = container.innerText;
    
    // Get context (Paragraph)
    var range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
    var node = range.commonAncestorContainer;
    
    // Find block parent
    while (node && (node.nodeType !== 1 || !['P', 'DIV', 'H1', 'H2', 'H3', 'H4', 'H5', 'H6', 'LI', 'BLOCKQUOTE'].includes(node.tagName))) {
         if (node === document.body) break;
         node = node.parentNode;
    }
    
    var context = "";
    if (node) {
         var contextClone = node.cloneNode(true);
         window.__obPruneSelectionDecorations(contextClone);
         context = contextClone.innerText.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
    return JSON.stringify({
        text: text,
        context: context
    });
window.getSelectionAnnotationInfo = function() {
    var selection = window.getSelection();
    if (selection.rangeCount === 0) return null;
    var range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
    var text = window.__obExtractCleanTextFromRange(range).trim();
    if (text.length === 0) return null;
    
    // Strategy: Find the nearest stable block parent and calculate text offsets.
    // This is robust against DOM changes like span wrapping (vocabulary highlights)
    // as long as the text content remains the same.
    
    var container = range.commonAncestorContainer;
    while (container && (container.nodeType !== 1 || !isBlock(container))) {
        if (container === document.body) break;
        container = container.parentNode;
    }
    if (!container) container = document.body;
    
    // Calculate offsets relative to this container's pure text content
    var preRange = document.createRange();
    preRange.selectNodeContents(container);
    preRange.setEnd(range.startContainer, range.startOffset);
    var start = window.__obExtractCleanTextFromRange(preRange).length;
    var end = start + text.length; 
    
    var blockPath = getXPath(container);
    
    return JSON.stringify({
        type: 'block-offset', // New format indicator
        text: text,
        blockPath: blockPath,
        startOffset: start,
        endOffset: end
    });
// --- Highlighting Rendering ---
window.highlightRange = function(range, className, styleProps, dataset) {
    // Try simple wrap first
    try {
        var span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = className;
        Object.assign(span.style, styleProps);
        Object.assign(span.dataset, dataset);
        range.surroundContents(span);
        return;
    } catch (e) {
        // console.log("Simple wrap failed, using complex wrap");
    }
    
    // Complex wrap: wrap each text node intersecting the range
    var nodes = [];
    var root = range.commonAncestorContainer;
    
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(
        root,
        NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,
        null,
        false
    );
    
    var node;
    while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
        if (range.intersectsNode(node)) {
            nodes.push(node);
        }
    }
    
    // Fallback for when root is a text node and walker might behave differently or if simple wrap failed for other reasons
    if (nodes.length === 0 && root.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && range.intersectsNode(root)) {
        nodes.push(root);
    }
    nodes.forEach(function(node) {
        var subRange = document.createRange();
        subRange.selectNodeContents(node);
        
        if (node === range.startContainer) {
            subRange.setStart(node, range.startOffset);
        }
        if (node === range.endContainer) {
            subRange.setEnd(node, range.endOffset);
        }
        
        if (subRange.toString().length === 0) return;
        
        var span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = className;
        Object.assign(span.style, styleProps);
        Object.assign(span.dataset, dataset);
        
        // Debug: Force visible style if transparent
        // if (span.style.backgroundColor === 'transparent' && !span.style.borderBottom) {
        //    span.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.2)';
        // }
        
        try {
            subRange.surroundContents(span);
            // console.log("Highlighted text: " + subRange.toString());
        } catch (e) {
            console.log("Sub-range wrap failed: " + e);
        }
    });
window.drawAnnotations = function(jsonString) {
    console.log("JS: drawAnnotations called with " + jsonString.length + " chars"); // Debug
    var annotations = JSON.parse(jsonString);
    console.log("JS: Parsing " + annotations.length + " annotations"); // Debug
    
    // Remove existing highlights
    var existing = document.querySelectorAll('.onebook-highlight');
    existing.forEach(function(el) {
        var parent = el.parentNode;
        parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(el.innerText), el);
        parent.normalize(); // Merge text nodes
    });
    annotations.forEach(function(ant) {
        try {
            var info = JSON.parse(ant.cfi);
            var range = null;
            
            if (info.type === 'block-offset') {
                // New robust strategy
                var block = getNodeByXPath(info.blockPath);
                if (block) {
                    range = restoreRangeFromBlockOffset(block, info.startOffset, info.endOffset);
                    if (!range) {
                        console.log("JS: restoreRangeFromBlockOffset returned null for " + info.text);
                    }
                } else {
                    console.log("JS: Block node not found for path: " + info.blockPath);
                }
            } else {
                // Old fragile strategy (fallback)
                var startNode = getNodeByXPath(info.startPath);
                var endNode = getNodeByXPath(info.endPath);
                
                if (startNode && endNode) {
                    range = document.createRange();
                    range.setStart(startNode, info.startOffset);
                    range.setEnd(endNode, info.endOffset);
                }
            }
            
            if (range) {
                var styleProps = {};
                var className = 'onebook-highlight';
                
                if (ant.color === 'underline-green') {
                    // styleProps.borderBottom = '2px solid #2ECC71';
                    // styleProps.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                    // className += ' onebook-underline-green';
                    
                    // Try background color for debugging visibility
                    styleProps.backgroundColor = 'rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.5)'; // Increased opacity
                    styleProps.borderBottom = '2px solid #2ECC71';
                } else if (ant.color === 'underline-red') {
                    styleProps.borderBottom = '2px solid #E74C3C';
                    styleProps.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                    className += ' onebook-underline-red';
                } else if (ant.color === 'underline-blue') {
                    styleProps.borderBottom = '2px solid #3498DB';
                    styleProps.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                    className += ' onebook-underline-blue';
                } else if (ant.color === 'underline-yellow') {
                     styleProps.borderBottom = '2px solid #F1C40F';
                     styleProps.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                     className += ' onebook-underline-yellow';
                } else {
                    styleProps.backgroundColor = ant.color;
                    styleProps.opacity = '0.5';
                }
                
                // Force z-index to ensure visibility
                styleProps.position = 'relative';
                styleProps.zIndex = '10';
                
                window.highlightRange(range, className, styleProps, { id: ant.id });
                console.log("JS: Highlighted " + info.text + " with color " + ant.color);
            } else {
                console.log("JS: Range could not be restored for annotation: " + ant.id);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.log("Error drawing annotation: " + e);
        }
    });
// Word-boundary helpers without regex lookbehind (older WebKit rejects `(?<!

window.onebookIsWordConnectorChar = function(ch) {
    if (!ch) return false;
    return /[A-Za-z0-9'

window.onebookHasWordBoundaries = function(text, index, length) {
    var before = index > 0 ? text.charAt(index - 1) : '';
    var after = index + length < text.length ? text.charAt(index + length) : '';
    return !window.onebookIsWordConnectorChar(before) && !window.onebookIsWordConnectorChar(after);
window.onebookApplyAnnotationDisplayModes = function(gradedMode, collectedMode) {
    if (collectedMode === undefined || collectedMode === null) {
        collectedMode = gradedMode;
    }
    var body = document.body;
    if (!body) return;
    body.classList.remove('ob-show-graded-ruby');
    body.classList.remove('ob-show-collected-ruby');
    body.classList.remove('ob-hide-highlights');
    body.classList.remove('ob-hide-graded-highlights');
    body.classList.remove('ob-hide-collected-highlights');
    if (gradedMode === 'ruby') {
        body.classList.add('ob-show-graded-ruby');
    } else if (gradedMode === 'none') {
        body.classList.add('ob-hide-graded-highlights');
    }
    if (collectedMode === 'ruby') {
        body.classList.add('ob-show-collected-ruby');
    } else if (collectedMode === 'none') {
        body.classList.add('ob-hide-collected-highlights');
    }
    // body.ob-show-ruby drives the expanded line-height reserve in Foliate theme CSS.
    // Keep it on whenever annotation wrappers remain, so highlight / ruby / none
    // toggles do not change line-height or reflow pagination.
    var hasAnnot = !!document.querySelector('.ob-ruby-container, ruby.ob-ruby, .vocab-wrapper');
    if (hasAnnot || gradedMode === 'ruby' || collectedMode === 'ruby') {
        body.classList.add('ob-show-ruby');
    } else {
        body.classList.remove('ob-show-ruby');
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('.ob-ruby-text-isolator').forEach(function(el) {
        el.style.removeProperty('display');
        el.style.removeProperty('visibility');
        el.style.removeProperty('opacity');
    });
