window.cleanAnnotations = function() {
    // Clean both old ruby tags and new span containers for backward compatibility
    var existing = document.querySelectorAll('ruby.ob-ruby, .ob-ruby-container, .vocab-wrapper');
    existing.forEach(function(el) {
        var parent = el.parentNode;
        if (!parent) return;
        var text = "";
        el.childNodes.forEach(function(node) {
            // Keep only the wrapped word (direct text nodes). Never use textContent on
            // element children 
 ob-ruby-text-isolator holds the definition and would leak into body text.
            if (node.nodeType === 3) {
                text += node.nodeValue;
                return;
            }
            if (node.nodeType !== 1) return;
            if (node.nodeName === 'RT' || node.nodeName === 'RP') return;
            if (node.classList && (
                node.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text') ||
                node.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text-isolator') ||
                node.classList.contains('vocab-badge')
            )) return;
        });
        parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(text), el);
        parent.normalize();
    });
window.clearActiveWords = function() {
    var activeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.onebook-analyzing, .onebook-active');
    activeElements.forEach(function(el) {
        el.classList.remove('onebook-analyzing');
        el.classList.remove('onebook-active');
        
        // Restore original ruby text if modified
        var rt = el.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text');
        if (rt) {
            if (rt.dataset.originalText) {
                rt.innerText = rt.dataset.originalText;
                delete rt.dataset.originalText;
            } else if (rt.innerText === 'Analyzing...') {
                // Temporary Analyzing chip (isolator or legacy in-flow) 
 remove fully.
                var isolator = rt.closest && rt.closest('.ob-ruby-text-isolator');
                if (isolator && isolator.parentNode === el) {
                    isolator.remove();
                } else {
                    rt.remove();
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Check if it has any class starting with 'level-'
        var hasLevel = false;
        el.classList.forEach(function(cls) {
            if (cls.startsWith('level-')) hasLevel = true;
        });
        
        // If it was a temporary container (no level classes) and has no RT left, unwrap it
        if (!hasLevel && el.classList.contains('ob-ruby-container')) {
            if (!el.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text')) {
                var parent = el.parentNode;
                while (el.firstChild) {
                    parent.insertBefore(el.firstChild, el);
                }
                parent.removeChild(el);
                parent.normalize(); // Merge text nodes
            }
        }
    });
// --- Vocabulary Rendering (Legacy) ---
window.cleanVocabulary = function() {
    var existing = document.querySelectorAll('.vocab-wrapper');
    existing.forEach(function(el) {
        var parent = el.parentNode;
        var ruby = el.querySelector('ruby');
        var text = "";
        if (ruby) {
            ruby.childNodes.forEach(function(node) {
                if (node.nodeName !== 'RT') {
                    text += node.textContent;
                }
            });
        }
        if (!text) text = el.textContent;
        
        parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(text), el);
        parent.normalize();
    });
window.drawVocabulary = function(jsonString) {
    var words = JSON.parse(jsonString);
    window.cleanVocabulary();
    words.sort((a, b) => b.word.length - a.word.length);
    
    words.forEach(function(vocab) {
        if (!vocab.word) return;
        var word = vocab.word;
        
        var walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
        var node;
        var matches = [];
        
        while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
            if (node.parentNode.classList.contains('vocab-wrapper') || 
                node.parentNode.nodeName === 'RUBY' || 
                node.parentNode.nodeName === 'RT') continue;
            
            var text = node.textContent;
            var escaped = word.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\\\$&');
            var regex = new RegExp(escaped, 'gi');
            
            var match;
            while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
                if (window.onebookHasWordBoundaries &&
                    !window.onebookHasWordBoundaries(text, match.index, match[0].length)) {
                    continue;
                }
                matches.push({
                    node: node,
                    index: match.index,
                    length: match[0].length
                });
            }
        }
        
        matches.reverse().forEach(function(m) {
            try {
                var range = document.createRange();
                range.setStart(m.node, m.index);
                range.setEnd(m.node, m.index + m.length);
                
                var wrapper = document.createElement('span');
                wrapper.className = 'vocab-wrapper';
                wrapper.onclick = function(e) {
                    // If inside a favorite phrase, let the event bubble to the phrase handler
                    if (this.closest('.favorite-phrase, .favorite-phrase-underline, .favorite-phrase-highlight, .favorite-phrase-highlight-only')) {
                        return;
                    }
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.selectionHandler) {
                        window.webkit.messageHandlers.selectionHandler.postMessage(word);
                    }
                };
                
                var content = range.extractContents();
                wrapper.appendChild(content);
                range.insertNode(wrapper);
            } catch (e) {
                console.log("Vocab highlight failed: " + e);
            }
        });
    });
window.drawWordAnnotations = function(jsonString, skipClean) {
    if (!skipClean) {
        window.cleanAnnotations();
    }
    var wordsRaw = JSON.parse(jsonString); // Expecting { "word": "definition" }
    var words = {};
    // Normalize keys to lowercase for case-insensitive lookup
    Object.keys(wordsRaw).forEach(function(key) {
        words[key.toLowerCase()] = wordsRaw[key];
    });
    
    var wordKeys = Object.keys(words);
    if (wordKeys.length === 0) return;
    
    // Sort by length desc
    wordKeys.sort(function(a, b) { return b.length - a.length; });            
    function escapeRegExp(string) {
        return string.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\\\$&');
    }
    var patternParts = wordKeys.map(function(k) {
        return escapeRegExp(k);
    });
    var pattern = new RegExp("(" + patternParts.join("|") + ")", "gi");
    function onebookAnnotationFindBlock(el) {
        var n = el;
        while (n && n !== document.body) {
            if (n.nodeType === 1) {
                var tag = n.tagName;
                if (tag === 'P' || tag === 'DIV' || tag === 'H1' || tag === 'H2' || tag === 'H3' || tag === 'H4' || tag === 'H5' || tag === 'LI' || tag === 'BLOCKQUOTE') {
                    return n;
                }
                var st = window.getComputedStyle(n);
                if (['block','list-item','flex','grid','table'].includes(st.display)) {
                    return n;
                }
            }
            n = n.parentNode;
        }
        return null;
    }
    function onebookNormContextSig(s) {
        if (s == null || s === undefined) return '';
        var t = String(s).trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
        try {
            t = t.normalize('NFD').replace(/\p{M}/gu, '');
        } catch (e) {
            try { t = t.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, ''); } catch (e2) {}
        }
        return t.toLowerCase();
    }
    function onebookPickTimelineDef(glosses, textNode, charIndexInNode) {
        if (!glosses || !glosses.length || !textNode) return null;
        var block = onebookAnnotationFindBlock(textNode);
        if (!block || !window.getSentenceFromBlock) return null;
        var liveCtx = '';
        try {
            liveCtx = window.getSentenceFromBlock(block, textNode, charIndexInNode);
        } catch (e) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!liveCtx) return null;
        var liveNorm = onebookNormContextSig(liveCtx);
        for (var i = 0; i < glosses.length; i++) {
            var gn = glosses[i].contextNorm || '';
            if (!gn) continue;
            if (liveNorm === gn) return glosses[i].definition;
            if (liveNorm.length >= 12 && gn.length >= 12 && (liveNorm.indexOf(gn) >= 0 || gn.indexOf(liveNorm) >= 0)) {
                return glosses[i].definition;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function onebookResolveMatchDisplay(data, textNode, charIndexInNode) {
        var defText = "";
        var level = "";
        var badgeCount = 0;
        if (typeof data === 'string') {
            defText = data;
        } else if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
            if (typeof data.definition === 'string') {
                defText = data.definition;
            }
            level = data.level || "";
            var rawBadge = data.badgeCount || data.badge_count || data.tapCount || data.tap_count || 0;
            var parsedBadge = parseInt(rawBadge, 10);
            badgeCount = isNaN(parsedBadge) ? 0 : parsedBadge;
        }
        if (data && typeof data === 'object' && data.contextGlosses && data.contextGlosses.length > 0 && textNode) {
            var picked = onebookPickTimelineDef(data.contextGlosses, textNode, charIndexInNode);
            if (picked) defText = picked;
        }
        return { definition: defText, level: level, badgeCount: badgeCount };
    }
    function onebookRenderRubyText(target, text, badgeTextValue) {
        if (!target) return;
        while (target.firstChild) {
            target.removeChild(target.firstChild);
        }
        if (badgeTextValue) {
            var badge = document.createElement('span');
            badge.className = 'vocab-badge';
            badge.style.cssText = 'color:#ffffff !important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#ffffff !important;';
            badge.textContent = badgeTextValue;
            target.appendChild(badge);
        }
        target.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text || ''));
    }
    function onebookSetRubyBadge(rt, badgeCount) {
        if (!rt) return;
        var badgeText = (badgeCount && badgeCount > 0)
            ? ((badgeCount > 99) ? '99+' : String(badgeCount))
            : null;
        var existingBadge = rt.querySelector('.vocab-badge');
        if (!badgeText) {
            if (existingBadge) existingBadge.remove();
            return;
        }
        if (existingBadge) {
            existingBadge.textContent = badgeText;
            existingBadge.style.cssText = 'color:#ffffff !important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#ffffff !important;';
            return;
        }
        var badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'vocab-badge';
        badge.style.cssText = 'color:#ffffff !important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#ffffff !important;';
        badge.textContent = badgeText;
        rt.insertBefore(badge, rt.firstChild);
    }
    function onebookRubyContainerWordText(wrapper) {
        if (!wrapper) return '';
        for (var ci = 0; ci < wrapper.childNodes.length; ci++) {
            var ch = wrapper.childNodes[ci];
            if (ch.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                var t = (ch.nodeValue || '').trim();
                if (t) return t;
            }
        }
        return '';
    }
    /** Word text node inside ruby 
 needed so contextGlosses matching can read the live sentence. */
    function onebookRubyContainerWordTextNode(wrapper) {
        if (!wrapper) return null;
        for (var ci = 0; ci < wrapper.childNodes.length; ci++) {
            var ch = wrapper.childNodes[ci];
            if (ch.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && (ch.nodeValue || '').trim()) {
                return ch;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function onebookPayloadLevelToken(data) {
        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return '';
        return data.level ? String(data.level) : '';
    }
    /** Incremental inject: upgrade CEFR-only wrappers to saved-vocabulary styling in place. */
    function onebookUpgradeCollectedVocabularyStyles(wordsMap) {
        if (!wordsMap || typeof wordsMap !== 'object') return;
        var containers = document.querySelectorAll('.ob-ruby-container');
        containers.forEach(function(wrapper) {
            var wordText = onebookRubyContainerWordText(wrapper);
            if (!wordText) return;
            var data = wordsMap[wordText.toLowerCase()];
            if (!data) return;
            var level = onebookPayloadLevelToken(data).toLowerCase();
            if (level.indexOf('user-marked') < 0) return;
            var alreadyCollected = wrapper.classList.contains('level-user-marked');
            if (!alreadyCollected) {
                var remove = [];
                wrapper.classList.forEach(function(cls) {
                    if (cls.indexOf('level-') === 0) remove.push(cls);
                });
                remove.forEach(function(cls) { wrapper.classList.remove(cls); });
                wrapper.classList.add('level-user-marked');
            }
            var rt = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text');
            var wordNode = onebookRubyContainerWordTextNode(wrapper);
            var resolved = onebookResolveMatchDisplay(data, wordNode, 0);
            var fullDef = resolved.definition || (typeof data.definition === 'string' ? data.definition : '');
            var fullGloss = onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload(data);
            if (!rt) return;
            if (!fullDef) fullDef = wordText;
            rt.dataset.fullText = fullDef;
            if (fullGloss) {
                rt.dataset.fullGlossary = fullGloss;
            } else {
                delete rt.dataset.fullGlossary;
            }
            var badgeLabel = (resolved.badgeCount && resolved.badgeCount > 0)
                ? ((resolved.badgeCount > 99) ? '99+' : String(resolved.badgeCount))
                : null;
            var isolator = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text-isolator');
            if (window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout) {
                window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout(
                    wrapper, rt, fullDef, badgeLabel, onebookRenderRubyText, wordText
                );
            } else if (window.onebookRenderRubyText) {
                window.onebookRenderRubyText(rt, fullDef, badgeLabel);
            }
            if (isolator) isolator.classList.remove('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
            if (window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick) {
                window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick(rt, wrapper, fullGloss);
            }
        });
    }
    window.onebookUpgradeCollectedVocabularyStyles = onebookUpgradeCollectedVocabularyStyles;
    /** Update inline ruby text for every existing wrapper from a fresh payload (
 etc.). */
    function onebookRefreshExistingRubyDefinitions(wordsMap) {
        if (!wordsMap || typeof wordsMap !== 'object') return;
        var containers = document.querySelectorAll('.ob-ruby-container');
        containers.forEach(function(wrapper) {
            var wordText = onebookRubyContainerWordText(wrapper);
            if (!wordText) return;
            var data = wordsMap[wordText.toLowerCase()];
            if (!data) return;
            var rt = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text');
            if (!rt) return;
            var wordNode = onebookRubyContainerWordTextNode(wrapper);
            var resolved = onebookResolveMatchDisplay(data, wordNode, 0);
            var fullDef = resolved.definition || (typeof data.definition === 'string' ? data.definition : '');
            if (!fullDef) return;
            if (window.onebookSimplifyRubyInlineDefinition) {
                fullDef = window.onebookSimplifyRubyInlineDefinition(fullDef);
            }
            if (!fullDef) return;
            var fullGloss = onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload(data);
            rt.dataset.fullText = fullDef;
            if (fullGloss) {
                rt.dataset.fullGlossary = fullGloss;
            } else {
                delete rt.dataset.fullGlossary;
            }
            var badgeLabel = (resolved.badgeCount && resolved.badgeCount > 0)
                ? ((resolved.badgeCount > 99) ? '99+' : String(resolved.badgeCount))
                : null;
            var isolator = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text-isolator');
            if (window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout) {
                window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout(
                    wrapper, rt, fullDef, badgeLabel, onebookRenderRubyText, wordText
                );
            } else if (window.onebookRenderRubyText) {
                window.onebookRenderRubyText(rt, fullDef, badgeLabel);
            }
            if (isolator) isolator.classList.remove('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
            if (window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick) {
                window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick(rt, wrapper, fullGloss);
            }
        });
    }
    window.onebookRefreshExistingRubyDefinitions = onebookRefreshExistingRubyDefinitions;
    function onebookUnwrapRubyContainer(wrapper) {
        if (!wrapper) return;
        var parent = wrapper.parentNode;
        if (!parent) return;
        var text = onebookRubyContainerWordText(wrapper);
        if (!text) return;
        parent.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(text), wrapper);
        parent.normalize();
    }
    function onebookApplyLevelClasses(wrapper, levelToken) {
        if (!wrapper) return;
        var remove = [];
        wrapper.classList.forEach(function(cls) {
            if (cls.indexOf('level-') === 0) remove.push(cls);
        });
        remove.forEach(function(cls) { wrapper.classList.remove(cls); });
        if (!levelToken) return;
        var tokens = String(levelToken)
            .split('|')
            .map(function(token) { return token.trim().toLowerCase(); })
            .filter(function(token) { return token.length > 0; });
        if (tokens.indexOf('user-marked') >= 0) {
            wrapper.classList.add('level-user-marked');
        } else {
            tokens.forEach(function(token) {
                wrapper.classList.add('level-' + token);
            });
        }
    }
    function onebookFindRubyContainersForWord(wordKey) {
        var key = (wordKey || '').toLowerCase();
        if (!key) return [];
        var found = [];
        document.querySelectorAll('.ob-ruby-container').forEach(function(wrapper) {
            var wt = onebookRubyContainerWordText(wrapper);
            if (wt && wt.toLowerCase() === key) found.push(wrapper);
        });
        return found;
    }
    function onebookIsAutoGradedLevelToken(levelToken) {
        var tokens = String(levelToken || '')
            .split('|')
            .map(function(token) { return token.trim().toLowerCase(); })
            .filter(function(token) { return token.length > 0; });
        for (var i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            if (tokens[i] === 'a1' || tokens[i] === 'a2' || tokens[i] === 'b1' ||
                tokens[i] === 'b2' || tokens[i] === 'c1' || tokens[i] === 'c2') {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    /** Single-word refresh after save/unsave: restore CEFR, keep collected, or unwrap. */
    function onebookReconcileWordAnnotationStyle(wordKey, data) {
        var key = (wordKey || '').toLowerCase();
        if (!key) return;
        var containers = onebookFindRubyContainersForWord(key);
        if (!data) {
            containers.forEach(onebookUnwrapRubyContainer);
            return;
        }
        if (!containers.length) {
            var singlePayload = {};
            singlePayload[key] = data;
            if (window.drawWordAnnotations) {
                window.drawWordAnnotations(JSON.stringify(singlePayload), true);
            }
            return;
        }
        containers.forEach(function(wrapper) {
            var level = onebookPayloadLevelToken(data).toLowerCase();
            if (!level) {
                onebookUnwrapRubyContainer(wrapper);
                return;
            }
            onebookApplyLevelClasses(wrapper, level);
            var wordNode = onebookRubyContainerWordTextNode(wrapper);
            var resolved = onebookResolveMatchDisplay(data, wordNode, 0);
            var fullDef = resolved.definition || (typeof data.definition === 'string' ? data.definition : '');
            var fullGloss = onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload(data);
            var wordText = onebookRubyContainerWordText(wrapper);
            var rt = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text');
            var isCollected = level.indexOf('user-marked') >= 0;
            var isGraded = onebookIsAutoGradedLevelToken(level);
            var badgeLabel = null;
            if (isCollected && resolved.badgeCount > 0) {
                badgeLabel = (resolved.badgeCount > 99) ? '99+' : String(resolved.badgeCount);
            } else if (rt) {
                onebookSetRubyBadge(rt, 0);
            }
            if (!fullDef) {
                fullDef = wordText || '';
            }
            if (!fullDef) {
                if (isCollected) return;
                if (isGraded) return;
                onebookUnwrapRubyContainer(wrapper);
                return;
            }
            if (rt) {
                rt.dataset.fullText = fullDef;
                if (fullGloss) rt.dataset.fullGlossary = fullGloss;
                if (window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout) {
                    window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout(
                        wrapper, rt, fullDef, badgeLabel, onebookRenderRubyText, wordText
                    );
                } else {
                    onebookRenderRubyText(rt, fullDef, badgeLabel);
                }
                if (window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick) {
                    window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick(rt, wrapper, fullGloss);
                }
            }
        });
    }
    window.onebookReconcileWordAnnotationStyle = onebookReconcileWordAnnotationStyle;
    function onebookUpdateExistingVocabularyBadges(wordsMap) {
        if (!wordsMap || typeof wordsMap !== 'object') return;
        var containers = document.querySelectorAll('.ob-ruby-container');
        containers.forEach(function(wrapper) {
            if (window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer &&
                !window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer(wrapper)) {
                return;
            }
            var wordText = '';
            for (var ci = 0; ci < wrapper.childNodes.length; ci++) {
                var ch = wrapper.childNodes[ci];
                if (ch.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                    wordText = (ch.nodeValue || '').trim();
                    if (wordText) break;
                }
            }
            if (!wordText) return;
            var data = wordsMap[wordText.toLowerCase()];
            if (!data) return;
            var wordNode = onebookRubyContainerWordTextNode(wrapper);
            var resolved = onebookResolveMatchDisplay(data, wordNode, 0);
            var rt = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text');
            if (!rt) return;
            var nextDef = resolved.definition || (typeof data.definition === 'string' ? data.definition : '');
            if (nextDef) {
                rt.dataset.fullText = nextDef;
                var nextGloss = onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload(data);
                if (nextGloss) rt.dataset.fullGlossary = nextGloss;
            }
            onebookSetRubyBadge(rt, resolved.badgeCount);
            if (window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout && rt.dataset.fullText) {
                var wordTextNode = '';
                for (var ci2 = 0; ci2 < wrapper.childNodes.length; ci2++) {
                    var ch2 = wrapper.childNodes[ci2];
                    if (ch2.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                        wordTextNode = (ch2.nodeValue || '').trim();
                        if (wordTextNode) break;
                    }
                }
                var badgeLabel = (resolved.badgeCount && resolved.badgeCount > 0)
                    ? ((resolved.badgeCount > 99) ? '99+' : String(resolved.badgeCount))
                    : null;
                window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout(
                    wrapper,
                    rt,
                    rt.dataset.fullText,
                    badgeLabel,
                    onebookRenderRubyText,
                    wordTextNode
                );
            } else if (window.onebookClampRubyIsolator) {
                window.onebookClampRubyIsolator(wrapper);
            }
        });
    }
    function onebookRubyHorizontalBounds(wrapper) {
        var margin = 6;
        var vw = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 320;
        var boundsLeft = margin;
        var boundsRight = vw - margin;
        if (!wrapper) {
            return { left: boundsLeft, right: boundsRight, width: boundsRight - boundsLeft };
        }
        var block = onebookAnnotationFindBlock(wrapper);
        if (block) {
            var br = block.getBoundingClientRect();
            var st = window.getComputedStyle(block);
            var padL = parseFloat(st.paddingLeft) || 0;
            var padR = parseFloat(st.paddingRight) || 0;
            if (br.width > 0) {
                boundsLeft = Math.max(boundsLeft, br.left + padL + margin);
                boundsRight = Math.min(boundsRight, br.right - padR - margin);
            }
        }
        var width = boundsRight - boundsLeft;
        if (width < 48) {
            boundsLeft = margin;
            boundsRight = vw - margin;
            width = boundsRight - boundsLeft;
        }
        return { left: boundsLeft, right: boundsRight, width: width };
    }
    function onebookMeasureWordWidth(wordText, wrapper) {
        if (wrapper) {
            var wr = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (wr.width > 0) return wr.width;
        }
        if (!wordText) return 0;
        if (!window.obCanvasCtx) {
            var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            if (canvas && typeof canvas.getContext === 'function') {
                window.obCanvasCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            }
        }
        var ctx = window.obCanvasCtx;
        if (!ctx || typeof ctx.measureText !== 'function') {
            return wordText.length * 8;
        }
        var bodyEl = document.body || document.documentElement;
        var bodyStyle = window.getComputedStyle(bodyEl);
        var bodyFontSize = parseFloat(bodyStyle.fontSize) || 16;
        ctx.font = (bodyStyle.fontWeight || 'normal') + ' ' + bodyFontSize + 'px ' + (bodyStyle.fontFamily || 'sans-serif');
        return ctx.measureText(wordText).width;
    }
    function onebookMeasureRubyTextWidth(text, badgeText) {
        if (!window.obCanvasCtx) {
            var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            if (canvas && typeof canvas.getContext === 'function') {
                window.obCanvasCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            }
        }
        var ctx = window.obCanvasCtx;
        if (!ctx || typeof ctx.measureText !== 'function') {
            return (text || '').length * 8;
        }
        var rootStyle = window.getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
        var bodyEl = document.body || document.documentElement;
        var bodyStyle = window.getComputedStyle(bodyEl);
        var rootFontSize = parseFloat(rootStyle.fontSize) || 16;
        var rtFontSize = rootFontSize * 0.55;
        ctx.font = rtFontSize + "px " + (bodyStyle.fontFamily || 'sans-serif');
        var width = ctx.measureText(text || '').width;
        if (badgeText) {
            width += rtFontSize * 1.4;
        }
        return width;
    }
    function onebookTruncateRubyDefinition(fullDef, maxWidth, badgeText) {
        if (!fullDef) return '';
        if (onebookMeasureRubyTextWidth(fullDef, badgeText) <= maxWidth) {
            return fullDef;
        }
        var low = 2;
        var high = fullDef.length;
        var best = 2;
        while (low <= high) {
            var mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
            var candidate = fullDef.substring(0, mid) + '..';
            if (onebookMeasureRubyTextWidth(candidate, badgeText) <= maxWidth) {
                best = mid;
                low = mid + 1;
            } else {
                high = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return fullDef.substring(0, Math.max(2, best)) + '..';
    }
    function onebookClampRubyIsolator(wrapper) {
        if (!wrapper) return;
        var isolator = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text-isolator');
        if (!isolator) return;
        isolator.style.left = '50%';
        isolator.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
        var bounds = onebookRubyHorizontalBounds(wrapper);
        var ir = isolator.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (ir.width <= 0) return;
        var wr = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
        var center = (wr.left + wr.right) / 2;
        var half = ir.width / 2;
        var left = center - half;
        var right = center + half;
        if (left < bounds.left) {
            left = bounds.left;
            right = left + ir.width;
        }
        if (right > bounds.right) {
            right = bounds.right;
            left = right - ir.width;
        }
        if (left < bounds.left) {
            left = bounds.left;
        }
        var offset = left + half - center;
        if (Math.abs(offset) > 0.5) {
            isolator.style.transform = 'translateX(calc(-50% + ' + offset + 'px))';
        }
    }
    window.onebookClampRubyIsolator = onebookClampRubyIsolator;
    function onebookPrepareRubyDisplay(fullDef, wordText, badgeText, wrapper) {
        if (!fullDef) {
            return { displayText: '', truncated: false, marginLeft: 0, marginRight: 0, maxWidth: 24 };
        }
        var wordWidth = onebookMeasureWordWidth(wordText, wrapper);
        if (wordWidth <= 0) wordWidth = Math.max(24, (wordText || '').length * 8);
        var rtFullWidth = onebookMeasureRubyTextWidth(fullDef, badgeText);
        var maxWidth = wordWidth;
        if (rtFullWidth > wordWidth * 1.2) {
            var fitted = onebookTruncateRubyDefinition(fullDef, wordWidth, badgeText);
            return {
                displayText: fitted,
                truncated: true,
                marginLeft: 0,
                marginRight: 0,
                maxWidth: maxWidth
            };
        }
        var marginLeft = 0;
        var marginRight = 0;
        if (rtFullWidth > wordWidth) {
            var extraSpace = (rtFullWidth - wordWidth) / 2;
            marginLeft = extraSpace;
            marginRight = extraSpace;
        }
        return {
            displayText: fullDef,
            truncated: false,
            marginLeft: marginLeft,
            marginRight: marginRight,
            maxWidth: maxWidth
        };
    }
    window.onebookPrepareRubyDisplay = onebookPrepareRubyDisplay;
    function onebookGetRubyDisplayText(rt) {
        if (!rt) return '';
        var clone = rt.cloneNode(true);
        var badge = clone.querySelector('.vocab-badge');
        if (badge) badge.remove();
        return (clone.textContent || '').trim();
    }
    function onebookApplyRubyLayout(wrapper, rt, prep, badgeText, renderRubyTextFn) {
        if (!wrapper || !rt || !prep || !renderRubyTextFn) return;
        var isolator = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text-isolator');
        if (!isolator) return;
        wrapper.style.marginLeft = '';
        wrapper.style.marginRight = '';
        rt.style.maxWidth = prep.maxWidth + 'px';
        isolator.style.maxWidth = prep.maxWidth + 'px';
        rt.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        rt.style.textOverflow = 'ellipsis';
        var currentText = onebookGetRubyDisplayText(rt);
        if (currentText !== prep.displayText) {
            renderRubyTextFn(rt, prep.displayText, badgeText);
        }
        if (prep.truncated) {
            rt.dataset.truncatedText = prep.displayText;
            rt.classList.add('ob-ruby-truncated');
        } else {
            rt.classList.remove('ob-ruby-truncated');
            delete rt.dataset.truncatedText;
            if (prep.marginLeft > 0) {
                wrapper.style.marginLeft = prep.marginLeft + 'px';
                wrapper.style.marginRight = prep.marginRight + 'px';
            }
        }
        onebookClampRubyIsolator(wrapper);
    }
    function onebookFinalizeRubyLayout(wrapper, rt, fullDef, badgeText, renderRubyTextFn, wordText) {
        if (!wrapper || !rt || !renderRubyTextFn) return;
        var text = fullDef || rt.dataset.fullText || wordText || '';
        var isolator = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text-isolator');
        if (!text) {
            if (isolator) isolator.classList.remove('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
            return;
        }
        if (document.__onebookPDFExportFullChapter) {
            renderRubyTextFn(rt, text, badgeText);
            if (isolator) {
                isolator.classList.remove('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
            }
            return;
        }
        var prep = onebookPrepareRubyDisplay(text, wordText, badgeText, wrapper);
        onebookApplyRubyLayout(wrapper, rt, prep, badgeText, renderRubyTextFn);
        if (isolator) isolator.classList.remove('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
    }
    window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout = onebookFinalizeRubyLayout;
    window.onebookFinalizeAllRubyForPDFExport = function() {
        if (!document.__onebookPDFExportFullChapter) return;
        var wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.ob-ruby-container');
        wrappers.forEach(function(wrapper) {
            var isolator = wrapper.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text-isolator');
            var rt = isolator ? isolator.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text') : null;
            if (!isolator || !rt) return;
            var badgeEl = rt.querySelector('.vocab-badge');
            var badgeText = badgeEl ? badgeEl.textContent : null;
            var wordText = '';
            for (var i = 0; i < wrapper.childNodes.length; i++) {
                var child = wrapper.childNodes[i];
                if (child.nodeType === 3) {
                    wordText += child.nodeValue || '';
                }
            }
            wordText = wordText.trim();
            if (window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout && rt.dataset.fullText) {
                window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout(
                    wrapper,
                    rt,
                    rt.dataset.fullText,
                    badgeText,
                    window.onebookRenderRubyText,
                    wordText
                );
            } else {
                isolator.classList.remove('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
            }
        });
    };            /** Short inline ruby label (width-limited); separate from full glossary bubble content. */
    function onebookSimplifyRubyInlineDefinition(definition) {
        var original = definition || "";
        var def = original;
        if (def.indexOf(';') !== -1) {
            def = def.split(';')[0];
        }
        var newline = String.fromCharCode(10);
        var literalNewline = String.fromCharCode(92) + 'n';
        def = def.split(literalNewline)[0];
        var lineParts = def.split(newline);
        def = '';
        for (var li = 0; li < lineParts.length; li++) {
            var candidate = (lineParts[li] || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
            if (candidate) {
                def = candidate;
                break;
            }
        }
        def = def.replace(/\n/g, ' ').replace(/\r/g, ' ');
        try {
            // Keep POS + optional IPA prefix; only trim long comma-separated gloss tails.
            var parts = def.match(/^((?:[a-z]+\.\s*)?(?:\/[^\/]+\/\s*|\[[^\]]+\]\s*)?)(.*)/i);
            if (parts && parts[2]) {
                var prefix = parts[1] || "";
                var content = parts[2];
                var defs = content.split(/[,
]/);
                if (defs.length > 2) {
                    def = prefix + defs.slice(0, 2).join(',');
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        // Never blank out a non-empty source (e.g. bad split on ";"/newlines).
        return def || original;
    }
    window.onebookSimplifyRubyInlineDefinition = onebookSimplifyRubyInlineDefinition;
    
    /** Normalize dictionary newlines for bubble display (`white-space: pre-line`). */
    function onebookNormalizeGlossaryNewlines(text) {
        if (text == null || text === undefined) return '';
        var s = String(text);
        var nl = String.fromCharCode(10);
        var cr = String.fromCharCode(13);
        var literalBackslashN = String.fromCharCode(92) + 'n';
        var literalBackslashR = String.fromCharCode(92) + 'r';
        while (s.indexOf(literalBackslashN) >= 0) {
            s = s.split(literalBackslashN).join(nl);
        }
        while (s.indexOf(literalBackslashR) >= 0) {
            s = s.split(literalBackslashR).join('');
        }
        s = s.split(cr + nl).join(nl);
        s = s.split(cr).join(nl);
        return s;
    }
    function onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload(data) {
        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return '';
        if (data.fullGlossary) return String(data.fullGlossary);
        if (data.raw_translation) return String(data.raw_translation);
        if (data.raw_definition_en) return String(data.raw_definition_en);
        return '';
    }
    window.onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload = onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload;
    function onebookDismissRubyGlossaryBubble() {
        var pd = window.parent && window.parent.document ? window.parent.document : document;
        var bubble = pd.getElementById('ob-active-bubble');
        if (bubble) bubble.remove();
        if (window.closeObBubble) {
            pd.removeEventListener('click', window.closeObBubble, true);
            pd.removeEventListener('touchstart', window.closeObBubble, true);
            document.removeEventListener('click', window.closeObBubble, false);
            document.removeEventListener('touchstart', window.closeObBubble, false);
            window.closeObBubble = null;
        }
    }
    function onebookPositionRubyGlossaryBubble(bubble, arrow, rtEl, wrapperEl) {
        var pd = window.parent.document;
        var pw = window.parent;
        var margin = 24, topSafe = 50, bottomSafe = 20, gap = 5;
        var vw = pw.innerWidth;
        var vh = pw.innerHeight;
        var fe = window.frameElement;
        var iframeScale = 1;
        var iframeRect = { left: 0, top: 0 };
        if (fe) {
            try {
                iframeRect = fe.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (fe.offsetWidth > 0) {
                    iframeScale = iframeRect.width / fe.offsetWidth;
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        var w2 = wrapperEl;
        var br = bubble.getBoundingClientRect();
        var wr = w2.getBoundingClientRect();
        var wcx = wr.left * iframeScale + iframeRect.left + wr.width * iframeScale / 2;
        var wt = wr.top * iframeScale + iframeRect.top;
        var wb = wr.bottom * iframeScale + iframeRect.top;
        var left = Math.max(margin, Math.min(wcx - br.width / 2, vw - br.width - margin - 2));
        bubble.style.left = left + 'px';
        arrow.style.left = Math.max(6, Math.min(wcx - left, br.width - 6)) + 'px';
        arrow.style.transform = 'none';
        var bubbleBelow = false;
        var ft = wt - br.height - gap;
        if (ft < topSafe) {
            ft = wb + gap;
            if (wb + gap + br.height <= vh - bottomSafe) {
                bubbleBelow = true;
            } else {
                ft = topSafe;
            }
        }
        if (!bubbleBelow) {
            arrow.style.bottom = '-6px';
            arrow.style.top = 'auto';
            arrow.style.borderTop = '6px solid #ffffff';
            arrow.style.borderBottom = 'none';
        } else {
            arrow.style.top = '-6px';
            arrow.style.bottom = 'auto';
            arrow.style.borderTop = 'none';
            arrow.style.borderBottom = '6px solid #ffffff';
        }
        if (!bubbleBelow) {
            if (ft + br.height > wt - 2) ft = wt - 2 - br.height;
            if (ft < topSafe) ft = topSafe;
        } else {
            if (ft < wb + 2) ft = wb + 2;
            var mt = vh - bottomSafe - br.height;
            if (ft > mt) ft = Math.max(topSafe, mt);
        }
        bubble.style.top = ft + 'px';
        bubble.style.opacity = '1';
        bubble.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
    }
    function onebookShowRubyGlossaryBubble(rtEl, wrapperEl, glossaryText) {

            if (b && !b.contains(ev.target)) {
                onebookDismissRubyGlossaryBubble();

        };
        setTimeout(function() {
            pd.addEventListener('click', window.closeObBubble, true);
            pd.addEventListener('touchstart', window.closeObBubble, true);
            document.addEventListener('click', window.closeObBubble, false);
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', window.closeObBubble, false);
        }, 50);
    }
    window.onebookShowRubyGlossaryBubble = onebookShowRubyGlossaryBubble;
    function onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick(rtEl, wrapperEl, glossaryText) {
        if (!rtEl || !wrapperEl) return;
        var full = onebookNormalizeGlossaryNewlines(glossaryText || rtEl.dataset.fullGlossary || '');
        if (!full.trim()) {
            rtEl.classList.remove('ob-ruby-has-glossary');
            rtEl._hasGlossaryBubble = false;
            rtEl.onclick = null;
            return;
        }
        rtEl.dataset.fullGlossary = full;
        rtEl.classList.add('ob-ruby-has-glossary');
        rtEl._hasGlossaryBubble = true;
        rtEl.onclick = function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            e.preventDefault();
            onebookShowRubyGlossaryBubble(rtEl, wrapperEl, full);
        };
    }
    window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick = onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick;
    
    // Incremental inject: existing annotated nodes are skipped by the scanner below.
    // Refresh definitions + badges in place (format changes must update CEFR and collected).
    if (skipClean) {
        onebookUpgradeCollectedVocabularyStyles(words);
        if (window.onebookRefreshExistingRubyDefinitions) {
            window.onebookRefreshExistingRubyDefinitions(words);
        }
        onebookUpdateExistingVocabularyBadges(words);
    }
    // Foliate only: restrict scanning to the visible page when foliate-js has stored a page range.
    // EPUB3 reader has no __foliateCurrentPageRange 
 scan the full chapter instead.
    // PDF export sets __onebookPDFExportFullChapter to force a full-chapter scan.
    var pageRange = document.__onebookPDFExportFullChapter
        ? null
        : (document.__foliateCurrentPageRange || null);
    // cleanAnnotations() unwraps ruby nodes and detaches / invalidates Foliate page Ranges.
    // Never reuse pageRange after a full clean 
 intersectsNode would skip every node and
    // leave the page blank (often noticed first on collected-word restyle).
    if (!skipClean) {
        pageRange = null;
    }
    
    // XML/XHTML chapters may not expose `document.body` as expected in some WebKit paths.
    // Fall back to documentElement and skip safely if neither is available.
    var walkRoot = document.body || document.documentElement;
    if (!walkRoot || !(walkRoot instanceof Node)) {
        console.log("JS: drawWordAnnotations skipped (no valid walk root)");
        return;
    }
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(walkRoot, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
    var node;
    var allMatches = [];
    
    while(node = walker.nextNode()) {
        var parent = node.parentNode;
        if (!parent || parent.nodeType !== 1) continue;
        if (parent.tagName === 'SCRIPT' || 
            parent.tagName === 'STYLE' || 
            parent.tagName === 'RT' || 
            parent.tagName === 'RP' ||
            parent.classList.contains('ob-ruby-container') ||
            parent.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text') ||
            parent.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text-isolator') ||
            parent.classList.contains('vocab-wrapper')) continue;
            
        // Foliate: skip text nodes outside the visible page range.
        if (pageRange && !pageRange.intersectsNode(node)) continue;
            
        var text = node.nodeValue;
        pattern.lastIndex = 0; 
        
        var nodeMatches = [];
        var match;
        while ((match = pattern.exec(text)) !== null) {
            if (window.onebookHasWordBoundaries &&
                !window.onebookHasWordBoundaries(text, match.index, match[0].length)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            var data = words[match[0].toLowerCase()];
            var resolved = onebookResolveMatchDisplay(data, node, match.index);
            nodeMatches.push({
                index: match.index,
                length: match[0].length,
                word: match[0],
                definition: resolved.definition,
                fullGlossary: onebookResolveFullGlossaryFromPayload(data),
                level: resolved.level,
                badgeCount: resolved.badgeCount
            });
        }
        if (nodeMatches.length > 0) {
            allMatches.push({node: node, matches: nodeMatches});
        }
    }            
    allMatches.forEach(function(item) {
        var node = item.node;
        var matches = item.matches;
        var text = node.nodeValue;
        var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
        var lastIndex = 0;
        
        matches.forEach(function(m) {
            if (m.index < lastIndex) return;
            
            if (m.index > lastIndex) {
                fragment.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.substring(lastIndex, m.index)));
            }
            
            // Create Span Wrapper instead of Ruby
            var wrapper = document.createElement('span');

            if (m.level) {
                // Collected vocabulary outranks CEFR: when user-marked is present, skip CEFR level classes.
                var tokens = String(m.level)
                    .split('|')
                    .map(function(token) { return token.trim().toLowerCase(); })
                    .filter(function(token) { return token.length > 0; });
                if (tokens.indexOf('user-marked') >= 0) {
                    wrapper.classList.add('level-user-marked');
                } else {
                    tokens.forEach(function(token) {
                        wrapper.classList.add('level-' + token);
                    });
                }
            }
            wrapper.appendChild(document.createTextNode(m.word));
            
            // Click Handler for AI Analysis (saved vocab deferred so double-tap-to-read can cancel)
            wrapper.onclick = function(e) {
                // If inside a favorite phrase, let the event bubble to the phrase handler
                if (this.closest('.favorite-phrase, .favorite-phrase-underline, .favorite-phrase-highlight-only')) {
                    return;
                }
                e.stopPropagation();
                e.preventDefault();
                if (window.clickAction === 'none') {
                    return;
                }
                var self = this;
                var wordText = m.word;
                var isSavedVocabRuby = (window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer && window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer(self));
                function fireAnnotWordClick() {
                    if (window.onebookShouldIgnoreDeferredWordClick && window.onebookShouldIgnoreDeferredWordClick()) return;
                    if (window.clickAction === 'none') return;
                    if (window.clearActiveWords) {
                        window.clearActiveWords();
                    }
                    var rt = self.querySelector('.ob-ruby-text');
                    if (rt) {
                        // Saved vocab may wait on contextual AI; mirror new-word feedback
                        // (cache hits clear Analyzing... almost immediately via clearActiveWords).
                        if (isSavedVocabRuby || window.clickAction === 'pronounceAndCollect') {
                            self.classList.add('onebook-analyzing');
                            rt.dataset.originalText = rt.innerText;
                            rt.innerText = 'Analyzing...';
                        } else {
                            self.classList.add('onebook-active');
                        }
                    }
                    var block = (window.onebookFindSentenceBlock && window.onebookFindSentenceBlock(self))
                        || self.closest('p, li, blockquote, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, div');
                    var context = '';
                    if (block && window.getSentenceFromBlock) {
                        context = window.getSentenceFromBlock(block, self) || '';
                    }
                    if (!context && block) {
                        try {
                            var clone = block.cloneNode(true);
                            clone.querySelectorAll(
                                '.ob-ruby-text, .ob-ruby-text-isolator, .vocab-badge, rt, rp'
                            ).forEach(function(n) { n.remove(); });
                            context = (clone.innerText || clone.textContent || '')
                                .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                                .trim();
                        } catch (ctxErr) {
                            context = '';
                        }
                    }
                    if (!context) context = wordText;
                    if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers) {
                        if (window.clickAction !== 'favoriteOnly' && window.clickAction !== 'none' && window.webkit.messageHandlers.speechHandler) {
                            window.webkit.messageHandlers.speechHandler.postMessage(wordText);
                        }
                        if (window.clickAction !== 'none' && window.webkit.messageHandlers.aiAnalysisHandler) {
                            window.webkit.messageHandlers.aiAnalysisHandler.postMessage({
                                word: wordText,
                                context: context,
                                isCollected: !!isSavedVocabRuby
                            });
                        } else if (window.clickAction !== 'none') {
                            try {
                                var report = { type: 'aiAnalysis', word: wordText, text: wordText, context: context };
                                if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
                                    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'foliate-webkit-report', payload: report }, '*');
                                }
                            } catch (postErr) {}
                        }
                    } else if (window.clickAction !== 'none') {
                        try {
                            var report2 = { type: 'aiAnalysis', word: wordText, text: wordText, context: context };
                            if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) {
                                window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'foliate-webkit-report', payload: report2 }, '*');
                            }
                        } catch (postErr2) {}
                    }
                }
                if (!isSavedVocabRuby) {
                    fireAnnotWordClick();
                    return;
                }
                if (window.onebookShouldIgnoreDeferredWordClick && window.onebookShouldIgnoreDeferredWordClick()) {

                    clearTimeout(window.__onebookAnnotClickTimeout);
                }
                var deferMs = window.__onebookAnnotClickDeferMs || 400;
                window.__onebookAnnotClickTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                    if (clickGen !== window.__onebookAnnotClickGen) return;
                    fireAnnotWordClick();
                }, deferMs);
            };
            // Simplify definition text for inline ruby (full glossary is shown via bubble).
            var def = window.onebookSimplifyRubyInlineDefinition
                ? window.onebookSimplifyRubyInlineDefinition(m.definition || "")
                : (m.definition || "");
            var fullGlossary = m.fullGlossary || "";

            //    This isolator inherits from the container (which has CEFR color etc.)
            //    but we will immediately reset ALL its visual properties to block inheritance.
            //    The ruby text inside the isolator only sees the isolator's computed styles.
            var isolator = document.createElement('span');
            isolator.className = 'ob-ruby-text-isolator';
            // Force ALL visual properties to initial values to block CSS inheritance.
            // Layout properties (display, position, bottom, left, transform) are set
            // separately below for proper positioning.
            // Layout only

            isolator.style.cssText = [

                'left', '50%',
                'transform', 'translateX(-50%)',
                'width', 'max-content',
                'max-width', '50vw',
                'z-index', '10'
            ].map(function(v, i, a) {
                return i % 2 === 0 ? v + ': ' + a[i+1] + ' !important' : '';
            }).filter(function(s) { return s; }).join('; ');
            
            // 2. Create ruby text INSIDE the isolator.
            //    The isolator resets all inherited properties, so the ruby text
            //    gets NONE of the container's CEFR colors, collection borders, etc.
            var rt = document.createElement('span');
            rt.className = 'ob-ruby-text';
            // Set ALL non-layout visual properties as inline styles with !important
            // to guarantee plain-text rendering.
            rt.style.cssText = [
                'color: #666 !important',
                'font-weight: normal !important',
                'font-style: normal !important',
                'font-size: 0.45rem !important',
                'text-decoration: none !important',
                'border: none !important',
                'background: transparent !important',
                'box-shadow: none !important',
                'text-shadow: none !important',
                'outline: none !important',
                'text-indent: 0 !important',
                'letter-spacing: normal !important',
                'word-spacing: normal !important',
                'text-transform: none !important',
                'line-height: 1.0 !important',
                'text-align: center !important',
                'white-space: nowrap !important',
                'overflow: hidden !important',
                'text-overflow: ellipsis !important',
                'max-width: 50vw !important',
                'pointer-events: auto !important',
                'user-select: none !important',
                '-webkit-user-select: none !important',
                'display: inline !important',
                'visibility: visible !important',
                'opacity: 1 !important'
            ].join('; ');
            
            rt.dataset.fullText = def;
            if (fullGlossary) {
                rt.dataset.fullGlossary = fullGlossary;
            }
            
            var badgeText = (m.badgeCount && m.badgeCount > 0)
                ? ((m.badgeCount > 99) ? '99+' : String(m.badgeCount))
                : null;
            var renderRubyText = onebookRenderRubyText;
            var prep = window.onebookPrepareRubyDisplay
                ? window.onebookPrepareRubyDisplay(def, m.word, badgeText, null)
                : { displayText: def, truncated: false, marginLeft: 0, marginRight: 0, maxWidth: 50 };
            // Avoid flash: hide until layout is finalized with accurate DOM measurements.
            if (!document.__onebookPDFExportFullChapter) {
                isolator.classList.add('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
            }
            rt.style.maxWidth = prep.maxWidth + 'px';
            isolator.style.maxWidth = prep.maxWidth + 'px';
            if (prep.marginLeft > 0) {
                wrapper.style.marginLeft = prep.marginLeft + 'px';
                wrapper.style.marginRight = prep.marginRight + 'px';
            }
            renderRubyText(rt, prep.displayText, badgeText);
            if (prep.truncated) {
                rt.classList.add('ob-ruby-truncated');
                rt.dataset.truncatedText = prep.displayText;
            }
            isolator.appendChild(rt);
            wrapper.appendChild(isolator);
            
            // PDF export batch-finalizes after the full chapter scan; skip per-word timers.
            if (!document.__onebookPDFExportFullChapter) {
            // Edge clamping needs layout boxes; refine without swapping full
truncated text.
            (function(rtEl, wrapperEl, fullText, badgeTextValue, renderFn, wordTextValue, isolatorEl, glossaryText) {
                setTimeout(function() {
                    if (!wrapperEl.parentNode || !rtEl.parentNode) return;
                    if (window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout) {
                        window.onebookFinalizeRubyLayout(wrapperEl, rtEl, fullText, badgeTextValue, renderFn, wordTextValue);
                    }
                    isolatorEl.classList.remove('ob-ruby-layout-pending');
                    if (rtEl.scrollWidth > rtEl.clientWidth && !rtEl.dataset.truncatedText) {
                        rtEl.classList.add('ob-ruby-truncated');
                    }
                    if (window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick) {
                        window.onebookInstallRubyGlossaryClick(rtEl, wrapperEl, glossaryText);
                    }
                }, 0);
            })(rt, wrapper, def, badgeText, renderRubyText, m.word, isolator, fullGlossary);
            }
            
            fragment.appendChild(wrapper);
            lastIndex = m.index + m.length;
        });
        
        if (lastIndex < text.length) {
            fragment.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.substring(lastIndex)));
        }
        
        if (node.parentNode) {
            node.parentNode.replaceChild(fragment, node);
        }
    });
        
    // Re-apply phrases if we modified the DOM to ensure highlights sit correctly on top of/inside annotations
    if (allMatches.length > 0 && window.lastPhrasesJson && window.markPhrases) {
        window.markPhrases(window.lastPhrasesJson);
    }
    if (document.__onebookPDFExportFullChapter && window.onebookFinalizeAllRubyForPDFExport) {
        window.onebookFinalizeAllRubyForPDFExport();
    }
// --- Favorite Phrase Rendering ---
window.onebookWordAtFavoritePhraseClick = function(e, phraseSpan) {
    try {
        var t = e.target;
        if (t && t.nodeType === 3) t = t.parentElement;
        if (t && t.closest) {
            var ruby = t.closest('.ob-ruby-container, .vocab-wrapper');
            if (ruby) {
                var fromRuby = '';
                if (window.onebookRubyContainerWordText) {
                    fromRuby = window.onebookRubyContainerWordText(ruby) || '';
                }
                if (!fromRuby) fromRuby = (ruby.innerText || ruby.textContent || '').trim();
                fromRuby = (fromRuby || '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || '';
                if (fromRuby) return fromRuby;
            }
        }
        var range = null;
        if (document.caretRangeFromPoint) {
            range = document.caretRangeFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        } else if (document.caretPositionFromPoint) {
            var pos = document.caretPositionFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            if (pos && pos.offsetNode) {
                range = document.createRange();
                range.setStart(pos.offsetNode, pos.offset);
                range.collapse(true);
            }
        }
        if (!range || !range.startContainer || range.startContainer.nodeType !== 3) return '';
        var text = range.startContainer.nodeValue || '';
        var i = Math.min(Math.max(0, range.startOffset), text.length);
        var cjk = /[\u3400-\u9fff\uf900-\ufaff]/;
        if (i < text.length && cjk.test(text.charAt(i))) return text.charAt(i);
        if (i > 0 && cjk.test(text.charAt(i - 1))) return text.charAt(i - 1);
        var isWord = function(ch) { return /[A-Za-z0-9'
\-]/.test(ch); };
        var start = i, end = i;
        while (start > 0 && isWord(text.charAt(start - 1))) start--;
        while (end < text.length && isWord(text.charAt(end))) end++;
        return text.substring(start, end).replace(/^[
']+|[
']+$/g, '');
    } catch (err) {
        return '';
    }
window.onebookHostRectForFavoritePhraseClick = function(e) {
    var x = e.clientX, y = e.clientY, w = 40, h = 24;
    try {
        var t = e.target;
        if (t && t.nodeType === 3) t = t.parentElement;
        if (t && t.getBoundingClientRect) {
            var r = t.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.width > 0.5 && r.height > 0.5) {
                x = r.x; y = r.y; w = r.width; h = r.height;
            }
        }
        // Foliate marks run inside the content iframe 
 lift into host WKWebView space.
        var frame = window.frameElement;
        if (frame && frame.getBoundingClientRect) {
            var fr = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
            x += fr.x;
            y += fr.y;
        }
    } catch (err2) {}
    return { x: x, y: y, width: w, height: h };
window.cleanPhrases = function() {
     var existing = document.querySelectorAll('.favorite-phrase, .favorite-phrase-underline, .favorite-phrase-highlight, .favorite-phrase-highlight-only');
     existing.forEach(function(el) {
         var parent = el.parentNode;
         while (el.firstChild) {
             parent.insertBefore(el.firstChild, el);
         }
         parent.removeChild(el);
         parent.normalize();
     });
window.markPhrases = function(jsonString) {
     // console.log("JS: markPhrases called. Input length: " + (jsonString ? jsonString.length : "null"));
     // console.log("JS: Raw JSON length: " + (jsonString ? jsonString.length : 0));
     
     if (jsonString) window.lastPhrasesJson = jsonString;
     if (window.cleanPhrases) window.cleanPhrases();
     
     var phrases = [];
     try {
         phrases = JSON.parse(jsonString);
         // console.log("JS: Parsed phrases count: " + phrases.length);
     } catch(e) {
         console.error("JS: Error parsing phrase JSON: " + e);
         return;
     }
     // Sort by length desc to prioritize longer matches
     phrases.sort(function(a, b) { 
         if (!a.phrase || !b.phrase) return 0;
         return b.phrase.length - a.phrase.length; 
     });
     
     // Helper to escape regex special characters
     function escapeRegExp(string) {
         return string.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
     }
     // Create flexible regex pattern for smart quotes and whitespace
     function createFlexiblePattern(text) {
         var pattern = "";
         for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
             var char = text[i];
             if (/\s/.test(char)) {
                 pattern += "\\s+";
             } else if (['\'', '
', '
', '`', '
'].indexOf(char) !== -1) {
                 pattern += "['
             } else if (['"', '
', '
'].indexOf(char) !== -1) {
                 pattern += "[\"
             } else {
                 pattern += escapeRegExp(char);
             }
         }
         return pattern;
     }
     
     // Process each phrase sequentially
     phrases.forEach(function(phrase) {
         // Check if phrase is valid object and has phrase property
         if (!phrase || typeof phrase.phrase !== 'string' || phrase.phrase.length < 2) {
            // console.log("JS: Skipping invalid phrase");
            return;
         }
         console.log("JS: Processing phrase: '" + phrase.phrase.substring(0, 50) + "...'");
         
         // 1. Scan DOM to build full text and node mapping
         // We re-scan for each phrase to handle DOM mutations from previous highlights
         var nodeOffsets = [];
         var fullText = "";
         
         // Use a filter to skip scripts/styles efficiently
         var filter = {
             acceptNode: function(node) {
                 if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                     var tag = node.tagName;
                     if (tag === 'SCRIPT' || tag === 'STYLE' || tag === 'RT' || tag === 'RP') {
                    return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                }
                if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text')) {
                    return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                }
                     // Skip existing underlines to avoid nesting (treat as opaque or skip?)
                     // Better to skip content if it's already highlighted? 
                     // No, we might want overlapping highlights. 
                     // But for simplicity, let's allow traversing into them.
                 }
                 return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
             }
         };
         var walker = document.createTreeWalker(
             document.body, 
             NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT | NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, 
             filter, 
             false
         );
         var node;
         var blockTags = ['P','DIV','H1','H2','H3','H4','H5','H6','LI','BLOCKQUOTE','BR','HR'];
         
         while(node = walker.nextNode()) {
             if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                 // Insert spacer for block elements to prevent concatenation bugs
                 if (blockTags.indexOf(node.tagName) !== -1) {
                     fullText += "\n";
                 }
             } else if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                 // Skip whitespace-only nodes if they are just formatting?
                 // No, keep them to maintain fidelity.
                 
                 var val = node.nodeValue;
                 nodeOffsets.push({
                     node: node,
                     start: fullText.length,
                     length: val.length
                 });
                 fullText += val;
             }
         }
         
         // 2. Search for the phrase in full text
         var searchStr = phrase.phrase.trim();
         var patternStr = createFlexiblePattern(searchStr);
         var regex = new RegExp(patternStr, 'gi');
         
         var matches = [];
         var match;
         while ((match = regex.exec(fullText)) !== null) {
             var start = match.index;
             var end = start + match[0].length;
             console.log("JS: Found match for '" + phrase.phrase + "' at index " + start);
             matches.push({ start: start, end: end });
         }
         
         // 3. Apply highlights (Processing matches from end to start is safer if we were modifying indices, 
        // but here we rely on node references. Still good practice.)
        for (var i = matches.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            var m = matches[i];
            highlightRange(m.start, m.end, nodeOffsets, phrase.id, phrase.style, phrase.color);
        }
    });
    
    function highlightRange(start, end, nodeOffsets, phraseId, style, color) {
       // console.log("JS: highlightRange called for " + start + " to " + end);
       
       // Normalize style: legacy "underline" 
 dashed. Supported: solid|dashed|dotted|wavy|highlight.
       var rawStyle = (style || 'dashed').toString().toLowerCase();
       if (rawStyle === 'underline' || rawStyle === '') rawStyle = 'dashed';
       var isHighlight = rawStyle === 'highlight';
       var decorationStyle = isHighlight ? null : rawStyle;
       if (!isHighlight && decorationStyle !== 'solid' && decorationStyle !== 'dashed'
           && decorationStyle !== 'dotted' && decorationStyle !== 'wavy') {
           decorationStyle = 'dashed';
       }
       var colorName = color || 'yellow';
       var classSuffix = isHighlight ? 'highlight' : 'underline';
       
       var underlineColors = {
           'red': '#FF3B30',
           'orange': '#FF9500',
           'yellow': '#FFCC00',
           'green': '#34C759',
           'cyan': '#5AC8FA',
           'blue': '#007AFF',
           'purple': '#AF52DE'
       };
       var highlightColors = {
           'red': 'rgba(255, 59, 48, 0.3)',
           'orange': 'rgba(255, 149, 0, 0.3)',
           'yellow': 'rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.3)',
           'green': 'rgba(52, 199, 89, 0.3)',
           'cyan': 'rgba(90, 200, 250, 0.3)',
           'blue': 'rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.3)',
           'purple': 'rgba(175, 82, 222, 0.3)'
       };
       
       // Find which nodes contain the start and end of the match
       var startNodeIdx = -1;
       var endNodeIdx = -1;
       
       for (var i = 0; i < nodeOffsets.length; i++) {
           var n = nodeOffsets[i];
           var nEnd = n.start + n.length;
           
           if (start >= n.start && start < nEnd) startNodeIdx = i;
           if (end > n.start && end <= nEnd) endNodeIdx = i;
       }
       
       if (startNodeIdx === -1 || endNodeIdx === -1) {
           console.log("JS: Could not find start/end nodes for range " + start + "-" + end);
           return;
       }
       
       // Collect all text node chunks that need wrapping
       var chunksToWrap = [];
       
       for (var i = startNodeIdx; i <= endNodeIdx; i++) {
           var n = nodeOffsets[i];
           var nEnd = n.start + n.length;
           
           // Calculate intersection between [start, end] and [n.start, nEnd]
           var wrapStart = Math.max(start, n.start);
           var wrapEnd = Math.min(end, nEnd);
           
           if (wrapStart < wrapEnd) {
               chunksToWrap.push({
                   node: n.node,
                   start: wrapStart - n.start, // Relative offset within the node
                   end: wrapEnd - n.start
               });
           }
       }
       
       console.log("JS: Wrapping " + chunksToWrap.length + " chunks");
       // Apply wraps
       chunksToWrap.forEach(function(chunk) {
           try {
               var range = document.createRange();
               range.setStart(chunk.node, chunk.start);
               range.setEnd(chunk.node, chunk.end);
               
               var span = document.createElement('span');
               span.className = 'favorite-phrase-' + classSuffix;
               span.dataset.markStyle = isHighlight ? 'highlight' : decorationStyle;
               
               // Common styles
               span.style.textDecoration = 'none';
               span.style.cursor = 'pointer';
               span.style.position = 'relative';
               span.style.zIndex = '20';
               span.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
               span.style.lineHeight = 'inherit'; // Ensure it inherits line height from parent
               
               // Apply specific styles
              if (isHighlight) {
                  var bg = highlightColors[colorName] || highlightColors['yellow'];
                  // Avoid gradient backgrounds in paged mode.
                  // WKWebView multi-column layout can intermittently skip painting gradient-decorated spans.
                  span.style.background = 'none';
                  span.style.backgroundImage = 'none';
                  span.style.backgroundColor = bg;
                  span.style.padding = '0 1px';
                  span.style.borderRadius = '3px';
                  span.style.boxDecorationBreak = 'clone';
                  span.style.webkitBoxDecorationBreak = 'clone';
              } else {
                  // Use native text-decoration (solid/dashed/dotted/wavy).
                  // Avoids WKWebView multi-column paint glitches vs background-image underlines.
                  var stroke = underlineColors[colorName] || underlineColors['yellow'];
                  span.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
                  span.style.backgroundImage = 'none';
                  span.style.paddingBottom = '0';
                  span.style.textDecorationLine = 'underline';
                  span.style.textDecorationStyle = decorationStyle;
                  span.style.textDecorationColor = stroke;
                  span.style.textDecorationThickness = '2px';
                  span.style.textUnderlineOffset = '0.18em';
                  span.style.textDecorationSkipInk = 'none';
              }
               
               span.dataset.phraseId = phraseId;
                
                // Tap word inside mark 
 Swift chooser (phrase vs lookup).
                // Tap non-word (punctuation/gap) 
 open phrase analysis directly.
                span.onclick = function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    e.preventDefault();
                    var phraseIdLocal = span.dataset.phraseId || phraseId;
                    var contextText = (span.innerText || span.textContent || '').trim();
                    var word = window.onebookWordAtFavoritePhraseClick
                        ? window.onebookWordAtFavoritePhraseClick(e, span)
                        : '';
                    word = (word || '').trim();
                    function postPhraseOnly() {
                        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.phraseClickHandler) {
                            window.webkit.messageHandlers.phraseClickHandler.postMessage(phraseIdLocal);
                        }
                    }
                    if (!word) {
                        postPhraseOnly();
                        return;
                    }
                    var rect = window.onebookHostRectForFavoritePhraseClick
                        ? window.onebookHostRectForFavoritePhraseClick(e)
                        : { x: e.clientX - 20, y: e.clientY - 12, width: 40, height: 24 };
                    if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.favoritePhraseWordChoice) {
                        window.webkit.messageHandlers.favoritePhraseWordChoice.postMessage({
                            phraseId: phraseIdLocal,
                            word: word,
                            context: contextText,
                            rect: rect
                        });
                    } else {
                        postPhraseOnly();
                    }
                };
                
                // Use extractContents + insertNode for better stability with nested elements
                span.appendChild(range.extractContents());
                range.insertNode(span);
                
            } catch(e) {
                console.error("JS: Wrap error for phrase " + phraseId + ": " + e);
            }
        });
    }

              var span = document.createElement('span');

              span.style.backgroundColor = '#FFEB3B';
              range.surroundContents(span);
              span.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
              return true;
         }
     }
     return false;
var scrollTimeout;
var lastScrollTime = 0;
window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    window.updatePageTag();
    
    // Throttle updates to ~10fps for smooth UI updates without overloading bridge
    var now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastScrollTime > 100) {
        lastScrollTime = now;
        var scrollY = window.scrollY;
        var height = window.innerHeight;
        var docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
        var maxScroll = docHeight - height;
        var progress = maxScroll > 0 ? scrollY / maxScroll : 0;
        
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollPositionHandler) {
            window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollPositionHandler.postMessage(progress);
        }
    }
    
    clearTimeout(scrollTimeout);
    scrollTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
        var scrollY = window.scrollY;
        var height = window.innerHeight;
        var docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
        var maxScroll = docHeight - height;
        var progress = maxScroll > 0 ? scrollY / maxScroll : 0;
        
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollPositionHandler) {
            window.webkit.messageHandlers.scrollPositionHandler.postMessage(progress);
        }
    }, 200);
// --- Scroll To ---
window.scrollToProgress = function(progress) {
     var height = window.innerHeight;
     var docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
     var maxScroll = docHeight - height;
     if (maxScroll > 0) {
         window.scrollTo(0, progress * maxScroll);
     }
