// --- Play From Here (Visible Text) ---
window.getVisibleText = function() {
    // 1. Find scroll container
    var container = window.findMainScrollContainer ? window.findMainScrollContainer() : (document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement);
    
    // 2. Select potential text blocks
    // We select common block elements containing text
    var elements = document.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, div');
    function isLikelyPageArtifact(el) {
        var t = (el.innerText || '').trim();
        if (t.length <= 4 && /^\d+$/.test(t)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    function isWrapperContainer(el) {
        if (!el || el.tagName !== 'DIV') return false;
        var inner = el.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, div');
        for (var j = 0; j < inner.length; j++) {
            if (inner[j] === el) continue;
            var style = window.getComputedStyle(inner[j]);
            if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') continue;
            var r = inner[j].getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.bottom > 0 && r.top < window.innerHeight && r.right > 0 && r.left < window.innerWidth) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) {
        var el = elements[i];
        
        // Skip if no text or too short (likely navigation or artifact)
        if (!el.innerText || el.innerText.trim().length < 2) continue;
        if (isLikelyPageArtifact(el)) continue;
        if (isWrapperContainer(el)) continue;
        
        // Skip hidden elements
        if (window.getComputedStyle(el).display === 'none') continue;
        
        var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        
        // Criteria:
        // 1. Element crosses the top edge (started above, ends below) -> currently reading this
        // 2. Element starts within the viewport (top >= 0 and top < viewportHeight)
        
        // Use a small buffer for top (e.g., 50px) to avoid skipping elements just barely cut off
        var viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
        var viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
        
        // Vertical visibility
        var isVerticallyVisible = rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < viewportHeight;
        
        // Horizontal visibility (Crucial for Paged Mode)
        var isHorizontallyVisible = rect.right > 0 && rect.left < viewportWidth;
        
        if (isVerticallyVisible && isHorizontallyVisible) {
            // This element is visible
            
            // Collect all IDs within this element (including itself) that are potentially SMIL targets
            var candidateIds = [];
            
            // 1. Check element itself
            if (el.id) candidateIds.push(el.id);
            
            // 2. Check children with IDs
            var childrenWithIds = el.querySelectorAll('[id]');
            for (var j = 0; j < childrenWithIds.length; j++) {
                var child = childrenWithIds[j];
                var childRect = child.getBoundingClientRect();
                // Check if child is actually visible
                if (childRect.bottom > 0 && childRect.top < viewportHeight && 
                    childRect.right > 0 && childRect.left < viewportWidth) {
                    candidateIds.push(child.id);
                }
            }
            
            // Return JSON with text and IDs
            var result = {
                text: el.innerText,
                ids: candidateIds
            };
            return JSON.stringify(result);
        }
    }
    
    // Fallback: if no specific block found, return body text (will likely start from beginning)
    return JSON.stringify({text: "", ids: []});
/// Clean visible-block text for TTS segment matching (skips ruby/annotation nodes).
/// Skips wrapper divs that contain other visible blocks; prefers topmost leaf block.
window.getVisibleTextForTTS = function() {
    try {
        var viewportHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 0;
        var viewportWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 0;
        var blocks = document.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, div');
        function isHidden(el) {
            var style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
            return style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.opacity === '0';
        }
        function isInViewport(el) {
            var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            return rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < viewportHeight &&
                rect.right > 0 && rect.left < viewportWidth;
        }
        function shouldSkipNode(node) {
            if (!node || !node.parentElement) return true;
            var p = node.parentElement;
            if (!p) return true;
            if (p.closest('.ob-ruby-text, .vocab-badge, #ob-active-bubble, script, style, noscript')) return true;
            if (typeof window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode === 'function' && window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) {
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function collectTextByTreeWalker(el) {
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                acceptNode: function(node) {
                    return shouldSkipNode(node) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                }
            });
            var out = [];
            var n;
            while ((n = walker.nextNode())) {
                var t = (n.nodeValue || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                if (!t) continue;
                out.push(t);
            }
            return out.join(' ').trim();
        }
        function isWrapperContainer(el) {
            if (!el || el.tagName !== 'DIV') return false;
            var inner = el.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, div');
            for (var j = 0; j < inner.length; j++) {
                if (inner[j] === el) continue;
                if (!isHidden(inner[j]) && isInViewport(inner[j])) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function isLikelyPageArtifactText(t) {
            t = (t || '').trim();
            if (t.length <= 4 && /^\d+$/.test(t)) return true;
            return false;
        }
        function collectSmilIds(el) {
            var candidateIds = [];
            if (el.id) candidateIds.push(el.id);
            var childrenWithIds = el.querySelectorAll('[id]');
            for (var j = 0; j < childrenWithIds.length; j++) {
                var child = childrenWithIds[j];
                if (isHidden(child) || !isInViewport(child)) continue;
                if (child.id) candidateIds.push(child.id);
            }
            return candidateIds;
        }
        var candidates = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
            var el = blocks[i];
            if (isHidden(el) || !isInViewport(el)) continue;
            if (isWrapperContainer(el)) continue;
            var t = collectTextByTreeWalker(el);
            if (!t || t.length < 8 || isLikelyPageArtifactText(t)) continue;
            var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            candidates.push({ text: t, top: rect.top, left: rect.left, el: el });
        }
        if (candidates.length === 0) return '';
        candidates.sort(function(a, b) {
            if (Math.abs(a.top - b.top) > 8) return a.top - b.top;
            return a.left - b.left;
        });
        return candidates[0].text;
    } catch (e) {
        return '';
    }
/// Clean visible block + SMIL ids for native audio play-from-here.
window.getVisibleSmilAnchor = function() {
    try {
        var viewportHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 0;
        var viewportWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 0;
        var blocks = document.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, div');
        function isHidden(el) {
            var style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
            return style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.opacity === '0';
        }
        function isInViewport(el) {
            var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            return rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < viewportHeight &&
                rect.right > 0 && rect.left < viewportWidth;
        }
        function shouldSkipNode(node) {
            if (!node || !node.parentElement) return true;
            var p = node.parentElement;
            if (!p) return true;
            if (p.closest('.ob-ruby-text, .vocab-badge, #ob-active-bubble, script, style, noscript')) return true;
            if (typeof window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode === 'function' && window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) {
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function collectTextByTreeWalker(el) {
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                acceptNode: function(node) {
                    return shouldSkipNode(node) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                }
            });
            var out = [];
            var n;
            while ((n = walker.nextNode())) {
                var t = (n.nodeValue || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                if (!t) continue;
                out.push(t);
            }
            return out.join(' ').trim();
        }
        function isWrapperContainer(el) {
            if (!el || el.tagName !== 'DIV') return false;
            var inner = el.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, div');
            for (var j = 0; j < inner.length; j++) {
                if (inner[j] === el) continue;
                if (!isHidden(inner[j]) && isInViewport(inner[j])) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function isLikelyPageArtifactText(t) {
            t = (t || '').trim();
            if (t.length <= 4 && /^\d+$/.test(t)) return true;
            return false;
        }
        function collectSmilIds(el) {
            var candidateIds = [];
            if (el.id) candidateIds.push(el.id);
            var childrenWithIds = el.querySelectorAll('[id]');
            for (var j = 0; j < childrenWithIds.length; j++) {
                var child = childrenWithIds[j];
                if (isHidden(child) || !isInViewport(child)) continue;
                if (child.id) candidateIds.push(child.id);
            }
            return candidateIds;
        }
        var candidates = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
            var el = blocks[i];
            if (isHidden(el) || !isInViewport(el)) continue;
            if (isWrapperContainer(el)) continue;
            var t = collectTextByTreeWalker(el);
            if (!t || t.length < 8 || isLikelyPageArtifactText(t)) continue;
            var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            candidates.push({ text: t, top: rect.top, left: rect.left, el: el });
        }
        if (candidates.length === 0) return JSON.stringify({ text: '', ids: [] });
        candidates.sort(function(a, b) {
            if (Math.abs(a.top - b.top) > 8) return a.top - b.top;
            return a.left - b.left;
        });
        var chosen = candidates[0];
        return JSON.stringify({ text: chosen.text, ids: collectSmilIds(chosen.el) });
    } catch (e) {
        return JSON.stringify({ text: '', ids: [] });
    }
// SMIL play-from-here: same anchor semantics as double-tap (page range + viewport caret).
window.__obFindBlockParent = function(node) {
    var el = node && node.nodeType === 3 ? node.parentElement : node;
    while (el && el !== document.body) {
        var display = window.getComputedStyle(el).display;
        if (display === 'block' || display === 'list-item' || display === 'flex' || display === 'grid' ||
            el.tagName === 'P' || el.tagName === 'DIV' || el.tagName === 'LI') return el;
        el = el.parentElement;
    }
    return el;
window.__obIsAnnotationNode = function(node) {
    var curr = node && node.parentNode;
    while (curr && curr !== document.body) {
        if (curr.nodeType === 1) {
            if (curr.nodeName === 'RT') return true;
            if (curr.classList && (
                curr.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text') ||
                curr.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text-isolator') ||
                curr.classList.contains('vocab-badge')
            )) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        curr = curr.parentNode;
    }
    return false;
/// Readable body text from an element, excluding ruby/annotation nodes.
window.__obExtractReadableText = function(el) {
    if (!el) return '';
    var doc = el.ownerDocument || document;
    var walker = doc.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
        acceptNode: function(node) {
            if (window.__obIsAnnotationNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
            var p = node.parentElement;
            if (p && p.closest && p.closest('.ob-ruby-text, .ob-ruby-text-isolator, .vocab-badge, script, style, noscript')) {
                return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
            }
            return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
        }
    });
    var parts = [];
    var n;
    while (n = walker.nextNode()) {
        var t = (n.nodeValue || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (t) parts.push(t);
    }
    return parts.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
window.__obExtractSentenceAtTextNode = function(textNode, offset) {
    if (!textNode || textNode.nodeType !== 3) return '';
    var block = window.__obFindBlockParent(textNode);
    if (!block) return '';
    var rawContext = '';
    var hitIndex = -1;
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(block, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
    var node;
    while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
        if (window.__obIsAnnotationNode(node)) continue;
        if (node === textNode) hitIndex = rawContext.length + (offset || 0);
        rawContext += node.nodeValue || '';
    }
    if (hitIndex < 0) hitIndex = 0;
    var sentStart = 0;
    var sentEnd = rawContext.length;
    var puncs = ['.', '!', '?', '\u3002', '\uFF01', '\uFF1F'];
    for (var i = hitIndex - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (puncs.indexOf(rawContext[i]) >= 0) { sentStart = i + 1; break; }
    }
    for (var j = hitIndex; j < rawContext.length; j++) {
        if (puncs.indexOf(rawContext[j]) >= 0) { sentEnd = j + 1; break; }
    }
    return rawContext.substring(sentStart, sentEnd).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
window.__obCollectSmilIds = function(textNode) {
    var ids = [];
    var seen = {};
    function add(id) {
        if (!id || seen[id]) return;
        seen[id] = true;
        ids.push(id);
    }
    var el = textNode && textNode.nodeType === 3 ? textNode.parentElement : textNode;
    while (el && el !== document.body) {
        if (el.id) add(el.id);
        el = el.parentElement;
    }
    var block = window.__obFindBlockParent(textNode);
    if (block) {
        block.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(function(idNode) { add(idNode.id); });
    }
    return ids;
window.__obSmilAnchorFromRange = function(range) {
    if (!range || !range.cloneRange) return null;
    try {
        range = range.cloneRange();
        range.collapse(true);
        var node = range.startContainer;
        var offset = range.startOffset;
        if (node.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE) {
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(
                node.nodeType === 1 ? node : document.body,
                NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,
                {
                    acceptNode: function(n) {
                        if (window.__obIsAnnotationNode(n)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                        try {
                            return range.isPointInRange(n, 0) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT : NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                        } catch (e) { return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT; }
                    }
                }
            );
            var first = walker.nextNode();
            if (!first) return null;
            node = first;
            offset = 0;
        }
        var text = window.__obExtractSentenceAtTextNode(node, offset);
        var ids = window.__obCollectSmilIds(node);
        if (!text && !ids.length) return null;
        return { text: text, ids: ids };
    } catch (e) {
        return null;
    }
window.__obSmilAnchorFromViewport = function() {
    if (!document.caretRangeFromPoint) return null;
    var x = Math.max(8, (window.innerWidth || 0) * 0.5);
    var y = Math.max(8, Math.min((window.innerHeight || 0) * 0.22, 160));
    var ptRange = document.caretRangeFromPoint(x, y);
    if (!ptRange || ptRange.startContainer.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE) return null;
    if (window.__obIsAnnotationNode(ptRange.startContainer)) return null;
    var text = window.__obExtractSentenceAtTextNode(ptRange.startContainer, ptRange.startOffset);
    var ids = window.__obCollectSmilIds(ptRange.startContainer);
    if (!text && !ids.length) return null;
    return { text: text, ids: ids };
window.getSmilPlayAnchor = function() {
    try {
        var fromRange = null;
        var fromViewport = null;
        var range = document.__foliateCurrentPageRange;
        if (range) fromRange = window.__obSmilAnchorFromRange(range);
        fromViewport = window.__obSmilAnchorFromViewport();
        var chosen = fromRange || fromViewport;
        if (fromRange && fromViewport && fromViewport.text && fromRange.text) {
            var rHead = fromRange.text.slice(0, 80).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
            var vHead = fromViewport.text.slice(0, 80).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
            if (rHead !== vHead && fromViewport.text.length >= 8) chosen = fromViewport;
        } else if (fromRange && fromViewport && fromViewport.text && !fromRange.text) {
            chosen = fromViewport;
        }
        if (chosen && (chosen.text || (chosen.ids && chosen.ids.length))) {
            return JSON.stringify({ text: chosen.text || '', ids: chosen.ids || [] });
        }
        if (typeof window.getVisibleSmilAnchor === 'function') {
            return window.getVisibleSmilAnchor();
        }
        return JSON.stringify({ text: '', ids: [] });
    } catch (e) {
        return JSON.stringify({ text: '', ids: [] });
    }
// Extract text from current visible page only, and complete the trailing sentence
// by appending nearby following text until sentence punctuation appears.
window.getVisibleTextForPhraseAnalysis = function() {
    try {
        var viewportHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 0;
        var viewportWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 0;
        var blocks = document.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, li, blockquote, div');
        var chunks = [];
        function isHidden(el) {
            var style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
            return style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.opacity === '0';
        }
        function shouldSkipNode(node) {
            if (!node || !node.parentElement) return true;
            var p = node.parentElement;
            if (!p) return true;
            if (p.closest('.ob-ruby-text, .vocab-badge, #ob-active-bubble, script, style, noscript')) return true;
            return false;
        }
        function collectTextByTreeWalker(el) {
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                acceptNode: function(node) {
                    return shouldSkipNode(node) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                }
            });
            var out = [];
            var n;
            while ((n = walker.nextNode())) {
                var t = (n.nodeValue || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                if (!t) continue;
                out.push(t);
            }
            return out.join(' ').trim();
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
            var el = blocks[i];
            if (isHidden(el)) continue;
            var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            var isVerticallyVisible = rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < viewportHeight;
            var isHorizontallyVisible = rect.right > 0 && rect.left < viewportWidth;
            if (!isVerticallyVisible || !isHorizontallyVisible) continue;
            var t = collectTextByTreeWalker(el);
            if (!t || t.length < 2) continue;
            chunks.push(t);
        }
        var visibleText = chunks.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        if (!visibleText) return '';
        if (/[.!?
]["')\]]*$/.test(visibleText)) return visibleText;
        var bodyText = (document.body && document.body.innerText ? document.body.innerText : '')
            .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
            .trim();
        if (!bodyText) return visibleText;
        var anchor = visibleText.slice(Math.max(0, visibleText.length - 80));
        var idx = bodyText.indexOf(anchor);
        if (idx < 0) return visibleText;
        var start = idx + anchor.length;
        var tail = bodyText.slice(start, Math.min(bodyText.length, start + 320));
        var m = tail.match(/^[\s\S]*?[.!?
]/);
        if (m && m[0]) {
            return (visibleText + ' ' + m[0]).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        }
        return visibleText;
    } catch (e) {
        return '';
    }

                    msg.indexOf("Failed to find text") === 0 ||
                    msg.indexOf("Range creation failed") === 0 ||
                    msg.indexOf("Global Mapping failed") !== -1 ||
                    msg.indexOf("Engaging Legacy Strategies") !== -1) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.logHandler) {
                window.webkit.messageHandlers.logHandler.postMessage(msg);
            }
        }
        window.clearCurrentHighlight = function() {
            // Also clear word highlights
            var wordHighlights = document.querySelectorAll('.ob-word-highlight');
            wordHighlights.forEach(function(span) {
                var parent = span.parentNode;
                while (span.firstChild) {
                    parent.insertBefore(span.firstChild, span);
                }
                parent.removeChild(span);
                parent.normalize();
            });
            var highlights = document.querySelectorAll('.tts-highlight, .audio-highlight, .epub-highlight');
            highlights.forEach(function(span) {
                var parent = span.parentNode;
                if (span.classList.contains('epub-highlight')) {
                     // For epub-highlight, it might be the element itself (e.g. <p id="f001" class="epub-highlight">)
                     // In that case, we just remove the class.
                     // But wait, setHighlight logic: el.classList.add('epub-highlight')
                     // So we should just remove the class if it's the element itself.
                     // BUT, tts-highlight and audio-highlight are WRAPPERS (spans) created by surroundContents.
                     // epub-highlight is a CLASS added to an existing element.
                     
                     // Let's distinguish based on tag name or just remove class if it has ID?
                     // Actually, for epub-highlight, we just want to remove the class.
                     span.classList.remove('epub-highlight');
                } else {
                    // For tts/audio highlight spans, we unwrap them.
                    while (span.firstChild) {
                        parent.insertBefore(span.firstChild, span);
                    }
                    parent.removeChild(span);
                    parent.normalize();
                }
            });
        }
        // Text used for TTS matching must exclude annotation/decorative content:
        // - ruby/rt text
        // - annotation definition text (ob-ruby-text)
        // - reading trajectory badge text (vocab-badge)
        // NOTE: keep real word text inside .ob-ruby-container participating in matching.
        window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode = function(node) {
            if (!node || node.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE) return true;
            var el = node.parentNode;
            while (el && el !== document.body) {
                if (el.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                    if (el.nodeName === 'RT' || el.nodeName === 'RP') return true;
                    if (el.classList) {
                        if (el.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text') ||
                            el.classList.contains('ob-ruby-text-isolator') ||
                            el.classList.contains('vocab-badge')) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                el = el.parentNode;
            }
            return false;
        };
        window.__obTtsBlockAncestor = function(node) {
            var el = node.parentElement;
            while (el && el !== document.body) {
                if (el.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                    var tag = el.nodeName;
                    if (/^(P|DIV|H[1-6]|LI|BLOCKQUOTE|SECTION|ARTICLE|HEADER|FOOTER|ADDRESS|PRE|TR|TD|TH)$/i.test(tag)) {
                        return el;
                    }
                }
                el = el.parentElement;
            }
            return null;
        };
        window.__obTtsBuildVisibleTextMap = function() {
            var textNodesMap = [];
            var fullDocText = "";
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                acceptNode: function(node) {
                    if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                    if (node.parentElement && getComputedStyle(node.parentElement).display === 'none') return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                    return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                }
            }, false);
            var node;
            while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
                var val = node.nodeValue;
                textNodesMap.push({ node: node, start: fullDocText.length, end: fullDocText.length + val.length });
                fullDocText += val;
            }
            return { textNodesMap: textNodesMap, fullDocText: fullDocText };
        };
        // Chapter text for Swift TTS tokenization: block elements become `\n\n`, highlight map stays unchanged above.
        window.__obTtsBuildChapterTextForTokenization = function() {
            var parts = [];
            var lastBlock = null;
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                acceptNode: function(node) {
                    if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                    if (node.parentElement && getComputedStyle(node.parentElement).display === 'none') return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                    return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                }
            }, false);
            var node;
            while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
                var block = window.__obTtsBlockAncestor(node);
                if (lastBlock !== null && block !== lastBlock) {
                    parts.push('\n\n');
                }
                lastBlock = block;
                parts.push(node.nodeValue);
            }
            return parts.join('');
        };
        window.__obTtsRangeStartToCharIndex = function(range) {
            if (!range || typeof window.__obTtsBuildVisibleTextMap !== 'function') return -1;
            var tpm = window.__obTtsBuildVisibleTextMap();
            var sc = range.startContainer;
            var so = range.startOffset;
            if (sc.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                for (var k = 0; k < tpm.textNodesMap.length; k++) {
                    if (tpm.textNodesMap[k].node === sc) {
                        return tpm.textNodesMap[k].start + so;
                    }
                }
            }
            return -1;
        };
        window.__obTtsCleanTextFromRange = function(range, maxLen) {
            if (!range) return '';
            maxLen = maxLen || 600;
            try {
                var frag = range.cloneContents();
                var walker = document.createTreeWalker(frag, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                    acceptNode: function(node) {
                        if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode && window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) {
                            return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                        }
                        return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                    }
                });
                var parts = [];
                var n;
                while (n = walker.nextNode()) {
                    var t = (n.nodeValue || '');
                    if (t) parts.push(t);
                }
                return parts.join('').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim().substring(0, maxLen);
            } catch (e) {
                return (range.toString() || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim().substring(0, maxLen);
            }
        };
        window.__obTtsRangeEndToCharIndex = function(range, textNodesMap) {
            if (!range || !textNodesMap || !textNodesMap.length) return 0;
            var ec = range.endContainer;
            var eo = range.endOffset;
            if (ec.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                for (var k = 0; k < textNodesMap.length; k++) {
                    if (textNodesMap[k].node === ec) {
                        return textNodesMap[k].start + eo;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        };
        window.__obTtsOffsetsToRange = function(textNodesMap, startIdx, endIdx) {
            var startNode = null, startOffset = 0, endNode = null, endOffset = 0;
            for (var k = 0; k < textNodesMap.length; k++) {
                var base = (typeof textNodesMap[k].nodeOffset === "number") ? textNodesMap[k].nodeOffset : 0;
                if (startNode === null && startIdx >= textNodesMap[k].start && startIdx < textNodesMap[k].end) {
                    startNode = textNodesMap[k].node;
                    startOffset = base + (startIdx - textNodesMap[k].start);
                }
                if (endIdx > textNodesMap[k].start && endIdx <= textNodesMap[k].end) {
                    endNode = textNodesMap[k].node;
                    endOffset = base + (endIdx - textNodesMap[k].start);
                }
            }
            if (!startNode || !endNode) return null;
            try {
                var range = document.createRange();
                var maxStart = (startNode.nodeValue || "").length;
                var maxEnd = (endNode.nodeValue || "").length;
                if (startOffset < 0) startOffset = 0;
                if (endOffset < 0) endOffset = 0;
                if (startOffset > maxStart) startOffset = maxStart;
                if (endOffset > maxEnd) endOffset = maxEnd;
                range.setStart(startNode, startOffset);
                range.setEnd(endNode, endOffset);
                return { range: range, endIdx: endIdx };
            } catch (e) {
                return null;
            }
        };
        // 1:1 code-unit mapping so char indices stay aligned with DOM textNodesMap (fullwidth digits / commas vs ASCII).
        window.__obTtsNormalizeForTtsMatch = function(s) {
            if (!s || typeof s !== 'string') return s;
            var out = '';
            for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
                var c = s.charCodeAt(i);
                if (c >= 0xFF10 && c <= 0xFF19) {
                    out += String.fromCharCode(0x30 + (c - 0xFF10));
                } else if (c >= 0x0660 && c <= 0x0669) {
                    out += String.fromCharCode(0x30 + (c - 0x0660));
                } else if (c >= 0x06F0 && c <= 0x06F9) {
                    out += String.fromCharCode(0x30 + (c - 0x06F0));
                } else if (c === 0xFF0C) {
                    out += ',';
                } else if (c === 0x3001) {
                    out += ',';
                } else {
                    out += s.charAt(i);
                }
            }
            return out;
        };
        window.__obTtsLooseSentenceRange = function(fullDocText, textNodesMap, text, minOffsets) {
            var fd = window.__obTtsNormalizeForTtsMatch(fullDocText);
            var tx = window.__obTtsNormalizeForTtsMatch(text);
            var h = fd.toLowerCase();
            var needle = tx.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!needle.length) return null;
            var uniq = [];
            for (var ui = 0; ui < minOffsets.length; ui++) {
                var v = minOffsets[ui];
                var dup = false;
                for (var uj = 0; uj < uniq.length; uj++) { if (uniq[uj] === v) { dup = true; break; } }
                if (!dup) uniq.push(v);
            }
            for (var mi = 0; mi < uniq.length; mi++) {
                var from = uniq[mi];
                if (from < 0) from = 0;
                var pos = h.indexOf(needle, from);
                if (pos !== -1) {
                    return window.__obTtsOffsetsToRange(textNodesMap, pos, pos + needle.length);
                }
            }
            var parts = needle.split(/\s+/).filter(function(x) { return x.length > 0; });
            if (parts.length === 0) return null;
            var esc = parts.map(function(p) {
                return p.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
            }).join('[\\s\\u00a0\\n\\r]*');
            var re = new RegExp(esc, 'i');
            for (var mi2 = 0; mi2 < uniq.length; mi2++) {
                var from2 = uniq[mi2];
                if (from2 < 0) from2 = 0;
                var sub = h.substring(from2);
                var m = sub.match(re);
                if (m && m.index !== undefined && m[0].length > 0) {
                    var s0 = from2 + m.index;
                    var s1 = s0 + m[0].length;
                    return window.__obTtsOffsetsToRange(textNodesMap, s0, s1);
                }
            }
            return null;
        };
        
        window.smartScrollTo = function(element) {
             if (!element) return;
             
             // Delay to ensure layout stability (Ruby expansion, etc.)
             setTimeout(function() {
                 if (!element.isConnected) return;
                 try {
                     // 0. Handle Paged Mode
                     if (typeof window.isPaged !== 'undefined' && window.isPaged) {
                         var rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
                         var pageWidth = window.innerWidth;
                         
                         // Check if element is outside the current viewport horizontally
                          if (rect.left >= pageWidth - 10) { // Next Page
                              window.log("TTS_SCROLL (Paged): Requesting Next Page");
                              if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
                                  window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge.postMessage({ type: 'page-next' });
                              }
                          } else if (rect.right <= 10) { // Prev Page
                              window.log("TTS_SCROLL (Paged): Requesting Prev Page");
                              if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
                                  window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge.postMessage({ type: 'page-prev' });
                              }
                          }
                          return;
                      }
                     // 1. Identify the scroll container
                     var container = window;
                     var containerEl = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement || document.body;
                     var containerType = "WINDOW";
                     
                     if (typeof window.findMainScrollContainer === 'function') {
                         var found = window.findMainScrollContainer();
                         if (found && found !== document.body && found !== document.documentElement) {
                             containerEl = found;
                             container = containerEl;
                             containerType = "DIV(" + (containerEl.id || containerEl.className || containerEl.tagName) + ")";
                         }
                     }
                     
                     // 2. Get Geometry (Now layout should be stable)
                     var rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
                     var viewportHeight = (container === window) ? window.innerHeight : containerEl.clientHeight;
                     // News cover masthead is position:fixed over the top of the viewport.
                     // Measure it so TTS comfort zone sits in the remaining body area (EPUB has no such pin).
                     var topInset = 0;
                     var newsPin = document.querySelector('.ob-news-pin-cover');
                     if (newsPin) {
                         var pinH = newsPin.getBoundingClientRect().height;
                         if (pinH > 0 && pinH < viewportHeight) {
                             topInset = pinH;
                         }
                     }
                     var usableHeight = Math.max(1, viewportHeight - topInset);
                     
                     // 3. Strict Comfort Zone Check
                     // Target is 30% down the *usable* viewport (below any fixed news pin).
                     // We accept 
5% as "Good Enough" to avoid jitter.
                     var targetRatio = 0.3;
                     var tolerance = 0.05; // 5%
                     var currentRatio = (rect.top - topInset) / usableHeight;
                     
                     var inStrictZone = (currentRatio >= (targetRatio - tolerance)) && (currentRatio <= (targetRatio + tolerance));
                     
                     window.log("TTS_SCROLL: Container=" + containerType + 
                                ", RectTop=" + rect.top.toFixed(1) + 
                                ", ViewH=" + viewportHeight + 
                                ", TopInset=" + topInset.toFixed(1) + 
                                ", Ratio=" + currentRatio.toFixed(3) + 
                                ", InZone=" + inStrictZone);
                     
                     // If already in strict zone, DO NOT SCROLL.
                     if (inStrictZone) {
                         window.log("TTS_SCROLL: Skipping scroll (in zone)");
                         return;
                     }
                     
                     // 4. Calculate Target Scroll Position
                     var currentScrollY = (container === window) ? window.scrollY : containerEl.scrollTop;
                     var elementAbsoluteTop;
                     
                     if (container === window) {
                         elementAbsoluteTop = currentScrollY + rect.top;
                     } else {
                         var containerRect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                         var offsetInContainer = rect.top - containerRect.top;
                         elementAbsoluteTop = currentScrollY + offsetInContainer;
                     }
                     var targetViewportY = topInset + (usableHeight * targetRatio);
                     var targetScrollY = elementAbsoluteTop - targetViewportY;
                     
                     // 5. Boundary Checks
                     targetScrollY = Math.max(0, targetScrollY);
                     var maxScroll = (containerEl.scrollHeight || document.body.scrollHeight) - viewportHeight;
                     if (maxScroll > 0) {
                         targetScrollY = Math.min(maxScroll, targetScrollY);
                     }
                     
                     // 6. Execute Scroll
                     window.log("TTS_SCROLL: Executing scroll. CurY=" + currentScrollY.toFixed(1) + 
                                ", AbsTop=" + elementAbsoluteTop.toFixed(1) + 
                                ", TargetY=" + targetScrollY.toFixed(1) + 
                                ", MaxScroll=" + maxScroll);
                                
                     if (container === window) {
                         window.scrollTo({ top: targetScrollY, behavior: 'smooth' });
                     } else {
                         containerEl.scrollTo({ top: targetScrollY, behavior: 'smooth' });
                     }
                     
                 } catch(e) {
                     window.log("TTS_SCROLL_ERROR: " + e);
                     // Fallback
                     element.scrollIntoView({block: "center", behavior: "smooth"});
                 }
             }, 100);
        }
        
        window.safeHighlightRange = function(range, className) {
             var nodes = [];
             var iterator = document.createNodeIterator(
                 range.commonAncestorContainer,
                 NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,
                 {
                     acceptNode: function(node) {
                         // Must be intersecting the range
                         if (!range.intersectsNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                         
                         // Skip ruby text (annotation)
                        if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) {
                             return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                         }
                         
                         // Check visibility
                         if (node.parentElement && getComputedStyle(node.parentElement).display === 'none') {
                             return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                         }
                         
                         return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                     }
                 }
             );
             
             var node;
             while (node = iterator.nextNode()) {
                 nodes.push(node);
             }
             
             var firstSpan = null;
             
             // Wrap each node
             nodes.forEach(function(node) {
                 var span = document.createElement('span');
                 span.className = className;
                 
                 var start = (node === range.startContainer) ? range.startOffset : 0;
                 var end = (node === range.endContainer) ? range.endOffset : node.nodeValue.length;
                 
                 if (start < end) {
                     try {
                         var subRange = document.createRange();
                         subRange.setStart(node, start);
                         subRange.setEnd(node, end);
                         subRange.surroundContents(span);
                         if (!firstSpan) firstSpan = span;
                     } catch(e) {
                         window.log("SafeHighlight inner error: " + e);
                     }
                 }
             });
             
             window.log("SafeHighlight: Wrapped " + nodes.length + " nodes. FirstSpan: " + (firstSpan ? "YES" : "NO"));
             
             return firstSpan;
        }
        // Initialize state for word highlighting
        window.lastWordSearchIndex = 0;
        window.lastSentenceText = "";
        window.setWordHighlight = function(word, sentenceText) {
             window.log("setWordHighlight called. Word: " + word + ", Sentence: " + (sentenceText ? sentenceText.substring(0, 20) : "null"));
             // 1. Remove existing word highlights
             var existing = document.querySelectorAll('.ob-word-highlight');
             existing.forEach(function(el) {
                 var parent = el.parentNode;
                 while(el.firstChild) parent.insertBefore(el.firstChild, el);
                 parent.removeChild(el);
                 parent.normalize(); 
             });
             if (!word) return;
             
             // Optimization: If style is 'sentence', stop here (don't create new word highlights)
             if (window.readerHighlightStyle === 'sentence') return;
             
             // 2. Detect Sentence Change (Reset Cursor)
             if (sentenceText !== window.lastSentenceText) {
                 window.lastWordSearchIndex = 0;
                 window.lastSentenceText = sentenceText;
                 // window.log("WordHighlight: Sentence changed, resetting index.");
             }
             // 3. Find the current sentence container
             // Support both TTS (.tts-highlight) and Native Audio (.epub-highlight)
             var sentenceEls = document.querySelectorAll('.tts-highlight, .audio-highlight, .epub-highlight');
             if (sentenceEls.length === 0) {
                 window.log("WordHighlight: No active sentence highlight found (checked .tts-highlight, .audio-highlight, .epub-highlight)");
                 return;
             }
             // 4. Build Full Text Map (concatenating all text nodes in the sentence)
             // This solves the issue where a word is split across multiple nodes (e.g. formatting)
             var textNodes = [];
             var fullText = "";
             
             sentenceEls.forEach(function(el) {
                 var walker = document.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                     acceptNode: function(node) {
                         // Skip Ruby text to match TTS content
                        if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                         // Skip hidden elements
                         if (node.parentElement && getComputedStyle(node.parentElement).display === 'none') return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                         return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                     }
                 }, false);
                 var node;
                 while(node = walker.nextNode()) {
                     textNodes.push({
                         node: node,
                         start: fullText.length,
                         end: fullText.length + node.nodeValue.length
                     });
                     fullText += node.nodeValue;
                 }
             });
             
             if (!fullText) return;
             
             window.log("WordHighlight: Searching for word: '" + word + "' in sentence: '" + fullText.substring(0, 50) + "...'");
             // 5. Search Logic (Stateful & Fuzzy)
            var searchStartIndex = window.lastWordSearchIndex;
            // Cursor at/after sentence end: last word already consumed the string; TTS may still emit word events 
 do not search or log (avoids native log spam).
            if (searchStartIndex >= fullText.length) {
                window.lastWordSearchIndex = 0;
                return;
            }
            
            // Optimization: Strip trailing punctuation from the search word.
            // This prevents failures where the TTS word has punctuation (e.g. "end.")
            // but the DOM text might handle it differently or we just want to match the word itself.
            // We keep the word if it's ONLY punctuation.
            var cleanWord = word;
            if (word.length > 1) {
                cleanWord = word.replace(/[\.,;!?:""''
()\[\]{}<>\/\\-]+$/, "");
                if (cleanWord.length === 0) cleanWord = word; // Revert if it was all punctuation
            }
            
            // Helper: Normalize char for comparison
            var normChar = function(c) {
                var low = c.toLowerCase();
                if ("\u2018\u2019\u201B'`".indexOf(low) !== -1) return "'";
                if ("\u201C\u201D\u0022".indexOf(low) !== -1) return '"';
                if ("\u2013\u2014\u2012\u2212-".indexOf(low) !== -1) return "-";
                if (low === "\u00A0") return " ";
                return low;
            };
            
            // Helper: Check if char is ignorable (soft hyphen, zero width space, etc)
            var isIgnorable = function(c) {
                return c === "\u00AD" || c === "\u200B" || c === "\uFEFF" || c === "\u200C" || c === "\u200D";
            };
            
            // Helper: Check if char is separator
            var isSeparator = function(c) {
                return /[\s\.,;!?:""''
()\[\]{}<>\/\\-]/.test(c);
            };
            // Fuzzy Finder: returns {start, end} in original text coordinates
            var findFuzzy = function(text, word, startIndex) {
                 var wordLen = word.length;
                 var textLen = text.length;
                 
                 // Normalize search word
                 var normWord = "";
                 for(var k=0; k<wordLen; k++) normWord += normChar(word[k]);
                 normWord = normWord.trim(); 
                 if (normWord.length === 0) return null;
                 
                 for (var i = startIndex; i < textLen; i++) {
                     var tIdx = i;
                     var wIdx = 0;
                     var match = true;
                     
                     while (wIdx < normWord.length) {
                         if (tIdx >= textLen) { match = false; break; }
                         
                         var tChar = text[tIdx];
                         if (isIgnorable(tChar)) {
                             tIdx++;
                             continue; 
                         }
                         
                         if (normChar(tChar) !== normWord[wIdx]) {
                             match = false;
                             break;
                         }
                         
                         tIdx++;
                         wIdx++;
                     }
                     
                     if (match) {
                         return { start: i, end: tIdx };
                     }
                 }
                 return null;
            };
            var match = findFuzzy(fullText, cleanWord, searchStartIndex);
            
            if (match) {
                window.log("WordHighlight: Found match at " + match.start + "-" + match.end + " (Stateful)");
            } else {
                // Blind Match (forward only): if fuzzy search failed, advance to the next word after the cursor.
                // We intentionally do NOT fall back to findFuzzy(..., 0), which matched the first occurrence
                // of repeated words and caused the underline to jump backward in the sentence.
                var currentIdx = searchStartIndex;
                while (currentIdx < fullText.length && isSeparator(fullText[currentIdx])) {
                    currentIdx++;
                }
                if (currentIdx < fullText.length) {
                    var textEndIdx = currentIdx;
                    while (textEndIdx < fullText.length && !isSeparator(fullText[textEndIdx])) {
                        textEndIdx++;
                    }
                    if (textEndIdx > currentIdx) {
                        match = { start: currentIdx, end: textEndIdx };
                        window.log("WordHighlight: Blind Match (Next Word) accepted for '" + word + "' -> '" + fullText.substring(currentIdx, textEndIdx) + "'");
                    }
                }
                if (!match) {
                    // Only log genuine mid-sentence misses (not already handled by searchStartIndex >= fullText.length).
                    window.log("WordHighlight: no match for word from index " + searchStartIndex + " (len=" + fullText.length + ")");
                }
            }
            
            if (match) {
                // Update cursor to end of this match
                window.lastWordSearchIndex = match.end;
                
                // 6. Map match index back to DOM Nodes
                var startGlobal = match.start;
                var endGlobal = match.end;
                 
                 var startNode = null, startOffset = 0;
                 var endNode = null, endOffset = 0;
                 
                 for (var i = 0; i < textNodes.length; i++) {
                     var tn = textNodes[i];
                     if (startGlobal >= tn.start && startGlobal < tn.end) {
                         startNode = tn.node;
                         startOffset = startGlobal - tn.start;
                     }
                     // Use < here because end offset can be equal to length
                     if (endGlobal > tn.start && endGlobal <= tn.end) {
                         endNode = tn.node;
                         endOffset = endGlobal - tn.start;
                     }
                 }
                 
                 if (startNode && endNode) {
                     try {
                         var range = document.createRange();
                         range.setStart(startNode, startOffset);
                         range.setEnd(endNode, endOffset);
                         
                         var className = 'ob-word-highlight';
                         // Replaced surroundContents with safeHighlightRange to prevent InvalidStateError
                         // when wrapping complex DOM structures (e.g. bold, italic, ruby)
                         // range.surroundContents(span);
                         
                         var firstSpan = window.safeHighlightRange(range, className);
                         
                         if (firstSpan) {
                             // safeHighlightRange returns the first span created.
                             // We need to apply styles to all created spans.
                             // Since we clear all 'ob-word-highlight' at the beginning of this function,
                             // we can safely query all of them now.
                             var allSpans = document.querySelectorAll('.' + className);
                            allSpans.forEach(function(span) {
                                // Paint-only word line: keep layout stable and avoid a second background layer.
                                span.style.setProperty('background-color', 'transparent', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('box-shadow', 'inset 0 -2px 0 var(--word-highlight-line, #6AAEFF)', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('border', 'none', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('outline', 'none', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('padding', '0', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('margin', '0', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('border-radius', '0', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('position', 'relative', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('z-index', '10', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('box-decoration-break', 'clone', 'important');
                                span.style.setProperty('-webkit-box-decoration-break', 'clone', 'important');
                            });
                             
                             // 6.5 Scroll only while Swift enables follow mode (never chase a stale sentence for tap-to-pronounce)
                             if (window.__obTtsAutoScroll === true) {
                                 window.smartScrollTo(firstSpan);
                             }
                         } else {
                             window.log("WordHighlight: safeHighlightRange failed to create spans");
                         }
                     } catch(e) {
                         window.log("WordHighlight: Wrap error: " + e);
                     }
                 }
             }
        }
        window.__obTtsBuildSentenceElsTextMap = function(sentenceEls) {
             var textNodes = [];
             var fullText = "";
             sentenceEls.forEach(function(el) {
                 var walker = document.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                     acceptNode: function(node) {
                        if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode && window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                         if (node.parentElement && getComputedStyle(node.parentElement).display === 'none') return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                         return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                     }
                 }, false);
                 var node;
                 while(node = walker.nextNode()) {
                     textNodes.push({
                         node: node,
                         start: fullText.length,
                         end: fullText.length + node.nodeValue.length
                     });
                     fullText += node.nodeValue;
                 }
             });
             return { textNodes: textNodes, fullText: fullText };
        };
        window.__obTtsTokenizeHighlightText = function(fullText) {
             var tokens = [];
             if (!fullText) return tokens;
             var hasSpace = /\s/.test(fullText);
             var hasCJK = /[\u3040-\u30FF\u3400-\u4DBF\u4E00-\u9FFF\uAC00-\uD7AF\uF900-\uFAFF\uFF66-\uFF9D]/.test(fullText);
             if (hasSpace || !hasCJK) {
                 var re = /\S+/g;
                 var match;
                 while (match = re.exec(fullText)) {
                     tokens.push({ start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });
                 }
             } else {
                 for (var ti = 0; ti < fullText.length; ) {
                     var cp = fullText.codePointAt(ti);
                     var ch = String.fromCodePoint(cp);
                     var advance = ch.length;
                     if (!/\s/.test(ch)) {
                         tokens.push({ start: ti, end: ti + advance });
                     }
                     ti += advance;
                 }
             }
             return tokens;
        };
        window.__obTtsApplyWordHighlightRange = function(textNodes, startGlobal, endGlobal) {
             var startNode = null, startOffset = 0;
             var endNode = null, endOffset = 0;
             for (var i = 0; i < textNodes.length; i++) {
                 var tn = textNodes[i];
                 if (startGlobal >= tn.start && startGlobal < tn.end) {
                     startNode = tn.node;
                     startOffset = startGlobal - tn.start;
                 }
                 if (endGlobal > tn.start && endGlobal <= tn.end) {
                     endNode = tn.node;
                     endOffset = endGlobal - tn.start;
                 }
             }
             if (!startNode || !endNode) return;
             try {
                 var range = document.createRange();
                 range.setStart(startNode, startOffset);
                 range.setEnd(endNode, endOffset);
                 var className = 'ob-word-highlight';
                 var firstSpan = window.safeHighlightRange(range, className);
                 if (firstSpan) {
                     var allSpans = document.querySelectorAll('.' + className);
                     allSpans.forEach(function(span) {
                         span.style.setProperty('background-color', 'transparent', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('box-shadow', 'inset 0 -2px 0 var(--word-highlight-line, #6AAEFF)', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('border', 'none', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('outline', 'none', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('padding', '0', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('margin', '0', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('border-radius', '0', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('position', 'relative', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('z-index', '10', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('box-decoration-break', 'clone', 'important');
                         span.style.setProperty('-webkit-box-decoration-break', 'clone', 'important');
                     });
                     if (window.__obTtsAutoScroll === true) {
                         window.smartScrollTo(firstSpan);
                     }
                 }
             } catch (e) {
                 window.log("WordHighlight: Wrap error: " + e);
             }
        };
        // Index-based word highlight used by UniversalReader streaming TTS (HTML path).
        window.setWordHighlightProportional = function(wordIndex, wordCount) {
             var existing = document.querySelectorAll('.ob-word-highlight');
             existing.forEach(function(el) {
                 var parent = el.parentNode;
                 if (!parent) return;
                 while (el.firstChild) parent.insertBefore(el.firstChild, el);
                 parent.removeChild(el);
                 parent.normalize();
             });
             if (wordCount <= 0 || wordIndex < 0) return;
             if (window.readerHighlightStyle === 'sentence') return;
             var sentenceEls = document.querySelectorAll('.tts-highlight, .audio-highlight, .epub-highlight');
             if (sentenceEls.length === 0) return;
             var built = window.__obTtsBuildSentenceElsTextMap(sentenceEls);
             var textNodes = built.textNodes;
             var fullText = built.fullText;
             if (!fullText) return;
             var tokens = window.__obTtsTokenizeHighlightText(fullText);
             if (!tokens.length) return;
             var wi = Math.max(0, Math.min(wordIndex | 0, tokens.length - 1));
             var tok = tokens[wi];
             window.lastWordSearchIndex = tok.end;
             window.__obTtsApplyWordHighlightRange(textNodes, tok.start, tok.end);
        }
        
        window.highlightTTSSegment = function(index) {
            try {
                window.log("highlightTTSSegment called for index: " + index);
                window.clearCurrentHighlight();
                
                if (!window.ttsSegments || !window.ttsSegments[index]) {
                    window.log("TTS Error: No segment for index " + index);
                    return;
                }
                
                var rawText = window.ttsSegments[index];
                var text = rawText.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                
                if (!text) return;
                
                window.log("Highlighting index: " + index + ", text len: " + text.length);
                
                var sel = window.getSelection();
                
                if (index === 0 || index < window.lastHighlightedIndex || index > window.lastHighlightedIndex + 1) {
                     window.log("Resetting search to top");
                     sel.removeAllRanges();
                     var range = document.createRange();
                     range.selectNodeContents(document.body);
                     range.collapse(true);
                     sel.addRange(range);
                }
                
                var wasRubyEnabled = window.onebookHasRubyAnnotationDisplay && window.onebookHasRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                var searchingClassAdded = false;
                var found = false;
                try {
                    // --- STRATEGY 1: Global Text Mapping (Primary - NO Layout Shift) ---
                    // This strategy searches for the text sequence across text nodes, IGNORING Ruby annotations.
                    // It does NOT require hiding Ruby (ob-tts-searching), so it prevents layout jumps.
                    
                    window.log("Attempting Strategy 1: Global Text Mapping (No Layout Shift)...");
                    
                    try {
                        // 1. Build Document Text Map
                        var textNodesMap = [];
                        var fullDocText = "";
                        var walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                            acceptNode: function(node) {
                                // Always skip Ruby text, regardless of visibility
                                if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                                if (node.parentElement && getComputedStyle(node.parentElement).display === 'none') return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                                return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                            }
                        }, false);
                        
                        var node;
                        while(node = walker.nextNode()) {
                            var val = node.nodeValue;
                            textNodesMap.push({
                                node: node,
                                start: fullDocText.length,
                                end: fullDocText.length + val.length
                            });
                            fullDocText += val;
                        }
                        
                        var fullDocTextN = window.__obTtsNormalizeForTtsMatch(fullDocText);
                        var textN = window.__obTtsNormalizeForTtsMatch(text);
                        
                        // 2. Prepare Token Regex (Exclude punctuation, dashes, whitespace)
                        // Added \u2010-\u2015 (dashes), \u2026 (ellipsis), \u3001 (
) to exclusion list
                        var tokenRegex = /[^ \f\n\r\t\v\u00a0\u1680\u2000-\u200a\u2028\u2029\u202f\u205f\u3000\.,;!?:""''
()\[\]{}<>\/\\-\u2010-\u2015\u2026\u3001]+/g;
                        
                        // 3. Find Target Tokens in Doc Text
                        var targetTokens = textN.toLowerCase().match(tokenRegex);
                        
                        if (targetTokens && targetTokens.length > 0) {
                            var docTokens = [...fullDocTextN.toLowerCase().matchAll(tokenRegex)];
                            
                            // Simple sliding window search for token sequence
                            for (var i = 0; i <= docTokens.length - targetTokens.length; i++) {
                                var match = true;
                                for (var j = 0; j < targetTokens.length; j++) {
                                    if (docTokens[i + j][0] !== targetTokens[j]) {
                                        match = false;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                
                                if (match) {
                                    var startToken = docTokens[i];
                                    var endToken = docTokens[i + targetTokens.length - 1];
                                    
                                    var startIdx = startToken.index;
                                    var endIdx = endToken.index + endToken[0].length;
                                    
                                    var startNode = null, startOffset = 0;
                                    var endNode = null, endOffset = 0;
                                    
                                    // Find start node
                                    for (var k = 0; k < textNodesMap.length; k++) {
                                        if (startIdx >= textNodesMap[k].start && startIdx < textNodesMap[k].end) {
                                            startNode = textNodesMap[k].node;
                                            startOffset = startIdx - textNodesMap[k].start;
                                            break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    
                                    // Find end node
                                    for (var k = 0; k < textNodesMap.length; k++) {
                                        if (endIdx > textNodesMap[k].start && endIdx <= textNodesMap[k].end) {
                                            endNode = textNodesMap[k].node;
                                            endOffset = endIdx - textNodesMap[k].start;
                                            break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    
                                    if (startNode && endNode) {
                                        var range = document.createRange();
                                        range.setStart(startNode, startOffset);
                                        range.setEnd(endNode, endOffset);
                                        sel.removeAllRanges();
                                        sel.addRange(range);
                                        found = true;
                                        window.log("Found by Global Text Mapping!");
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch(e) {
                        window.log("Global Text Mapping Error: " + e);
                    }
                    try {
                        if (!found && typeof fullDocText !== 'undefined' && fullDocText && textNodesMap && textNodesMap.length) {
                            var minOffSeg = [0];
                            var looseSeg = window.__obTtsLooseSentenceRange(fullDocText, textNodesMap, text, minOffSeg);
                            if (looseSeg && looseSeg.range) {
                                sel.removeAllRanges();
                                sel.addRange(looseSeg.range);
                                found = true;
                                window.log("highlightTTSSegment: Found by loose sentence mapping");
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (eLoose) {
                        window.log("highlightTTSSegment loose mapping: " + eLoose);
                    }
                    // --- LEGACY STRATEGIES (Require Layout Shift) ---
                    if (!found) {
                        window.log("Global Mapping failed. Engaging Legacy Strategies (Layout Shift required)...");
                        
                        document.body.classList.add('ob-tts-searching');
                        if (wasRubyEnabled && window.onebookHideRubyAnnotationDisplay) {
                            window.onebookHideRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                        }
                        searchingClassAdded = true;
                    
                    document.body.offsetHeight; // Force layout
                    
                    // --- DEBUG LOGGING ---
                    try {
                        window.log("--- TTS DEBUG START (ULTIMATE) ---");
                        window.log("Target Text: " + text);
                        var bodyHTML = document.body.innerHTML;
                        if (bodyHTML) {
                             window.log("Body HTML (First 1000): " + bodyHTML.substring(0, 1000));
                             var firstWord = text.split(' ')[0];
                             var firstWordIndex = bodyHTML.indexOf(firstWord);
                             if (firstWordIndex !== -1) {
                                 var start = Math.max(0, firstWordIndex - 100);
                                 var end = Math.min(bodyHTML.length, firstWordIndex + 500);
                                 window.log("HTML Snippet around '" + firstWord + "': " + bodyHTML.substring(start, end));
                             } else {
                                 window.log("Could not find even the first word '" + firstWord + "' in HTML!");
                             }
                        }
                        window.log("--- TTS DEBUG END ---");
                    } catch (logErr) {
                        window.log("Debug logging failed: " + logErr);
                    }
                    var found = false;
                    
                    // Strategy 1: Full text match
                    found = window.find(text, false, false, true, false, false, false);
                    
                    // Verify Strategy 1 Match
                    if (found) {
                        var selText = window.getSelection().toString().replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                        var targetText = text.replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                        // If length mismatch is significant (e.g. > 20% difference), reject it
                        // This handles cases where window.find matches a substring or weird range due to Ruby
                        if (Math.abs(selText.length - targetText.length) > targetText.length * 0.2) {
                            window.log("Strategy 1 verification failed: length mismatch (" + selText.length + " vs " + targetText.length + "). Rejecting.");
                            found = false;
                            window.getSelection().removeAllRanges();
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Strategy 2: Start+End Match
                    if (!found) {
                         window.log("Exact match failed. Trying Start+End match...");
                         sel.removeAllRanges();
                         var range = document.createRange();
                         range.selectNodeContents(document.body);
                         range.collapse(true);
                         sel.addRange(range);
                         
                         var prefix = text.substring(0, 15).trim();
                         var suffix = text.substring(Math.max(0, text.length - 15)).trim();
                         
                         if (prefix.length >= 3 && suffix.length >= 3) {
                             if (window.find(prefix, false, false, true, false, false, false)) {
                                 var startRange = sel.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange();
                                 sel.collapseToEnd();
                                 if (window.find(suffix, false, false, true, false, false, false)) {
                                     var endRange = sel.getRangeAt(0);
                                     try {
                                         var combinedRange = document.createRange();
                                         combinedRange.setStart(startRange.startContainer, startRange.startOffset);
                                         combinedRange.setEnd(endRange.endContainer, endRange.endOffset);
                                         sel.removeAllRanges();
                                         sel.addRange(combinedRange);
                                         found = true;
                                         window.log("Found by Start+End match");
                                     } catch(e) {
                                         window.log("Range creation failed: " + e);
                                         sel.removeAllRanges();
                                         sel.addRange(startRange);
                                         found = true;
                                     }
                                 } else {
                                     sel.removeAllRanges();
                                     sel.addRange(startRange);
                                     found = true; 
                                     window.log("Suffix not found, highlighting prefix only");
                                 }
                             }
                         }
                    }
                    
                    // Verify Strategy 2 Match (if it succeeded)
                    if (found) {
                         var selText = window.getSelection().toString().replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                         var targetText = text.replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                         if (Math.abs(selText.length - targetText.length) > targetText.length * 0.2) {
                             window.log("Strategy 2 verification failed: length mismatch. Rejecting.");
                             found = false;
                             window.getSelection().removeAllRanges();
                         }
                    }
                    
                    // Strategy 4: Multi-Chunk match (Fallback)
                    if (!found) {
                        var chunks = text.split(/[,.
]/);
                        for (var i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
                            var chunk = chunks[i].trim();
                            if (chunk.length > 5) { 
                                 window.log("Trying chunk " + i + ": " + chunk.substring(0, 20) + "...");
                                 sel.removeAllRanges();
                                 var range = document.createRange();
                                 range.selectNodeContents(document.body);
                                 range.collapse(true);
                                 sel.addRange(range);
                                 if (window.find(chunk, false, false, true, false, false, false)) {
                                     window.log("Found by chunk " + i);
                                     found = true;
                                     break;
                                 }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Strategy 5: Sliding Window
                    if (!found) {
                        var words = text.split(/\s+/);
                        if (words.length > 4) {
                            window.log("Trying sliding window...");
                            for (var i = 0; i < words.length - 3; i++) {
                                var phrase = words.slice(i, i + 4).join(' ');
                                if (phrase.length < 5) continue;
                                 sel.removeAllRanges();
                                 var range = document.createRange();
                                 range.selectNodeContents(document.body);
                                 range.collapse(true);
                                 sel.addRange(range);
                                if (window.find(phrase, false, false, true, false, false, false)) {
                                     window.log("Found by sliding window: " + phrase);
                                     found = true;
                                     break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    } // End Legacy Strategies
                    
                    // Highlight logic
                    if (!found) {
                         window.log("Failed to find text: " + text);
                    } else {
                        var selection = window.getSelection();
                        if (selection.rangeCount > 0) {
                            var range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
