                            var fallbackTop = 0;
                            var rect = range.getBoundingClientRect();
                            if (rect && rect.height > 0) {
                                 fallbackTop = rect.top + window.scrollY - (window.innerHeight / 2);
                            }
                            
                            var span = document.createElement('span');
                            // span.className = window.isTTSMode ? 'tts-highlight' : 'audio-highlight'; // Now handled by safeHighlightRange
                            var className = window.isTTSMode ? 'tts-highlight' : 'audio-highlight';
                            
                            try {
                                // Replaced surroundContents with safeHighlightRange
                                // range.surroundContents(span);
                                var firstSpan = window.safeHighlightRange(range, className);
                                
                                if (firstSpan) {
                                    // Add extra class to first span for tracking? or all?
                                    // The original code added 'epub-playing-highlight' to the wrapper.
                                    // We can't easily add it to all without returning them all.
                                    // But CSS usually targets the main class.
                                    
                                    // RESTORE LAYOUT BEFORE SCROLLING
                                    // This is critical because smartScrollTo needs correct coordinates.
                                    // If we are in 'ob-tts-searching' mode, Ruby is hidden and layout is compacted.
                                    // We must expand it back to normal state before calculating scroll position.
                                    if (searchingClassAdded) {
                                        document.body.classList.remove('ob-tts-searching');
                                        if (wasRubyEnabled && window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay) {
                                            window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                                        }
                                        void document.body.offsetHeight; // Force layout update
                                        searchingClassAdded = false; // Prevent double removal in finally
                                    }
                                    // Scroll logic
                                    var rect = range.getBoundingClientRect(); // Range rect is still valid and covers all spans
                                    var viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
                                    var topThreshold = viewportHeight * 0.2; // 20%
                                    var bottomThreshold = viewportHeight * 0.8; // 80%
                                    
                                    if (window.__obTtsAutoScroll === true) {
                                        window.log("TTS_HIGHLIGHT: Calling smartScrollTo for segment index " + index);
                                        window.smartScrollTo(firstSpan);
                                    }
                                    window.lastHighlightedIndex = index;
                                } else {
                                     window.log("safeHighlightRange returned no spans");
                                }
                            } catch (e) {
                                 window.log("Highlight wrap failed: " + e);
                                 if (window.__obTtsAutoScroll === true && fallbackTop > 0) {
                                     window.scrollTo({top: fallbackTop, behavior: "smooth"});
                                 }
                                 window.lastHighlightedIndex = index;
                            }
                            selection.removeAllRanges();
                        }
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    window.log("CRITICAL ERROR in highlightTTSSegment logic: " + err);
                } finally {
                    // RESTORE STATE
                    if (searchingClassAdded) {
                        document.body.classList.remove('ob-tts-searching');
                        void document.body.offsetHeight; // Force layout
                    }
                    if (wasRubyEnabled && window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay) {
                        window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                    }
                }
            } catch (outerErr) {
                window.log("CRITICAL ERROR in highlightTTSSegment outer: " + outerErr);
            }
        }
        
        window.highlightText = function(text, segmentIndexOpt) {
             try {
                 window.log("JS Log: highlightText called for text: " + (text ? (typeof text === 'string' ? text.substring(0, 20) : "not string") : "null") + "...");
                 
                 // --- SELF-HEALING START ---
                var isDirty = document.body.classList.contains('ob-tts-searching');
                 if (isDirty) {
                     window.log("JS Log: Recovering from dirty state (ob-tts-searching found at start)");
                     document.body.classList.remove('ob-tts-searching');
                     void document.body.offsetHeight;
                 }
                 
                 window.clearCurrentHighlight();
                 if (!text) {
                     window.__obTtsForwardSearchMinChar = undefined;
                     window.__obTtsLastHighlightSegmentIndex = -1;
                     return;
                 }
                 if (typeof text !== 'string') return;
                 
                 var seg = (typeof segmentIndexOpt === 'number' && !isNaN(segmentIndexOpt)) ? segmentIndexOpt : null;
                 var lastSeg = (typeof window.__obTtsLastHighlightSegmentIndex === 'number') ? window.__obTtsLastHighlightSegmentIndex : -1;
                 if (seg === null) {
                     window.__obTtsForwardSearchMinChar = undefined;
                 } else if (lastSeg < 0 || seg === 0 || seg < lastSeg || seg > lastSeg + 1) {
                     window.__obTtsForwardSearchMinChar = undefined;
                 }
                 
                 var sel = window.getSelection();
                 sel.removeAllRanges();
                 
                 var wasRubyEnabled = window.onebookHasRubyAnnotationDisplay && window.onebookHasRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                 var searchingClassAdded = false;
                 var found = false;
                 var strategy1EndCharIdx = null;
                 try {
                     // --- STRATEGY 1: Global Text Mapping 
 prefer match at/after last highlight end (sequential TTS). ---
                     window.log("highlightText: Attempting Strategy 1: Global Text Mapping...");
                     try {
                        var textNodesMap = [];
                        var fullDocText = "";
                        var walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
                            acceptNode: function(node) {
                                if (window.__obTtsShouldSkipTextNode(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                                if (node.parentElement && getComputedStyle(node.parentElement).display === 'none') return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
                                return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                            }
                        }, false);
                        
                        var node;
                        while(node = walker.nextNode()) {
                            textNodesMap.push({ node: node, start: fullDocText.length, end: fullDocText.length + node.nodeValue.length });
                            fullDocText += node.nodeValue;
                        }
                        
                        var fullDocTextN = window.__obTtsNormalizeForTtsMatch(fullDocText);
                        var textN = window.__obTtsNormalizeForTtsMatch(text);
                        
                        var tokenRegex = /[^ \f\n\r\t\v\u00a0\u1680\u2000-\u200a\u2028\u2029\u202f\u205f\u3000\.,;!?:""''
()\[\]{}<>\/\\-\u2010-\u2015\u2026\u3001]+/g;
                        var targetTokens = textN.toLowerCase().match(tokenRegex);
                        
                        var baseMin = (typeof window.__obTtsForwardSearchMinChar === 'number') ? window.__obTtsForwardSearchMinChar : 0;
                        var minOffsets = [baseMin];
                        if (baseMin > 0) { minOffsets.push(0); }
                        
                        if (targetTokens && targetTokens.length > 0) {
                            var docTokens = [...fullDocTextN.toLowerCase().matchAll(tokenRegex)];
                            for (var oi = 0; oi < minOffsets.length && !found; oi++) {
                                var useMin = minOffsets[oi];
                                for (var i = 0; i <= docTokens.length - targetTokens.length; i++) {
                                    var match = true;
                                    for (var j = 0; j < targetTokens.length; j++) {
                                        if (docTokens[i + j][0] !== targetTokens[j]) { match = false; break; }
                                    }
                                    if (!match) continue;
                                    var startToken = docTokens[i];
                                    var endToken = docTokens[i + targetTokens.length - 1];
                                    var startIdx = startToken.index;
                                    var endIdx = endToken.index + endToken[0].length;
                                    if (startIdx < useMin) continue;
                                    var startNode = null, startOffset = 0, endNode = null, endOffset = 0;
                                    
                                    for (var k = 0; k < textNodesMap.length; k++) {
                                        if (startIdx >= textNodesMap[k].start && startIdx < textNodesMap[k].end) {
                                            startNode = textNodesMap[k].node; startOffset = startIdx - textNodesMap[k].start; break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    for (var k = 0; k < textNodesMap.length; k++) {
                                        if (endIdx > textNodesMap[k].start && endIdx <= textNodesMap[k].end) {
                                            endNode = textNodesMap[k].node; endOffset = endIdx - textNodesMap[k].start; break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    
                                    if (startNode && endNode) {
                                        var range = document.createRange();
                                        range.setStart(startNode, startOffset);
                                        range.setEnd(endNode, endOffset);
                                        sel.removeAllRanges();
                                        sel.addRange(range);
                                        found = true;
                                        strategy1EndCharIdx = endIdx;
                                        window.log("highlightText: Found by Global Text Mapping!");
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (!found && fullDocText.length > 0 && textNodesMap && textNodesMap.length) {
                            var looseR = window.__obTtsLooseSentenceRange(fullDocText, textNodesMap, text, minOffsets);
                            if (looseR && looseR.range) {
                                sel.removeAllRanges();
                                sel.addRange(looseR.range);
                                found = true;
                                strategy1EndCharIdx = looseR.endIdx;
                                window.log("highlightText: Found by loose sentence mapping");
                            }
                        }
                        if (found && text && text.length >= 20 && sel.rangeCount > 0 && typeof fullDocText === 'string' && fullDocText.length > 0 && textNodesMap && textNodesMap.length) {
                            var gDeg = sel.getRangeAt(0).toString().replace(/[\s\u00a0\n\r]+/g, ' ').trim();
                            if (gDeg.length <= 8 && gDeg.length < text.length * 0.22) {
                                window.log("highlightText: degenerate selection vs TTS line; retrying loose from 0");
                                found = false;
                                sel.removeAllRanges();
                                var looseFix = window.__obTtsLooseSentenceRange(fullDocText, textNodesMap, text, [0]);
                                if (looseFix && looseFix.range) {
                                    sel.addRange(looseFix.range);
                                    found = true;
                                    strategy1EndCharIdx = looseFix.endIdx;
                                    window.log("highlightText: recovered full line after degenerate match");
                                }
                            }
                        }
                     } catch(e) { window.log("highlightText Global Mapping Error: " + e); }
                     if (!found) {
                         // --- LEGACY STRATEGIES (Require Layout Shift) ---
                         window.log("highlightText: Global Mapping failed. Engaging Legacy Strategies...");
                         document.body.classList.add('ob-tts-searching');
                         if (wasRubyEnabled && window.onebookHideRubyAnnotationDisplay) {
                             window.onebookHideRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                         }
                         searchingClassAdded = true;
                         document.body.offsetHeight; // Force layout
                         
                         try {
                             // Strategy 2: Window.find
                         found = window.find(text, false, false, true, false, false, false);
                         
                         // Verify Strategy 1 Match
                         if (found) {
                             var selText = window.getSelection().toString().replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                             var targetText = text.replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                             var maxLenDiff = targetText.length * 0.2;
                             if (targetText.length < 24) {
                                 maxLenDiff = Math.max(maxLenDiff, 4);
                             }
                             if (Math.abs(selText.length - targetText.length) > maxLenDiff) {
                                 window.log("highlightText Strategy 1 verification failed: length mismatch. Rejecting.");
                                 found = false;
                                 window.getSelection().removeAllRanges();
                             }
                         }
                         
                         // Strategy 2: Start+End Match (Robust Fallback)
                         if (!found) {
                             window.log("Exact match failed. Trying Start+End match...");
                             
                             // Reset search to top
                             sel.removeAllRanges();
                             var range = document.createRange();
                             range.selectNodeContents(document.body);
                             range.collapse(true);
                             sel.addRange(range);
                             
                             var prefix = text.substring(0, 15).trim();
                             var suffix = text.substring(Math.max(0, text.length - 15)).trim();
                             
                             if (prefix.length >= 3 && suffix.length >= 3) {
                                 if (window.find(prefix, false, false, true, false, false, false)) {
                                     var startRange = sel.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange();
                                     sel.collapseToEnd();
                                     
                                     if (window.find(suffix, false, false, true, false, false, false)) {
                                         var endRange = sel.getRangeAt(0);
                                         try {
                                             var combinedRange = document.createRange();
                                             combinedRange.setStart(startRange.startContainer, startRange.startOffset);
                                             combinedRange.setEnd(endRange.endContainer, endRange.endOffset);
                                             sel.removeAllRanges();
                                             sel.addRange(combinedRange);
                                             found = true;
                                             window.log("Found by Start+End match");
                                         } catch(e) {
                                             window.log("Range creation failed: " + e);
                                             sel.removeAllRanges();
                                             sel.addRange(startRange);
                                             found = true;
                                         }
                                     } else {
                                         sel.removeAllRanges();
                                         sel.addRange(startRange);
                                         found = true; 
                                         window.log("Suffix not found, highlighting prefix only");
                                     }
                                 }
                             }
                         }
                         
                         // Verify Strategy 2 Match (if it succeeded)
                         if (found) {
                              var selText = window.getSelection().toString().replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                              var targetText = text.replace(/[\r\n\s]+/g, '');
                              if (Math.abs(selText.length - targetText.length) > targetText.length * 0.2) {
                                  window.log("highlightText Strategy 2 verification failed: length mismatch. Rejecting.");
                                  found = false;
                                  window.getSelection().removeAllRanges();
                              }
                         }
                         
                        // Strategy 3: Global Text Mapping (Moved to top)
                        
                        // Strategy 4: Multi-Chunk
                        if (!found) {
                            var chunks = text.split(/[,.
]/);
                            for (var i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
                                var chunk = chunks[i].trim();
                                if (chunk.length > 5) {
                                     sel.removeAllRanges();
                                     var range = document.createRange();
                                     range.selectNodeContents(document.body);
                                     range.collapse(true);
                                     sel.addRange(range);
                                     
                                     if (window.find(chunk, false, false, true, false, false, false)) {
                                         window.log("Found by chunk " + i);
                                         found = true;
                                         break;
                                     }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                     } catch(e) {
                         window.log("highlightText legacy error: " + e);
                     }
                     } // End Legacy Strategies
                     if (found) {
                          var selection = window.getSelection();
                          if (selection.rangeCount > 0) {
                                  var range = selection.getRangeAt(0);
                                  var rect = range.getBoundingClientRect();
                                  if (rect && rect.height > 0) {
                                      var fallbackTop = rect.top + window.scrollY - (window.innerHeight / 2);
                                      var className = window.isTTSMode ? 'tts-highlight' : 'audio-highlight';
                                      try {
                                          var firstSpan = window.safeHighlightRange(range, className);
                                          if (firstSpan) {
                                              if (searchingClassAdded) {
                                                  document.body.classList.remove('ob-tts-searching');
                                                  if (wasRubyEnabled && window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay) window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                                                  void document.body.offsetHeight;
                                                  searchingClassAdded = false;
                                              }
                                              if (window.__obTtsAutoScroll === true) {
                                                  window.smartScrollTo(firstSpan);
                                              }
                                              if (typeof strategy1EndCharIdx === 'number') {
                                                  window.__obTtsForwardSearchMinChar = strategy1EndCharIdx;
                                              } else {
                                                  try {
                                                      var tpmHt = window.__obTtsBuildVisibleTextMap();
                                                      window.__obTtsForwardSearchMinChar = window.__obTtsRangeEndToCharIndex(range, tpmHt.textNodesMap);
                                                  } catch (eEnd) {}
                                              }
                                              if (seg !== null) {
                                                  window.__obTtsLastHighlightSegmentIndex = seg;
                                              }
                                          } else {
                                              window.log("safeHighlightRange returned no spans");
                                          }
                                      } catch (e) {
                                          window.log("Highlight wrap failed: " + e);
                                          if (window.__obTtsAutoScroll === true) {
                                              window.scrollTo({ top: fallbackTop, behavior: "auto" });
                                          }
                                      }
                                  }
                          }
                     } else {
                          window.log("highlightText: failed to find text: " + text);
                     }
                 } finally {
                     // RESTORE STATE - UNCONDITIONALLY
                     document.body.classList.remove('ob-tts-searching');
                     void document.body.offsetHeight; // Force layout
                     
                    // Restore ruby strictly to the pre-highlight state.
                    if (wasRubyEnabled && window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay) {
                         window.onebookRestoreRubyAnnotationDisplay();
                     }
                     sel.removeAllRanges();
                 }
             } catch(e) {
                 window.log("highlightText CRITICAL error: " + e);
                 // Double safety cleanup
                 document.body.classList.remove('ob-tts-searching');
                 void document.body.offsetHeight; // Force layout
             }
        }

#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;
struct LiveOrbUniforms {
    float4 pack0;
    float4 pack1;
    float4 pack2;
    float4 accent;
struct ParticleIn {
    float3 position [[attribute(0)]];
    float jitter [[attribute(1)]];
struct ParticleOut {
    float4 position [[position]];
    float pointSize [[point_size]];
    float4 color;
vertex ParticleOut live_orb_vertex(
    ParticleIn in [[stage_in]],
    constant LiveOrbUniforms &u [[buffer(1)]],
    uint vid [[vertex_id]]
    float time = u.pack0.x;
    float breathAmp = u.pack0.y;
    float breathHz = u.pack0.z;
    float spinRate = u.pack0.w;
    float turbulence = u.pack1.y;
    float accentMix = u.pack1.z;
    float pointScale = u.pack1.w;
    float2 viewport = u.pack2.xy;
    float3 p = in.position;
    // Fixed tilt so poles stay off-axis.
    {
        const float tx = 1.05;
        const float tz = 0.42;
        float cx0 = cos(tx), sx0 = sin(tx);
        float cz0 = cos(tz), sz0 = sin(tz);
        float3 a = p;
        p.y = a.y * cx0 - a.z * sx0;
        p.z = a.y * sx0 + a.z * cx0;
        a = p;
        p.x = a.x * cz0 - a.y * sz0;
        p.y = a.x * sz0 + a.y * cz0;
    }
    // Single-axis spin.
    float yaw = time * spinRate;
    float cy = cos(yaw), sy = sin(yaw);
    float3 q = p;
    p.x = q.x * cy + q.z * sy;
    p.z = -q.x * sy + q.z * cy;
    float n = sin(p.x * 3.0 + time * 1.1) * cos(p.y * 2.7 - time * 0.9);
    float radius = 1.0 + in.jitter + turbulence * n * 0.06;
    float breathWave = 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(time * breathHz * 6.2831853);
    p *= radius * (1.0 + breathAmp * breathWave);
    ParticleOut out;
    float ndotv = p.z;
    // Facing hemisphere only 
 no see-through center, no front/back moir
    if (ndotv < 0.06) {
        out.position = float4(2.0, 2.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        out.pointSize = 0.0;
        out.color = float4(0.0);
        return out;
    }
    // Orthographic projection.
    float2 ndc = p.xy * 0.80;
    float aspect = viewport.x / max(viewport.y, 1.0);
    if (aspect > 1.0) ndc.x /= aspect; else ndc.y *= aspect;
    out.position = float4(ndc, 0.5 - ndotv * 0.15, 1.0);
    // Mild face fill only 
 strong compensate made blotches.
    float face = smoothstep(0.06, 0.95, ndotv);
    float compensate = mix(0.92, 1.35, pow(face, 0.7));
    float rim = length(p.xy);
    float edgeSoft = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.93, 1.05, rim);
    // Nearly uniform point size 
 even grain.
    out.pointSize = clamp(pointScale * 3.2 * compensate * edgeSoft, 2.0, 5.5);
    float3 graphite = float3(0.26, 0.27, 0.29);
    float3 lit = float3(0.38, 0.39, 0.42);
    float3 base = mix(graphite, lit, face * 0.85);
    float3 rgb = mix(base, mix(base, u.accent.xyz, 0.35), accentMix * face);
    float alpha = (0.28 + 0.22 * face) * edgeSoft;
    alpha *= mix(0.96, 1.03, breathWave);
    out.color = float4(rgb * clamp(alpha, 0.12, 0.65), clamp(alpha, 0.12, 0.65));
    return out;
fragment float4 live_orb_fragment(ParticleOut in [[stage_in]], float2 pc [[point_coord]]) {
    float2 uv = pc * 2.0 - 1.0;
    float d2 = dot(uv, uv);
    if (d2 > 1.0) discard_fragment();
    return in.color * exp(-d2 * 4.2);

        return false;
    }
    function obPerformDoubleClickSentenceRead(e) {
        if (window.doubleClickAction === 'off') {
            return;
        }
        // Suppress synthesized click(s) after a sentence double-tap (touch + mouse dblclick).
        // iOS often delivers two click events after two touchends; without this, the delayed
        // single-word handler can still run and add onebook-active / speak(word).
        window.__obTouchDoubleJustFiredUntil = Date.now() + 800;
        window.__obSuppressSelectionAnnotationUntil = Date.now() + 900;
        if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
            clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
            window.singleClickTimeout = null;
        }
        window.__obIgnoreWordClickUntil = Date.now() + 900;
        try {
            if (window.clearActiveWords) {
                window.clearActiveWords();
            }
        } catch (err) {}
        var idTarget = e.target;
        while (idTarget && idTarget !== document.body && !idTarget.id) {
            idTarget = idTarget.parentElement;
        }
        var text = "";
        var sel = window.getSelection();
        if (sel.rangeCount === 0 || sel.isCollapsed) {
             if (document.caretRangeFromPoint) {
                var range = document.caretRangeFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
                if (range && range.startContainer.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                    sel.removeAllRanges();
                    sel.addRange(range);
                }
            }
        }
        if (sel.rangeCount > 0) {
            try {
                sel.modify('move', 'backward', 'sentence');
                sel.modify('extend', 'forward', 'sentence');
                text = sel.toString().trim();
            } catch(err) {
                console.error("Selection modify failed", err);
            }
        }
        if (!text) {
            var textTarget = e.target;
            while (textTarget && textTarget !== document.body) {
                var display = window.getComputedStyle(textTarget).display;
                if (display === 'block' || display === 'list-item' || display === 'flex' || display === 'grid' || textTarget.tagName === 'P' || textTarget.tagName === 'DIV') {
                    break;
                }
                textTarget = textTarget.parentElement;
            }
            if (!textTarget) textTarget = e.target;
            if (textTarget) {
                 text = textTarget.innerText || "";
            }
        }
        text = text.trim();
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
             window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge.postMessage({
                type: 'tap',
                id: (idTarget && idTarget.id) ? idTarget.id : null,
                text: text
            });
        }
        try {
            sel.removeAllRanges();
        } catch (err) {}
        if (document.activeElement) {
            document.activeElement.blur();
        }
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler) {
            window.webkit.messageHandlers.annotationHandler.postMessage("");
        }
    }
    document.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e) {
        if (window.doubleClickAction === 'off') {
            return;
        }
        if (window.__obTouchDoubleJustFiredUntil && Date.now() < window.__obTouchDoubleJustFiredUntil) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        obPerformDoubleClickSentenceRead(e);
    });
    function obIsVerticalScrollGesture(dx, dy) {
        return Math.abs(dy) > 12 && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) * 1.2;
    }
    function obTouchEndWasScroll(clientX, clientY) {
        if (window.__obCurrentTouchIsScroll) return true;
        var gs = window.__obTouchGestureStart;
        if (!gs || window.isPaged) return false;
        var gdx = clientX - gs.x;
        var gdy = clientY - gs.y;
        return obIsVerticalScrollGesture(gdx, gdy);
    }
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
        window.__obCurrentTouchIsScroll = false;
        if (e.touches && e.touches.length === 1) {
            window.__obTouchGestureStart = {
                x: e.touches[0].clientX,
                y: e.touches[0].clientY,
                t: Date.now()
            };
        } else {
            window.__obTouchGestureStart = null;
        }
    }, { capture: true, passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
        if (!window.__obTouchGestureStart || !e.touches || !e.touches.length || window.isPaged) return;
        var dx = e.touches[0].clientX - window.__obTouchGestureStart.x;
        var dy = e.touches[0].clientY - window.__obTouchGestureStart.y;
        if (obIsVerticalScrollGesture(dx, dy)) {
            window.__obCurrentTouchIsScroll = true;
        }
    }, { capture: true, passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
        if (window.doubleClickAction === 'off') return;
        if (!e.changedTouches || e.changedTouches.length !== 1) return;
        var tch = e.changedTouches[0];
        var node = e.target;
        while (node && node !== document.body) {
            if (node.nodeType === 1 && obSkipDoubleClickTarget(node)) {
                return;
            }
            if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.tagName === 'A') {
                return;
            }
            node = node.parentNode;
        }
        var now = Date.now();
        var last = window.__obLastTouchEndPt;
        var x = tch.clientX;
        var y = tch.clientY;
        var wasScroll = obTouchEndWasScroll(x, y);
        window.__obCurrentTouchIsScroll = false;
        if (wasScroll || (last && last.wasScroll)) {
            window.__obLastTouchEndPt = null;
            return;
        }
        if (last && (now - last.t) > 0 && (now - last.t) < __obTouchDoubleComposeMs) {
            var dx = x - last.x;
            var dy = y - last.y;
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 55 * 55) {
                try { e.preventDefault(); } catch (err) {}
                window.__obLastTouchEndPt = null;
                obPerformDoubleClickSentenceRead({ target: e.target, clientX: x, clientY: y });
                return;
            }
        }
        window.__obLastTouchEndPt = { t: now, x: x, y: y, wasScroll: false };
    }, { capture: true, passive: false });
    // Second finger goes down soon after first lift 
 likely a double-tap for sentence read.
    // Clear the debounced word handler immediately (before `click` is delivered), so single/double stay disjoint.
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
        if (window.doubleClickAction === 'off') return;
        if (!e.touches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
        var tch = e.touches[0];
        var now = Date.now();
        var lastEnd = window.__obLastTouchEndPt;
        if (!lastEnd || (now - lastEnd.t) <= 0 || (now - lastEnd.t) >= __obTouchDoubleComposeMs) {
            return;
        }
        var dx = tch.clientX - lastEnd.x;
        var dy = tch.clientY - lastEnd.y;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy >= 72 * 72) {
            return;
        }
        if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
            clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
            window.singleClickTimeout = null;
        }
    }, { capture: true, passive: true });        
    // Helper for logging
    function log(msg) {
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.logHandler) {
            window.webkit.messageHandlers.logHandler.postMessage(msg);
        }
    }
    function blankTapLog(msg) {
        // Always emit via logHandler with a stable prefix (never silent if helper missing).
        var line = '[HTMLBlankTap] ' + msg;
        if (window.__obHTMLBlankTapLog) {
            window.__obHTMLBlankTapLog(msg);
            return;
        }
        log(line);
    }
    function describeEl(el) {
        if (window.__obHTMLDescribeEl) return window.__obHTMLDescribeEl(el);
        if (!el) return 'null';
        return (el.tagName || '?') + (el.className ? ('.' + String(el.className).split(/\s+/).slice(0, 3).join('.')) : '');
    }
    
    // Helper for handling tap (supports paged mode navigation)
    function handleTap(x) {
        // REMOVED: Side tap for page turn (User request)
        if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
             window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge.postMessage({ type: 'tap' });
        }
    }
    
    // Expand to a "whole word" where apostrophe/hyphen are in-word connectors.
    // e.g. didn't, don't, brand-new, funny-looking
    function getConnectedWordRange(textNode, offset) {
        if (!textNode || textNode.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE) return null;
        var text = textNode.nodeValue || "";
        if (!text || text.length === 0) return null;
        
        var idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(offset, text.length - 1));
        
        // If caret lands on separator, try previous char first.
        // Use Unicode letters/numbers so Spanish (
) and other scripts are not cut off.
        function isWordChar(ch) {
            return /[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(ch);
        }
        function isConnector(ch) {
            return ch === "'" || ch === "
" || ch === "-";
        }
        function isConnectedWordChar(ch) {
            return isWordChar(ch) || isConnector(ch);
        }
        
        if (!isConnectedWordChar(text.charAt(idx)) && idx > 0 && isConnectedWordChar(text.charAt(idx - 1))) {
            idx = idx - 1;
        }
        if (!isConnectedWordChar(text.charAt(idx))) return null;
        
        var start = idx;
        var end = idx + 1;
        
        while (start > 0 && isConnectedWordChar(text.charAt(start - 1))) {
            start--;
        }
        while (end < text.length && isConnectedWordChar(text.charAt(end))) {
            end++;
        }
        
        // Trim leading/trailing connectors to avoid selecting only punctuation.
        while (start < end && isConnector(text.charAt(start))) start++;
        while (end > start && isConnector(text.charAt(end - 1))) end--;
        if (end <= start) return null;
        
        // Require at least one letter or number (any script).
        var candidate = text.substring(start, end);
        if (!/[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(candidate)) return null;
        
        var r = document.createRange();
        r.setStart(textNode, start);
        r.setEnd(textNode, end);
        return r;
    }
    
    // --- Manual Hit Test Fallback ---
    // When HTMLReaderBlankTapScript is injected, prefer its tighter glyph policy.
    function manualHitTest(x, y, root) {
        if (window.__obHTMLManualHitTest) {
            return window.__obHTMLManualHitTest(x, y, root);
        }
        if (!root) return null;
        var tag = root.tagName.toUpperCase();
        if (tag === 'HTML') return null; // Allow BODY scan if needed, but usually elementFromPoint finds deeper
        var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
        var node;
        while(node = walker.nextNode()) {
            var str = node.nodeValue;
            // Simple word regex
            var regex = /\S+/g;
            var match;
            while ((match = regex.exec(str)) !== null) {
                var range = document.createRange();
                range.setStart(node, match.index);
                range.setEnd(node, regex.lastIndex);
                var rects = range.getClientRects();
                for (var i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
                    var r = rects[i];
                    // 5px padding for precision (was 10)
                    if (x >= r.left - 15 && x <= r.right + 15 && y >= r.top - 15 && y <= r.bottom + 15) {
                        return range;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    // --- Handle Word Selection on Tap ---
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (window.__obIgnoreWordClickUntil && Date.now() < window.__obIgnoreWordClickUntil) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }
        if (window.__obTouchDoubleJustFiredUntil && Date.now() < window.__obTouchDoubleJustFiredUntil) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }
        // Second click of a mouse double-click: cancel the first click's debounced word handler.
        // Do not preventDefault/stopPropagation here 
 that can suppress the following dblclick.
        if (typeof e.detail === 'number' && e.detail >= 2) {
            if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
            }
            return;
        }
        log("Click at: " + e.clientX + ", " + e.clientY);
        blankTapLog(
            'click xy=' + Math.round(e.clientX) + ',' + Math.round(e.clientY) +
            ' target=' + describeEl(e.target) +
            ' hasHTMLHitTest=' + (typeof window.__obHTMLManualHitTest === 'function') +
            ' pad=' + ((window.__obHTMLBlankTapPolicy && window.__obHTMLBlankTapPolicy.glyphPadPx) || 'n/a')
        );
        
        // 1. Check if clicking on an interactive element (link, button, existing highlight)
        // HTML blank-tap policy: ruby container padding toggles chrome unless glyph is hit.
        var target = e.target;
        while (target && target !== document.body && target !== document.documentElement) {
            if (target.nodeType === 1) {
                if (target.classList.contains('ob-ruby-container')) {
                    // HTML blank-tap: only the word/gloss glyphs count; padding 
 chrome.
                    var hitsRuby = window.__obHTMLPointHitsRubyGlyph
                        && window.__obHTMLPointHitsRubyGlyph(target, e.clientX, e.clientY);
                    blankTapLog('ruby-container hitsGlyph=' + !!hitsRuby + ' el=' + describeEl(target));
                    if (hitsRuby) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
                        clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
                        window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                    }
                    window.singleClickTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                        window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                        blankTapLog('decision=chrome reason=ruby-padding');
                        handleTap(e.clientX);
                    }, 250);
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    return;
                }
                if (
                    target.tagName === 'BUTTON' ||
                    target.classList.contains('epub-highlight') ||
                    target.classList.contains('epub-tts-highlight') ||
                    target.classList.contains('vocab-wrapper') ||
                    target.classList.contains('favorite-phrase') ||
                    target.classList.contains('favorite-phrase-underline') ||
                    target.classList.contains('favorite-phrase-highlight-only')
                ) {
                    log("Click on interactive element: " + target.tagName + " Classes: " + target.className);
                    blankTapLog('decision=ignore reason=interactive el=' + describeEl(target));
                    return;
                }
            }
            target = target.parentNode;
        }
        if (window.__obHTMLIsBlankishTarget && window.__obHTMLIsBlankishTarget(e.target)) {
            blankTapLog('decision=chrome reason=blankish-target el=' + describeEl(e.target));
            if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
            }
            window.singleClickTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                handleTap(e.clientX);
            }, 250);
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }
        
        // Paged Mode Navigation Priority (Readium-like) - REMOVED (User request: swipe only)
        /*
        if (window.isPaged) {
            var width = window.innerWidth;
            if (e.clientX < width * 0.2 || e.clientX > width * 0.8) {
                handleTap(e.clientX);
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                return;
            }
        }
        */
        
        // 2. Handle existing selection (Dismiss on outside click)
        var currentSel = window.getSelection();
        if (currentSel.toString().length > 0 && currentSel.type === 'Range') {
            var isInside = false;
            if (currentSel.rangeCount > 0) {
                 var range = currentSel.getRangeAt(0);
                 var rects = range.getClientRects();
                 for (var i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
                     var r = rects[i];
                     if (e.clientX >= r.left && e.clientX <= r.right &&
                         e.clientY >= r.top && e.clientY <= r.bottom) {
                         isInside = true;
                         break;
                     }
                 }
            }
            
            if (isInside) {
                 if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
                     clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
                     window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                 }
                 return;
            } else {
                 // log("Click outside existing selection -> Clear");
                 currentSel.removeAllRanges();
                 // Continue to allow selecting a new word if tapped on text
            }
        }
        if (window.clickAction === 'none') {
            // Word / AI 
onTap(nil,nil)
            // 
 tap 
 250ms 
            var awl = e.target;
            while (awl && awl !== document.body) {
                if (awl.nodeType === 1 && awl.tagName === 'A') {
                    return;
                }
                awl = awl.parentNode;
            }
            if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
            }
            window.singleClickTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
                    window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge.postMessage({ type: 'tap' });
                }
            }, 250);
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }
        
        // 3. Debounce for Double Click
        if (window.singleClickTimeout) {
            clearTimeout(window.singleClickTimeout);
            window.singleClickTimeout = null;
        }
        // 4. HTML article Events are glyph-strict (this script is never loaded by Foliate).
        // caretRangeFromPoint snap-to-nearest must not steal blank taps for chrome toggle.
        var pointTarget = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        var searchRoot = pointTarget;
        if (searchRoot && searchRoot.nodeType === 1 && searchRoot.closest) {
            // Never climb to a generic content `div` 
 that walks the whole article and
            // makes nearby-word hits too easy on news HTML.
            searchRoot = searchRoot.closest('p, li, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, td, th, figcaption, span, a') || searchRoot;
        }
        var hitRoot = searchRoot || pointTarget;
        var probe = (window.__obHTMLProbeWordHit)
            ? window.__obHTMLProbeWordHit(e.clientX, e.clientY, hitRoot)
            : null;
        var glyphHit = probe ? probe.hit : manualHitTest(e.clientX, e.clientY, hitRoot);
        blankTapLog(
            'glyphCheck pointTarget=' + describeEl(pointTarget) +
            ' searchRoot=' + describeEl(searchRoot) +
            ' usedHTMLProbe=' + !!probe +
            ' hit=' + !!(glyphHit) +
            (probe && probe.nearest
                ? (' nearest="' + probe.nearest.word + '" dist=' + probe.nearest.dist +
                   ' dx=' + probe.nearest.dx + ' dy=' + probe.nearest.dy +
                   ' pad=' + probe.nearest.pad +
                   ' rect=[' + probe.nearest.rect.l + ',' + probe.nearest.rect.t +
                   '-' + probe.nearest.rect.r + ',' + probe.nearest.rect.b + ']')
                : ' nearest=none')
        );
        if (!glyphHit) {
            log("HTML blank policy: no glyph under point -> Chrome tap");
            blankTapLog('decision=chrome reason=no-glyph-under-point');
            window.getSelection().removeAllRanges();
            handleTap(e.clientX);
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }
        blankTapLog(
            'decision=word-pending reason=glyph-hit word="' +
            ((probe && probe.nearest && probe.nearest.word) || (glyphHit.toString && glyphHit.toString()) || '?') + '"'
        );
        
        // 5. Schedule Selection Logic only when point is on a word glyph.
        window.singleClickTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
            if (window.clickAction === 'none') {
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                return;
            }
            if (window.__obIgnoreWordClickUntil && Date.now() < window.__obIgnoreWordClickUntil) {
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                return;
            }
            if (window.__obTouchDoubleJustFiredUntil && Date.now() < window.__obTouchDoubleJustFiredUntil) {
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                return;
            }
            var ptHit = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
            var root = ptHit;
            if (root && root.nodeType === 1 && root.closest) {
                root = root.closest('p, li, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, td, th, figcaption, span, a') || root;
            }
            var range = manualHitTest(e.clientX, e.clientY, root || ptHit);
            if (!range || range.startContainer.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                blankTapLog('decision=chrome reason=debounce-miss-range root=' + describeEl(root || ptHit));
                if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
                     handleTap(e.clientX);
                }
                window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                return;
            }
            
            if (range && range.startContainer.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                var sel = window.getSelection();
                sel.removeAllRanges();
                sel.addRange(range);
                
                // Expand to connected word (apostrophe/hyphen aware)
                var connectedWordRange = getConnectedWordRange(range.startContainer, range.startOffset);
                if (connectedWordRange) {
                    sel.removeAllRanges();
                    sel.addRange(connectedWordRange);
                } else {
                    // Fallback to browser default word boundary
                    sel.modify('move', 'backward', 'word');
                    sel.modify('extend', 'forward', 'word');
                }
                
                // Verify click is actually ON the word (not just near it)
                var isClickOnSelection = false;
                var hitPad = (window.__obHTMLBlankTapPolicy && window.__obHTMLBlankTapPolicy.glyphPadPx) || 3;
                if (sel.rangeCount > 0) {
                    var expandedRange = sel.getRangeAt(0);
                    var rects = expandedRange.getClientRects();
                    for (var i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
                         var r = rects[i];
                         if (e.clientX >= r.left - hitPad && e.clientX <= r.right + hitPad &&
                             e.clientY >= r.top - hitPad && e.clientY <= r.bottom + hitPad) {
                             isClickOnSelection = true;
                             log("Click confirmed on selection (Rect " + i + ")");
                             break;
                             }
                    }
                }
                
                if (!isClickOnSelection) {
                    log("Click not on word rects -> Fallback to Tap");
                    blankTapLog('decision=chrome reason=expanded-word-rect-miss word="' + sel.toString().trim() + '"');
                    sel.removeAllRanges();
                    window.singleClickTimeout = null;
                    if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.epubBridge) {
                         handleTap(e.clientX);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                
                var word = sel.toString().trim();
                if (word.length > 0) {
                    blankTapLog('decision=word reason=confirmed word="' + word + '"');
                    // Get Context (Sentence or Paragraph)
                    var context = word;
                    try {
                        // Simple context: parent block text
                        var node = range.startContainer;
                        var parent = node.parentElement;
                        // Climb up to find a block element
                        while (parent && parent !== document.body) {
                            var display = window.getComputedStyle(parent).display;
                            if (display === 'block' || display === 'list-item' || display === 'flex' || display === 'grid' || parent.tagName === 'P' || parent.tagName === 'DIV') {
                                break;
                            }
                            parent = parent.parentElement;
                        }
                        if (parent) {
                            log("JS: Found parent block for context: " + parent.tagName);
                            
                            // Use robust getSentenceFromBlock if available to exclude annotations
                            if (window.getSentenceFromBlock) {
                                log("JS: Using getSentenceFromBlock for context extraction");
                                context = window.getSentenceFromBlock(parent, range.startContainer, range.startOffset);
                            } else {
                                log("JS: Fallback to innerText (Warning: may include annotations)");
                                var fullText = parent.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                                context = fullText;
                            }
                            log("JS: Extracted context result: " + context.substring(0, 50) + "...");
                        }
                    } catch(err) {
                        log("Context extraction error: " + err);
                    }
                    if (window.webkit && window.webkit.messageHandlers && window.webkit.messageHandlers.aiAnalysisHandler) {
                         // Speech (Add speech trigger for black words)
                         if (window.clickAction !== 'favoriteOnly' && window.webkit.messageHandlers.speechHandler) {
                             window.webkit.messageHandlers.speechHandler.postMessage(word);
                         }
                         var rectData = null;
                         var tapIsCollected = false;
                         if (sel.rangeCount > 0) {
                             var r = sel.getRangeAt(0).getBoundingClientRect();
                             rectData = {
                                 x: r.x,
                                 y: r.y,
                                 width: r.width,
                                 height: r.height
                             };
                             
                             // --- Visual Feedback for Plain Text ---
                             try {
                                 var range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
                                 var parent = range.commonAncestorContainer;
                                 if (parent.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) parent = parent.parentElement;
                                 
                                 var sc = range.startContainer;
                                 var startEl = (sc.nodeType === 1) ? sc : sc.parentElement;
                                 var rubyHost = startEl && startEl.closest && startEl.closest('.ob-ruby-container');
                                 var collectedWrap = rubyHost && window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer && window.onebookIsSavedVocabRubyContainer(rubyHost);
                                 tapIsCollected = !!collectedWrap;
                                 
                                 if (collectedWrap) {
                                     // Saved vocab: swap trajectory/gloss ruby for Analyzing... while Swift may AI-enrich.
                                     if (window.clearActiveWords) {

  window.__obHTMLProbeWordHit = function(x, y, root) {
    var pad = (window.__obHTMLBlankTapPolicy && window.__obHTMLBlankTapPolicy.glyphPadPx) || 3;
    var result = { hit: null, nearest: null, pad: pad };
    if (!root) return result;
    if (root.nodeType === 1 && root.tagName && root.tagName.toUpperCase() === 'HTML') return result;
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);

    while (node = walker.nextNode()) {
      var str = node.nodeValue;
      if (!str) continue;

      var match;
      while ((match = regex.exec(str)) !== null) {
        var range = document.createRange();
        range.setStart(node, match.index);
        range.setEnd(node, regex.lastIndex);

          var r = rects[i];
          var dx = 0;
          var dy = 0;
          if (x < r.left) dx = r.left - x;
          else if (x > r.right) dx = x - r.right;
          if (y < r.top) dy = r.top - y;
          else if (y > r.bottom) dy = y - r.bottom;
          var dist = Math.max(dx, dy);
          if (dist <= pad) {
            result.hit = range;
            result.nearest = {
              word: match[0],
              dx: Math.round(dx),
              dy: Math.round(dy),
              dist: Math.round(dist),
              pad: pad,
              rect: {
                l: Math.round(r.left), r: Math.round(r.right),
                t: Math.round(r.top), b: Math.round(r.bottom)
              }
            };
            return result;
          }
          if (!best || dist < best.dist) {
            best = {
              word: match[0],
              dx: Math.round(dx),
              dy: Math.round(dy),
              dist: Math.round(dist),
              pad: pad,
              rect: {
                l: Math.round(r.left), r: Math.round(r.right),
                t: Math.round(r.top), b: Math.round(r.bottom)
              }
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
    result.nearest = best;
    return result;
  };

  };

function obCollapseDeadImage(img){
  if(!img||img.dataset.obDead==='1')return;
  img.dataset.obDead='1';
  img.style.setProperty('display','none','important');
  img.style.setProperty('max-height','0','important');
  img.style.setProperty('max-width','0','important');
  img.style.setProperty('margin','0','important');
  img.style.setProperty('padding','0','important');
  img.style.setProperty('border','none','important');
  img.removeAttribute('src');
  var fig=img.closest('figure');
  if(fig){
    fig.style.setProperty('min-height','0','important');
    fig.style.setProperty('max-height','none','important');
    fig.style.setProperty('aspect-ratio','unset','important');
    fig.style.setProperty('height','auto','important');
    var slot=img.parentElement;
    if(slot&&slot!==fig&&slot.tagName.toLowerCase()==='div'&&slot.children.length===1&&slot.firstElementChild===img){
      slot.style.setProperty('display','none','important');
    }
    var remaining=fig.querySelectorAll('img:not([data-ob-dead="1"])');
    if(!remaining.length){
      var cap=fig.querySelector('figcaption');
      var capText=cap?(cap.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,''):'';
      if(!capText){fig.style.setProperty('display','none','important');}
    }
    return;
  var p=img.parentElement,d=0;
  while(p&&p!==document.body&&d<8){
    var nm=(p.tagName||'').toLowerCase();
    if(nm==='figure'){p.style.minHeight='0';return;}
    if(nm==='div'&&p.children.length===1&&p.firstElementChild===img){
      var t=(p.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,'').length;
      if(t===0){p.style.setProperty('display','none','important');return;}
    }
    p.style.minHeight='0';
    p=p.parentElement;
    d++;
function obIsTinyLoaded(img){
  try{
    if(!img.complete)return false;
    var w=img.naturalWidth||0,h=img.naturalHeight||0;
    // Tracking pixels / broken placeholders often decode as 0
2px.
    if(w>0&&h>0&&w<=3&&h<=3)return true;
    if(w===0&&h===0&&img.getAttribute('src'))return true;
  }catch(e){}
  return false;
function obLooksLikeBeacon(img){
  var src=(img.getAttribute('src')||'').toLowerCase();
  if(!src)return true;
  if(/scorecardresearch|doubleclick|googletagmanager|google-analytics|facebook\.com\/tr|chartbeat|quantserve|comscore|1x1|spacer|pixel|blank\.gif/.test(src))return true;
  var w=parseInt(img.getAttribute('width')||'',10);
  var h=parseInt(img.getAttribute('height')||'',10);
  if((w>0&&w<=3)||(h>0&&h<=3))return true;
  return false;
function obBindImg(img){

  },{once:true});

function obSweepEmptyShells(){

    if(el.dataset.obShell==='1')return;

  function sentenceRangeAtPoint(x, y) {
    var pt = caretAt(x, y);
    var textNode = pt ? pt.startContainer : null;
    var offset = pt ? pt.startOffset : 0;
    if (!textNode || textNode.nodeType !== 3) {

      if (!el) return null;

    }
    var start = 0;
    var end = raw.length;
    for (var i = hit - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

    }

    }

  function fireLongPress() {

(function() {
    var attempts = 0;
    var maxAttempts = 60; // 30 seconds
    var found = false;
    function log(msg) {
        window.webkit.messageHandlers.podcastHandler.postMessage({log: msg});
    }
    function findData() {
        var result = {
            title: null,
            audioURL: null,
            coverURL: null,
            description: null,
            feedURL: null
        };
        
        // 1. Meta Tags
        var ogAudio = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:audio"]');
        if (ogAudio) result.audioURL = ogAudio.content;
        
        var ogTitle = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]');
        if (ogTitle) result.title = ogTitle.content;
        
        var ogImage = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:image"]');
        if (ogImage) result.coverURL = ogImage.content;
        
        var ogDesc = document.querySelector('meta[property="og:description"]');
        if (ogDesc) result.description = ogDesc.content;
        
        // 2. JSON-LD
        if (!result.audioURL) {
            var scripts = document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]');
            for (var i = 0; i < scripts.length; i++) {
                try {
                    var data = JSON.parse(scripts[i].innerText);
                    if (data['@type'] === 'PodcastEpisode' || data['@type'] === 'RadioEpisode') {
                        if (data.associatedMedia && data.associatedMedia.contentUrl) {
                            result.audioURL = data.associatedMedia.contentUrl;
                        }
                        if (!result.title && data.name) result.title = data.name;
                        if (!result.description && data.description) result.description = data.description;
                        if (!result.coverURL && data.image) result.coverURL = data.image;
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        }
        // 3. serialized-server-data
        var serverData = document.getElementById('serialized-server-data');
        if (serverData) {
            try {
                var jsonStr = serverData.textContent || serverData.innerText;
                if (jsonStr) {
                    // Extract feedUrl
                    var feedMatch = jsonStr.match(/"feedUrl"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
                    if (feedMatch) {
                        result.feedURL = feedMatch[1].replace(/\\//g, '/');
                        log("Found feedURL: " + result.feedURL);
                    }
                
                    // Audio URL Priority: assetUrl > streamUrl
                    var assetMatch = jsonStr.match(/"assetUrl"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
                    if (assetMatch) {
                        try {
                            result.audioURL = JSON.parse('"' + assetMatch[1] + '"');
                            log("Found audioURL (assetUrl)");
                        } catch(e) {
                            result.audioURL = assetMatch[1].replace(/\//g, '/');
                        }
                    } else if (!result.audioURL) {
                        var streamMatch = jsonStr.match(/"streamUrl"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
                        if (streamMatch) {
                            try {
                                result.audioURL = JSON.parse('"' + streamMatch[1] + '"');
                                log("Found audioURL (streamUrl)");
                            } catch(e) {
                                result.audioURL = streamMatch[1].replace(/\//g, '/');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (!result.title) {
                        var titleMatch = jsonStr.match(/"title"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
                        if (titleMatch) result.title = titleMatch[1];
                    }
                }
            } catch(e) {
                log("Error parsing server-data: " + e);
            }
        }
        
        // 4. Body Regex
        if (!result.audioURL && document.body) {
            var match = document.body.innerHTML.match(/https?:\/\/[^"']+\.(mp3|m4a)/i);
            if (match) result.audioURL = match[0];
        }
        
        if (!result.title) result.title = document.title;
        
        return result;
    }
    function check() {
        if (found) return;
        var data = findData();
        if (data && data.audioURL) {
            found = true;
            window.webkit.messageHandlers.podcastHandler.postMessage(data);
        } else {
            attempts++;
            if (attempts % 4 === 0) log("Polling " + attempts + "...");
            if (attempts < maxAttempts) setTimeout(check, 500);
            else window.webkit.messageHandlers.podcastHandler.postMessage({error: "Not found"});
        }
    }
    
    if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') check();
    else window.addEventListener('load', check);
})();

import sys, imp, types
from os import environ
from os.path import exists, join
try:
    # python 3
    import _imp
    EXTS = _imp.extension_suffixes()
    sys.modules['subprocess'] = types.ModuleType(name='subprocess')
    sys.modules['subprocess'].PIPE = None
    sys.modules['subprocess'].STDOUT = None
    sys.modules['subprocess'].DEVNULL = None
    sys.modules['subprocess'].CalledProcessError = Exception
    sys.modules['subprocess'].check_output = None
except ImportError:
    EXTS = ['.so']
# Fake redirection to supress console output
if environ.get('KIVY_NO_CONSOLE', '0') == '1':
    class fakestd(object):
        def write(self, *args, **kw): pass
        def flush(self, *args, **kw): pass

# Custom builtin importer for precompiled modules
class CustomBuiltinImporter(object):
    def find_module(self, fullname, mpath=None):
        # print(f'find_module() fullname={fullname} mpath={mpath}')
        if '.' not in fullname:
            return
        if not mpath:
            return
        part = fullname.rsplit('.')[-1]
        for ext in EXTS:
            fn = join(list(mpath)[0], '{}{}'.format(part, ext))
        # print('find_module() {}'.format(fn))
        if exists(fn):
            return self
        return
    def load_module(self, fullname):
        f = fullname.replace('.', '_')
        mod = sys.modules.get(f)
        if mod is None:
            # print('LOAD DYNAMIC', f, sys.modules.keys())
            try:
                mod = imp.load_dynamic(f, f)
            except ImportError:
                # import traceback; traceback.print_exc();
                # print('LOAD DYNAMIC FALLBACK', fullname)
                mod = imp.load_dynamic(fullname, fullname)
            sys.modules[fullname] = mod
            return mod
        return mod
sys.meta_path.insert(0, CustomBuiltinImporter())

The `then_branch` and `else_branch` may produce tensors with the same element type and different shapes. If corresponding outputs from the then-branch and the else-branch have static shapes S1 and S2, then the shape of the corresponding output variable of the if-node (if present) must be compatible with both S1 and S2 as it represents the union of both possible shapes.For example, if in a model file, the first output of `then_branch` is typed float tensor with shape [2] and the first output of `else_branch` is another float tensor with shape [3], If's first output should have (a) no shape set, or (b) a shape of rank 1 with neither `dim_value` nor `dim_param` set, or (c) a shape of rank 1 with a unique `dim_param`. In contrast, the first output cannot have the shape [2] since [2] and [3] are not compatible.

onesided
If `onesided` is `1` and input is real, only values for `k` in `[0, 1, 2, ..., floor(n_fft/2) + 1]` are returned because the real-to-complex Fourier transform satisfies the conjugate symmetry, i.e., `X[m, k] = X[m, n_fft-k]*`, where `m` denotes "all other dimensions" DFT was not applied on. If the input tensor is complex, onesided output is not possible. Value can be `0` or `1`. Default is `0`.
Whether to perform the inverse discrete Fourier Transform. Default is 0, which corresponds to `false`.
For real input, the following shape is expected: `[signal_dim0][signal_dim1][signal_dim2]...[signal_dimN][1]`. For complex input, the following shape is expected: `[signal_dim0][signal_dim1][signal_dim2]...[signal_dimN][2]`. The final dimension represents the real and imaginary parts of the value in that order.
dft_length
The length of the signal as a scalar. If greater than the axis dimension, the signal will be zero-padded up to `dft_length`. If less than the axis dimension, only the first `dft_length` values will be used as the signal. 
The axis as a scalar on which to perform the DFT. Default is `-2` (last signal axis). Negative value means counting dimensions from the back. Accepted range is $[-r, -2] \cup [0, r-2]$ where `r = rank(input)`. The last dimension is for representing complex numbers and thus is an invalid axis.
The Fourier Transform of the input vector. If `onesided` is `0`, the following shape is expected: `[signal_dim0][signal_dim1][signal_dim2]...[signal_dimN][2]`. If `axis=0` and `onesided` is `1`, the following shape is expected: `[floor(signal_dim0/2)+1][signal_dim1][signal_dim2]...[signal_dimN][2]`. If `axis=1` and `onesided` is `1`, the following shape is expected: `[signal_dim0][floor(signal_dim1/2)+1][signal_dim2]...[signal_dimN][2]`. If `axis=N` and `onesided` is `1`, the following shape is expected: `[signal_dim0][signal_dim1][signal_dim2]...[floor(signal_dimN/2)+1][2]`. The `signal_dim` at the specified `axis` is equal to the `dft_length`.

BlackmanWindow
output_datatype
The data type of the output tensor. Strictly must be one of the values from DataType enum in TensorProto whose values correspond to T3. The default value is 1 = FLOAT. 
num_mel_bins
The number of bands in the mel spectrum.
The size of the original DFT. The size of the original DFT is used to infer the size of the onesided DFT, which is understood to be floor(dft_length/2) + 1, i.e. the spectrogram only contains the nonredundant DFT bins.
sample_rate
Samples per second of the input signal used to create the spectrogram. Used to figure out the frequencies corresponding to each spectrogram bin, which dictates how they are mapped into the mel scale.
lower_edge_hertz
Lower bound on the frequencies to be included in the mel spectrum. This corresponds to the lower edge of the lowest triangular band.
upper_edge_hertz
The desired top edge of the highest frequency band.
The Mel Weight Matrix. The output has the shape: [floor(dft_length/2) + 1][num_mel_bins].

MelWeightMatrix
If onesided is 1, only values for w in [0, 1, 2, ..., floor(n_fft/2) + 1] are returned because the real-to-complex Fourier transform satisfies the conjugate symmetry, i.e., X[m, w] = X[m,w]=X[m,n_fft-w]*. Note if the input or window tensors are complex, then onesided output is not possible. Enabling onesided with real inputs performs a Real-valued fast Fourier transform (RFFT).When invoked with real or complex valued input, the default value is 1. Values can be 0 or 1.
signal
Input tensor representing a real or complex valued signal. For real input, the following shape is expected: [batch_size][signal_length][1]. For complex input, the following shape is expected: [batch_size][signal_length][2], where [batch_size][signal_length][0] represents the real component and [batch_size][signal_length][1] represents the imaginary component of the signal.
frame_step
The number of samples to step between successive DFTs.
window
A tensor representing the window that will be slid over the signal.The window must have rank 1 with shape: [window_shape]. It's an optional value. 
frame_length
A scalar representing the size of the DFT. It's an optional value.
The Short-time Fourier Transform of the signals.If onesided is 1, the output has the shape: [batch_size][frames][dft_unique_bins][2], where dft_unique_bins is frame_length // 2 + 1 (the unique components of the DFT) If onesided is 0, the output has the shape: [batch_size][frames][frame_length][2], where frame_length is the length of the DFT.

If necessary the right-hand-side argument will be broadcasted to match the
shape of left-hand-side argument. When broadcasting is specified, the second
tensor can either be of element size 1 (including a scalar tensor and any
tensor with rank equal to or smaller than the first tensor), or having its
shape as a contiguous subset of the first tensor's shape. The starting of the
mutually equal shape is specified by the argument "axis", and if it is not set,
suffix matching is assumed. 1-dim expansion doesn't work yet.
For example, the following tensor shapes are supported (with broadcast=1):
  shape(A) = (2, 3, 4, 5), shape(B) = (,), i.e. B is a scalar tensor
  shape(A) = (2, 3, 4, 5), shape(B) = (1, 1), i.e. B is an 1-element tensor
  shape(A) = (2, 3, 4, 5), shape(B) = (5,)
  shape(A) = (2, 3, 4, 5), shape(B) = (4, 5)
  shape(A) = (2, 3, 4, 5), shape(B) = (3, 4), with axis=1
  shape(A) = (2, 3, 4, 5), shape(B) = (2), with axis=0

Note if the input or window tensors are complex, then onesided output is not possible. Enabling onesided with real inputs performs a Real-valued fast Fourier transform (RFFT). When invoked with real or complex valued input, the default value is 0. Values can be 0 or 1.

Padding for the beginning and ending along each spatial axis, it can take any value greater than or equal to 0. The value represent the number of pixels added to the beginning and end part of the corresponding axis. `pads` format should be as follow [x1_begin, x2_begin...x1_end, x2_end,...], where xi_begin the number of pixels added at the beginning of axis `i` and xi_end, the number of pixels added at the end of axis `i`. auto_pad must be either NOTSET, SAME_UPPER, SAME_LOWER or VALID. Where default value is NOTSET, which means explicit padding is used. SAME_UPPER or SAME_LOWER mean pad the input so that `output_shape[i] = input_shape[i] * strides[i]` for each axis `i`. The padding is split between the two sides equally or almost equally (depending on whether it is even or odd). In case the padding is an odd number, the extra padding is added at the end for SAME_UPPER and at the beginning for SAME_LOWER.

The starting indexes of 1-grams, 2-grams, and so on in pool. It is useful when determining the boundary between two consecutive collections of n-grams. This format is essentially identical to CSR (or CSC) sparse matrix format, and we choose to use this due to its popularity.

Input data tensor to be rearranged from column blocks back into an image. This is a 3-dimensional tensor containing [N, C * n-ary-product(block_shape), L], where N is batch dimension, C is image channel dimension and L is number of blocks.The blocks are enumerated in increasing lexicographic-order of their indices.For example, with an image-size 10*20 and block-size 9*18, there would be 2*3 blocks, enumerated in the order block(0, 0), block(0, 1), block(0, 2), block(1, 0), block(1, 1), block(1, 2).

block_shape
The shape of the block to apply on the input.This is a 1-dimensional tensor of size of at least 2, containing the value [H_block, W_block]  for a 2-D image or [dim_b1, dim_b2, ..., dim_bN] for a N-D block.This is the block-shape before dilation is applied to it.

Attribute expected to have tensor or sparse tensor type
Carries out batch normalization as described in the paper
https://arxiv.org/abs/1502.03167. Depending on the mode it is being run,
There are five required inputs 'X', 'scale', 'B', 'input_mean' and
'input_var'.
Note that 'input_mean' and 'input_var' are expected to be the estimated
statistics in inference mode (training_mode=False, default),
and the running statistics in training mode (training_mode=True).
There are multiple cases for the number of outputs, which we list below:
* Output case #1: Y, running_mean, running_var (training_mode=True)
* Output case #2: Y (training_mode=False)
When training_mode=False, extra outputs are invalid.
The outputs are updated as follows when training_mode=True:
running_mean = input_mean * momentum + current_mean * (1 - momentum)
running_var = input_var * momentum + current_var * (1 - momentum)
Y = (X - current_mean) / sqrt(current_var + epsilon) * scale + B
where:
current_mean = ReduceMean(X, axis=all_except_channel_index)
current_var =  ReduceVar(X, axis=all_except_channel_index)
Notice that `ReduceVar` refers to the population variance, and it equals to
`sum(sqrd(x_i - x_avg)) / N`
where `N` is the population size (this formula does not use sample size `N - 1`).
The computation of ReduceMean and ReduceVar uses float to avoid overflow for float16 inputs.
When training_mode=False:
Y = (X - input_mean) / sqrt(input_var + epsilon) * scale + B
For previous (depreciated) non-spatial cases, implementors are suggested
to flatten the input shape to (N x C * D1 * D2 * ... * Dn) before a BatchNormalization Op.
